Are volitional formations the person…pe… is a person in volitional formations…pe… is a person apart from volitional formations…pe… are volitional formations in a person…pe…

Viññāṇaṃ puggalo…pe… viññāṇasmiṃ puggalo…pe… aññatra viññāṇā puggalo…pe… puggalasmiṃ viññāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

Is consciousness the person…pe… is a person in consciousness…pe… is a person apart from consciousness…pe… is consciousness in a person? It should not be said so.

Ājānāhi paṭikammaṃ. Hañci vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,” tena vata re vattabbe – “puggalasmiṃ viññāṇa”nti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘vuttaṃ bhagavatā – atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘puggalasmiṃ viññāṇa’”nti micchā.

Acknowledge the rejoinder. If, friend, it was said by the Blessed One, 'There is a person practicing for his own welfare,' then indeed it should be said, 'Consciousness is in the person.' That which you state there—'It should indeed be said, “It was said by the Blessed One, ‘There is a person practicing for his own welfare,’” but it should not be said, “Consciousness is in the person”'—is incorrect.

No [P 0.0023] ce pana vattabbe – “puggalasmiṃ viññāṇa”nti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “vuttaṃ bhagavatā – ‘atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno’”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘vuttaṃ bhagavatā – atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘puggalasmiṃ viññāṇa’”nti micchā…pe….

If, however, it should not be said, 'Consciousness is in the person,' then indeed, friend, it should not be said, 'It was said by the Blessed One, “There is a person practicing for his own welfare.”' That which you state there—'It should indeed be said, “It was said by the Blessed One, ‘There is a person practicing for his own welfare,’” but it should not be said, “Consciousness is in the person”'—is incorrect… and so on.

52. Puggalo [M 0.0025] nupalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti? Āmantā. Vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno”ti? Āmantā. Cakkhāyatanaṃ puggalo…pe… cakkhāyatanasmiṃ puggalo…pe… aññatra cakkhāyatanā puggalo…pe… puggalasmiṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ puggalo…pe… dhammāyatanasmiṃ puggalo…pe… aññatra dhammāyatanā puggalo…pe… puggalasmiṃ dhammāyatanaṃ…pe….

52. Is a person not apprehended in the sense of a true and ultimate reality? Yes. Was it said by the Blessed One, 'There is a person practicing for his own welfare'? Yes. Is the eye-base the person…pe… is a person in the eye-base…pe… is a person apart from the eye-base…pe… is the eye-base in a person…pe… is the mind-object-base the person…pe… is a person in the mind-object-base…pe… is a person apart from the mind-object-base…pe… is the mind-object-base in a person…pe…

Cakkhudhātu [V 0.0028] puggalo…pe… cakkhudhātuyā puggalo…pe… aññatra [T 0.0034] cakkhudhātuyā puggalo…pe… puggalasmiṃ cakkhudhātu…pe… dhammadhātu puggalo…pe… dhammadhātuyā puggalo…pe… aññatra dhammadhātuyā puggalo…pe… puggalasmiṃ dhammadhātu…pe….

Is the eye-element a person?… Is a person apprehended in the eye-element?… Is a person apprehended apart from the eye-element?… Is the eye-element apprehended in the person?… Is the mind-object-element a person?… Is a person apprehended in the mind-object-element?… Is a person apprehended apart from the mind-object-element?… Is the mind-object-element apprehended in the person?…

Cakkhundriyaṃ puggalo…pe… cakkhundriyasmiṃ puggalo…pe… aññatra cakkhundriyā puggalo…pe… puggalasmiṃ cakkhundriyaṃ…pe… aññātāvindriyaṃ puggalo…pe… aññātāvindriyasmiṃ puggalo…pe… aññatra aññātāvindriyā puggalo…pe… puggalasmiṃ aññātāvindriyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

Is the eye-faculty a person?… Is a person apprehended in the eye-faculty?… Is a person apprehended apart from the eye-faculty?… Is the eye-faculty apprehended in the person?… Is the faculty of one who has final knowledge a person?… Is a person apprehended in the faculty of one who has final knowledge?… Is a person apprehended apart from the faculty of one who has final knowledge?… Is the faculty of one who has final knowledge apprehended in the person? It should not be said thus.

Ājānāhi paṭikammaṃ. Hañci vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,” tena vata re vattabbe – “puggalasmiṃ [P 0.0024] aññātāvindriya”nti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘vuttaṃ bhagavatā – atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘puggalasmiṃ aññātāvindriya’”nti micchā.

Acknowledge the refutation. If it was said by the Blessed One, 'There is a person practicing for his own welfare,' then indeed it should be said, 'The faculty of one who has final knowledge is apprehended in the person.' The statement you make—that 'it should be said, "It was said by the Blessed One, ‘There is a person practicing for his own welfare,’" but it should not be said, "The faculty of one who has final knowledge is apprehended in the person"'—is wrong.

No ce pana vattabbe – “puggalasmiṃ aññātāvindriya”nti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “vuttaṃ bhagavatā – ‘atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno’”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘vuttaṃ bhagavatā – atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘puggalasmiṃ aññātāvindriya’”nti micchā…pe….

If, however, it should not be said, 'The faculty of one who has final knowledge is apprehended in the person,' then indeed it should not be said, 'It was said by the Blessed One, "There is a person practicing for his own welfare."' The statement you make—that 'it should be said, "It was said by the Blessed One, ‘There is a person practicing for his own welfare,’" but it should not be said, "The faculty of one who has final knowledge is apprehended in the person"'—is wrong…

Catukkanayasaṃsandanaṃ.

Connection by the Fourfold Method.

8. Lakkhaṇayuttikathā

8. The Discussion on Characteristics and Logic.

53. Puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti? Āmantā. Puggalo sappaccayo…pe… puggalo appaccayo… puggalo saṅkhato [T 0.0035]… puggalo asaṅkhato… puggalo sassato [V 0.0029] … puggalo asassato… puggalo sanimitto… puggalo animittoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe. (Saṃkhittaṃ)

53. Is a person apprehended in the sense of a real and ultimate meaning? Yes. Is a person with cause… without cause… conditioned… unconditioned… eternal… non-eternal… with a sign… without a sign? It should not be said thus. (Abbreviated)

54. Puggalo [M 0.0026] nupalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti? Āmantā. Vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno”ti? Āmantā. Puggalo sappaccayo…pe… puggalo appaccayo… puggalo saṅkhato… puggalo asaṅkhato… puggalo sassato… puggalo asassato… puggalo sanimitto… puggalo animittoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe. (Saṃkhittaṃ)

54. Is a person not apprehended in the sense of a real and ultimate meaning? Yes. Has it been said by the Blessed One: 'There is a person who is practicing for his own welfare'? Yes. Is a person with cause… without cause… conditioned… unconditioned… eternal… non-eternal… with a sign… without a sign? It should not be said thus. (Abbreviated)

Lakkhaṇayuttikathā.

The Discussion on Characteristics and Logic.

9. Vacanasodhanaṃ

9. The Clarification of Speech.

55. Puggalo upalabbhati, upalabbhati puggaloti? Puggalo upalabbhati, upalabbhati kehici puggalo kehici na puggaloti. Puggalo kehici upalabbhati kehici na upalabbhatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

55. Is a person apprehended? Is what is apprehended a person? A person is apprehended. Of what is apprehended, some is a person, and some is not a person. Is it that among persons, some are apprehended and some are not apprehended? It should not be said thus…

56. Puggalo saccikaṭṭho, saccikaṭṭho puggaloti? Puggalo saccikaṭṭho, saccikaṭṭho kehici puggalo kehici na puggaloti. Puggalo [P 0.0025] kehici saccikaṭṭho kehici na saccikaṭṭhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

56. Is a person a real phenomenon? Is what is a real phenomenon a person? A person is a real phenomenon. Of what is a real phenomenon, some is a person, and some is not a person. Is it that among persons, some are a real phenomenon and some are not a real phenomenon? It should not be said thus…

57. Puggalo vijjamāno, vijjamāno puggaloti? Puggalo vijjamāno, vijjamāno kehici puggalo kehici na puggaloti. Puggalo kehici vijjamāno kehici na vijjamānoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

57. Is a person existent? Is what is existent a person? A person is existent. Of what is existent, some is a person, and some is not a person. Is it that among persons, some are existent and some are not existent? It should not be said thus…

58. Puggalo [T 0.0036] saṃvijjamāno, saṃvijjamāno puggaloti? Puggalo saṃvijjamāno, saṃvijjamāno [V 0.0030] kehici puggalo kehici na puggaloti. Puggalo kehici saṃvijjamāno kehici na saṃvijjamānoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

58. Is a person truly existent? Is what is truly existent a person? A person is truly existent. Of what is truly existent, some is a person, and some is not a person. Is it that among persons, some are truly existent and some are not truly existent? It should not be said thus…

59. Puggalo atthi, atthi puggaloti? Puggalo atthi, atthi kehici puggalo kehici na puggaloti. Puggalo kehici atthi kehici natthīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

59. Does a person exist? Is that which exists a person? A person exists. Of that which exists, some is a person, and some is not a person. Is it that among persons, some exist and some do not exist? It should not be said thus…

60. Puggalo atthi, atthi na sabbo puggaloti? Āmantā…pe… puggalo natthi, natthi na sabbo puggaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe. (Saṃkhittaṃ)

60. Does a person exist, and is it that not all that exists is a person? Yes… Does a person not exist, and is it that not all that does not exist is a person? It should not be said thus. (Abbreviated)

Vacanasodhanaṃ.

The Clarification of Speech.

10. Paññattānuyogo

10. The Inquiry into Designations.

61. Rūpadhātuyā [M 0.0027] rūpī puggaloti? Āmantā. Kāmadhātuyā kāmī puggaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

61. In the form realm, is one with form a person? Yes. In the desire realm, is one of the desire realm a person? It should not be said thus…

62. Rūpadhātuyā rūpino sattāti? Āmantā. Kāmadhātuyā kāmino sattāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

62. In the form realm, are those with form beings? Yes. In the desire realm, are those of the desire realm beings? It should not be said thus…

63. Arūpadhātuyā arūpī puggaloti? Āmantā. Kāmadhātuyā [P 0.0026] kāmī puggaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

63. In the formless realm, is a formless one a person? Yes. In the desire realm, is one of the desire realm a person? It should not be said thus…

64. Arūpadhātuyā arūpino sattāti? Āmantā. Kāmadhātuyā kāmino sattāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

64. In the formless realm, are formless ones beings? Yes. In the desire realm, are those of the desire realm beings? It should not be said thus…

65. Rūpadhātuyā rūpī puggalo arūpadhātuyā arūpī puggalo, atthi [T 0.0037] ca koci rūpadhātuyā [V 0.0031] cuto arūpadhātuṃ upapajjatīti? Āmantā. Rūpī puggalo upacchinno, arūpī puggalo jātoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

65. In the form realm, one with form is a person; in the formless realm, a formless one is a person. And is there anyone who, having passed away from the form realm, is reborn in the formless realm? Yes. Is the person with form cut off, and the formless person born? It should not be said thus…

66. Rūpadhātuyā rūpino sattā arūpadhātuyā arūpino sattā, atthi ca koci rūpadhātuyā cuto arūpadhātuṃ upapajjatīti? Āmantā. Rūpī satto upacchinno, arūpī satto jātoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

66. In the form realm, those with form are beings; in the formless realm, formless ones are beings. And is there anyone who, having passed away from the form realm, is reborn in the formless realm? Yes. Is the being with form cut off, and the formless being born? It should not be said thus…

67. Kāyoti vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāteti? Āmantā. Puggaloti vā jīvoti vā, jīvoti vā puggaloti vā, puggalaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāteti? Āmantā. Añño kāyo, añño puggaloti? Āmantā. Aññaṃ jīvaṃ, aññaṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

67. Regarding 'body' (kāya) or 'physical frame' (sarīra), or 'physical frame' or 'body'—having treated them as inseparable, is this one that one? Are they of one meaning? Are they the same? Are they of the same portion? Are they born from that? Yes. Regarding 'person' (puggala) or 'life-principle' (jīva), or 'life-principle' or 'person'—having treated them as inseparable, is this one that one? Are they of one meaning? Are they the same? Are they of the same portion? Are they born from that? Yes. Is the body other than the person? Is the person other than the body? Yes. Is the life-principle other than the physical frame? Is the physical frame other than the life-principle? It should not be said thus.

Ājānāhi niggahaṃ. Hañci kāyoti vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, puggaloti vā jīvoti vā, jīvoti vā puggaloti vā, puggalaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe [P 0.0027] same samabhāge tajjāte, añño kāyo añño puggalo; tena vata re vattabbe – “aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra”nti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘kāyoti [M 0.0028] vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese [T 0.0038] ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, puggaloti vā jīvoti vā, jīvoti vā puggaloti vā, puggalaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, añño kāyo añño puggalo,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra’”nti micchā.

Acknowledge the refutation. If, concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated the body as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and if, concerning ‘person’ or ‘life-principle,’ or ‘life-principle’ or ‘person,’ having treated the person as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and if the body is other and the person is other; then, sir, it should indeed be said: ‘The life-principle is other, the physical frame is other.’ That which you state therein—‘It should indeed be said: “Concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated the body as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and concerning ‘person’ or ‘life-principle,’ or ‘life-principle’ or ‘person,’ having treated the person as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and the body is other, the person is other,” but it should not be said: “The life-principle is other, the physical frame is other”’—is incorrect.

No ce pana vattabbe – “aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra”nti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “kāyoti vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, puggaloti vā jīvoti vā, jīvoti vā puggaloti vā, puggalaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, añño kāyo añño puggalo”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘kāyoti [V 0.0032] vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, puggaloti vā jīvoti vā, jīvoti vā puggaloti vā, puggalaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, añño kāyo añño puggalo’, no ca vattabbe – ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra’”nti micchā…pe….

But if it should not be said: ‘The life-principle is other, the physical frame is other,’ then, sir, it should indeed not be said: ‘Concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated the body as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and concerning ‘person’ or ‘life-principle,’ or ‘life-principle’ or ‘person,’ having treated the person as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and the body is other, the person is other.’ That which you state therein—‘It should indeed be said: “Concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’… and the body is other, the person is other,” but it should not be said: “The life-principle is other, the physical frame is other”’—is incorrect… and so on.

68. Kāyoti vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāteti? Āmantā. Vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno”ti? Āmantā. Añño kāyo añño puggaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

68. Concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated them as inseparable, is it that this very one is that one, that they are of one meaning, that they are the same, that they are of the same portion, and that they are born from that? Yes. Has it been said by the Blessed One: ‘There is a person who practices for his own welfare’? Yes. Is the body other? Is the person other? This should not be said.

Ājānāhi paṭikammaṃ. Hañci kāyoti vā sarīranti [T 0.0039] vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,” tena vata re vattabbe – “añño kāyo añño puggalo”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘kāyoti vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, vuttaṃ bhagavatā – atthi [P 0.0028] puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘añño kāyo añño puggalo’”ti micchā.

Acknowledge the rejoinder. If, concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated them as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and if it has been said by the Blessed One: ‘There is a person who practices for his own welfare,’ then, sir, it should indeed be said: ‘The body is other, the person is other.’ That which you state therein—‘It should indeed be said: “Concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated them as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and it has been said by the Blessed One: ‘There is a person who practices for his own welfare,’” but it should not be said: “The body is other, the person is other”’—is incorrect.

No [M 0.0029] ce pana vattabbe – “añño kāyo añño puggalo”ti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “kāyoti vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, vuttaṃ bhagavatā – ‘atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno’”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘kāyoti vā sarīranti vā, sarīranti vā kāyoti vā, kāyaṃ appiyaṃ karitvā esese ekaṭṭhe same samabhāge tajjāte, vuttaṃ bhagavatā – atthi puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘añño kāyo añño puggalo’”ti micchā. (Saṃkhittaṃ)

But if it should not be said: ‘The body is other, the person is other,’ then, sir, it should indeed not be said: ‘Concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated them as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and it has been said by the Blessed One: “There is a person who practices for his own welfare.”’ That which you state therein—‘It should indeed be said: “Concerning ‘body’ or ‘physical frame,’ or ‘physical frame’ or ‘body,’ having treated them as inseparable, this very one is that one, they are of one meaning, they are the same, they are of the same portion, and they are born from that; and it has been said by the Blessed One: ‘There is a person who practices for his own welfare,’” but it should not be said: “The body is other, the person is other”’—is incorrect. (Abbreviated)

Paññattānuyogo.

The Inquiry into Designations.

11. Gatianuyogo

11. Inquiry Concerning Destinations

69. Puggalo [V 0.0033] sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. So puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe [T 0.0040] …pe….

11. Does a person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? This should not be said… and so on.

70. Puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Añño puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

69. Does a person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Does another person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? This should not be said… and so on.

71. Puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. So ca añño ca sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

70. Does a person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Do both that very person and another person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? This should not be said… and so on.

72. Puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Neva so sandhāvati, na añño sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Na [P 0.0029] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

71. Does a person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Does neither that very person nor another person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? This should not be said… and so on.

73. Puggalo [M 0.0030] sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. So puggalo sandhāvati, añño puggalo sandhāvati, so ca añño ca sandhāvati, neva so sandhāvati na añño sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

72. Does a person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Does that very person transmigrate, does another person transmigrate, do both that very person and another person transmigrate, or does neither that very person nor another person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? This should not be said… and so on.

74. Na vattabbaṃ – “puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ loka”nti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ [T 0.0041] bhagavatā –

73. Should it not be said: ‘A person transmigrates from this world to another world, and from another world to this world’? Yes. But was it not said by the Blessed One—

“Sa sattakkhattuparamaṃ, sandhāvitvāna puggalo;

Dukkhassantakaro hoti, sabbasaṃyojanakkhayā”ti saṃ. ni. 2.133; itivu. 24 itivuttakepi.

‘That person, having transmigrated at most seven times, makes an end of suffering through the destruction of all fetters.’

Attheva [V 0.0034] suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti.

Is there indeed such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, a person transmigrates from this world to another world, and from another world to this world.

75. Na vattabbaṃ – “puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ loka”nti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “anamataggoyaṃ anamataggāyaṃ (ka.), bhikkhave, saṃsāro. Pubbakoṭi na paññāyati, avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarata”nti saṃ. ni. 2.124! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti.

75. Should it not be said that “a person transmigrates from this world to another world, and from another world to this world”? Yes. But was it not said by the Blessed One: “Monks, this saṃsāra is without a discernible beginning. A first point is not perceived for beings who, hindered by ignorance and fettered by craving, are transmigrating and running on.” Is there such a Sutta? Yes. In that case, a person does transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world.

76. Puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

76. Does a person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? This should not be said… and so on.

77. Sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Atthi koci manusso hutvā devo hotīti? Āmantā. Sveva manusso so devoti? Na [P 0.0030] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

77. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Is there anyone who, having been a human, becomes a deva? Yes. Is that very human that deva? This should not be said… and so on.

78. Sveva manusso so devoti? Āmantā. Manusso hutvā devo hoti, devo hutvā manusso [T 0.0042] hoti, manussabhūto añño, devo añño, manussabhūto svevāyaṃ sandhāvatīti micchā…pe….

78. Is that very human that deva? Yes. Having been a human, one becomes a deva; having been a deva, one becomes a human. The one who was human is another, and the deva is another. To say that this very one who was human transmigrates is wrong… and so on.

Sace [M 0.0031] hi sandhāvati sveva puggalo ito cuto paraṃ lokaṃ anañño, hevaṃ maraṇaṃ na hehiti, pāṇātipātopi nupalabbhati. Kammaṃ atthi, kammavipāko atthi, katānaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko atthi, kusalākusale vipaccamāne svevāyaṃ sandhāvatīti micchā.

For if that very person, not another, transmigrates, having passed away from here to the next world, then death would not occur, and the killing of living beings would not be found. There is kamma, there is the result of kamma, there is the result of deeds that have been done. To say that while wholesome and unwholesome kamma are ripening, this very same one transmigrates, is wrong.

79. Sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Atthi koci manusso hutvā yakkho hoti, peto hoti, nerayiko hoti[V 0.0035], tiracchānagato hoti, oṭṭho hoti, goṇo hoti, gadrabho hoti, sūkaro hoti, mahiṃso mahiso (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) hotīti? Āmantā. Sveva manusso so mahiṃsoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

79. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Is there anyone who, having been a human, becomes a yakkha, a peta, a hell-being, an animal, a camel, an ox, a donkey, a pig, or a buffalo? Yes. Is that very human that buffalo? This should not be said… and so on.

80. Sveva manusso so mahiṃsoti? Āmantā. Manusso hutvā mahiṃso hoti, mahiṃso hutvā manusso hoti, manussabhūto añño, mahiṃso añño, manussabhūto svevāyaṃ sandhāvatīti micchā…pe….

80. Is that very human that buffalo? Yes. Having been a human, one becomes a buffalo; having been a buffalo, one becomes a human. The one who was human is another, and the buffalo is another. To say that this very one who was human transmigrates is wrong… and so on.

Sace hi sandhāvati sveva puggalo ito cuto paraṃ lokaṃ anañño, hevaṃ maraṇaṃ na hehiti, pāṇātipātopi nupalabbhati. Kammaṃ atthi, kammavipāko atthi, katānaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko atthi, kusalākusale vipaccamāne svevāyaṃ sandhāvatīti micchā.

For if that very person, not another, transmigrates, having passed away from here to the next world, then death would not occur, and the killing of living beings would not be found. There is kamma, there is the result of kamma, there is the result of deeds that have been done. To say that while wholesome and unwholesome kamma are ripening, this very same one transmigrates, is wrong.

81. Sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā[P 0.0031]. Atthi koci khattiyo hutvā brāhmaṇo hotīti? Āmantā. Sveva khattiyo so brāhmaṇoti[T 0.0043]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

81. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to another world, and from another world to this world? Yes. Is there anyone who, having been a khattiya, becomes a brahmin? Yes. Is that very khattiya that brahmin? This should not be said… and so on.

82. Atthi koci khattiyo hutvā vesso hoti, suddo hotīti? Āmantā. Sveva khattiyo so suddoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

82. Is there anyone who, having been a khattiya, becomes a vessa or a sudda? Yes. Is that very khattiya that sudda? This should not be said… and so on.

83. Atthi koci brāhmaṇo hutvā vesso hoti, suddo hoti, khattiyo hotīti? Āmantā. Sveva brāhmaṇo so khattiyoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

83. Is there anyone who, having been a brahmin, becomes a vessa, a sudda, or a khattiya? Yes. Is that very brahmin that khattiya? This should not be said… and so on.

84. Atthi [M 0.0032] koci vesso hutvā suddo hoti, khattiyo hoti, brāhmaṇo hotīti? Āmantā. Sveva vesso so brāhmaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

84. Is there anyone who, having been a vessa, becomes a sudda, a khattiya, or a brahmin? Yes. Is that very vessa that brahmin? This should not be said… and so on.

85. Atthi koci suddo hutvā khattiyo hoti, brāhmaṇo hoti, vesso hotīti? Āmantā. Sveva suddo so vessoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

85. Is there anyone who, having been a sudda, becomes a khattiya, a brahmin, or a vessa? Yes. Is that very sudda that vessa? This should not be said… and so on.

86. Sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti[V 0.0036]? Āmantā. Hatthacchinno hatthacchinnova hoti, pādacchinno pādacchinnova hoti, hatthapādacchinno hatthapādacchinnova hoti, kaṇṇacchinno… nāsacchinno… kaṇṇanāsacchinno… aṅgulicchinno… aḷacchinno… kaṇḍaracchinno… kuṇihatthako… phaṇahatthako… kuṭṭhiyo… gaṇḍiyo… kilāsiyo… sosiyo… apamāriyo… oṭṭho… goṇo… gadrabho… sūkaro… mahiṃso mahiṃsova hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

86. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world? Yes. Is a person with a severed hand still just a person with a severed hand? Is a person with a severed foot still just a person with a severed foot? Is a person with severed hands and feet still just a person with severed hands and feet? A person with a severed ear… a severed nose… severed ear and nose… a severed finger… a severed thumb… a severed tendon… a crippled hand… a splayed hand… a leper… a person with boils… a person with a skin disease… a consumptive… an epileptic… a camel… an ox… a donkey… a pig… a buffalo still just a buffalo? This should not be said… and so on.

87. Na vattabbaṃ – “sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ loka”nti? Āmantā. Nanu [P 0.0032] sotāpanno puggalo manussalokā cuto devalokaṃ upapanno tatthapi sotāpannova [T 0.0044] hotīti? Āmantā.

87. Should it not be said: ‘That very person transmigrates from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world’? Yes. Is it not so that a stream-enterer, a person who, having passed away from the human world, is reborn in the deva world, is also a stream-enterer there? Yes.

Hañci sotāpanno puggalo manussalokā cuto devalokaṃ upapanno tatthapi sotāpannova hoti, tena vata re vattabbe – “sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ loka”nti.

If indeed a stream-enterer, a person who, having passed away from the human world, is reborn in the deva world, is also a stream-enterer there, then, indeed, it should be said: ‘That very person transmigrates from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world.’

88. Sotāpanno puggalo manussalokā cuto devalokaṃ upapanno tatthapi sotāpannova hotīti katvā tena ca kāraṇena sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Sotāpanno puggalo manussalokā cuto devalokaṃ upapanno tatthapi manusso hotīti katvā? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

88. Is it because a stream-enterer, a person who, having passed away from the human world, is reborn in the deva world, is also a stream-enterer there, that for this reason that very person transmigrates from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world? Yes. Is it because a stream-enterer, a person who, having passed away from the human world, is reborn in the deva world, is also a human there? This should not be said… and so on.

89. Sveva [M 0.0033] puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Anañño avigato sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

89. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world? Yes. Does he transmigrate as not another and unchanged? This should not be said… and so on.

90. Anañño avigato sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Hatthacchinno hatthacchinnova hoti, pādacchinno pādacchinnova hoti, hatthapādacchinno hatthapādacchinnova hoti, kaṇṇacchinno… nāsacchinno… kaṇṇanāsacchinno… aṅgulicchinno… aḷacchinno… kaṇḍaracchinno… kuṇihatthako… phaṇahatthako… kuṭṭhiyo… gaṇḍiyo… kilāsiyo… sosiyo… apamāriyo… oṭṭho… goṇo… gadrabho… sūkaro… mahiṃso mahiṃsova hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

90. Does one transmigrate as not another and unchanged? Yes. Is a person with a severed hand still just a person with a severed hand? Is a person with a severed foot still just a person with a severed foot? Is a person with severed hands and feet still just a person with severed hands and feet? A person with a severed ear… a severed nose… severed ear and nose… a severed finger… a severed thumb… a severed tendon… a crippled hand… a splayed hand… a leper… a person with boils… a person with a skin disease… a consumptive… an epileptic… a camel… an ox… a donkey… a pig… a buffalo still just a buffalo? It should not be said thus… and so on.

91. Sveva [V 0.0037] puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā [T 0.0045] lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Sarūpo sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sarūpo sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

91. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world? Yes. Does one transmigrate with form? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does one transmigrate with form? Yes. Is the life-principle the same as the body? It should not be said thus… and so on.

Savedano…pe… sasañño…pe… sasaṅkhāro…pe… saviññāṇo sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saviññāṇo sandhāvatīti? Āmantā[P 0.0033]. Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does one transmigrate with feeling… and so on… with perception… and so on… with formations… and so on… with consciousness? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does one transmigrate with consciousness? Yes. Is the life-principle the same as the body? It should not be said thus… and so on.

92. Sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Arūpo sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… arūpo sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

92. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world? Yes. Does one transmigrate without form? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does one transmigrate without form? Yes. Is the life-principle one thing and the body another? It should not be said thus… and so on.

Avedano…pe… asañño…pe… asaṅkhāro…pe… aviññāṇo sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… aviññāṇo sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does one transmigrate without feeling… and so on… without perception… and so on… without formations… and so on… without consciousness? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does one transmigrate without consciousness? Yes. Is the life-principle one thing and the body another? It should not be said thus… and so on.

93. Sveva puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… rūpaṃ sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

93. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world? Yes. Does form transmigrate? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does form transmigrate? Yes. Is the life-principle the same as the body? It should not be said thus… and so on.

Vedanā [M 0.0034]…pe… saññā…pe… saṅkhārā…pe… viññāṇaṃ sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… viññāṇaṃ sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does feeling… and so on… perception… and so on… formations… and so on… consciousness transmigrate? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does consciousness transmigrate? Yes. Is the life-principle the same as the body? It should not be said thus… and so on.

94. Sveva [T 0.0046] puggalo sandhāvati asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, parasmā lokā imaṃ lokanti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ na sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… rūpaṃ na sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Aññaṃ [P 0.0034] jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

94. Does that very person transmigrate from this world to the next world, and from the next world to this world? Yes. Does form not transmigrate? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does form not transmigrate? Yes. Is the life-principle one thing and the body another? It should not be said thus… and so on.

Vedanā [V 0.0038] …pe… saññā…pe… saṅkhārā…pe… viññāṇaṃ na sandhāvatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… viññāṇaṃ na sandhāvatīti? Āmantā. Aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe. (Saṃkhittaṃ).

Does feeling… and so on… perception… and so on… formations… and so on… consciousness not transmigrate? It should not be said thus… and so on. Does consciousness not transmigrate? Yes. Is the life-principle one thing and the body another? It should not be said thus. (Abbreviated).

Khandhesu bhijjamānesu, so ce bhijjati puggalo;

Ucchedā bhavati diṭṭhi, yā buddhena vivajjitā.

When the aggregates are breaking up, if that person also breaks up, the view of annihilation arises, which has been rejected by the Buddha.

Khandhesu bhijjamānesu, no ce bhijjati puggalo;

Puggalo sassato hoti, nibbānena samasamoti.

When the aggregates are breaking up, if the person does not break up, the person becomes eternal, exactly the same as Nibbāna.

Gatianuyogo.

The Inquiry into Destinies.

12. Upādāpaññattānuyogo

12. Inquiry into Dependent Designation

95. Rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti? Āmantā? Puggalopi anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno khayadhammo vayadhammo virāgadhammo nirodhadhammo vipariṇāmadhammoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

95. Is a person designated in dependence on form? Yes. Is form impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? Yes. Is the person also impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? It should not be said thus… and so on.

96. Vedanaṃ upādāya… saññaṃ upādāya… saṅkhāre upādāya… viññāṇaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Viññāṇaṃ [T 0.0047] aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti? Āmantā. Puggalopi anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno khayadhammo vayadhammo virāgadhammo nirodhadhammo vipariṇāmadhammoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

96. Is a person designated in dependence on feeling… in dependence on perception… in dependence on formations… in dependence on consciousness? Yes. Is consciousness impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? Yes. Is the person also impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? It should not be said thus… and so on.

97. Rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Nīlaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya nīlakassa [V 0.0039] puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… pītaṃ [P 0.0035] rūpaṃ upādāya… lohitaṃ [M 0.0035] rūpaṃ upādāya… odātaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya… sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya… anidassanaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya… sappaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya… appaṭighaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya appaṭighassa puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

97. Is a person designated in dependence on form? Yes. Is a blue person designated in dependence on blue form? It should not be said thus… and so on. …in dependence on yellow form… in dependence on red form… in dependence on white form… in dependence on visible form… in dependence on invisible form… in dependence on resistant form… is a non-resistant person designated in dependence on non-resistant form? It should not be said thus… and so on.

98. Vedanaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Kusalaṃ vedanaṃ upādāya kusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalaṃ vedanaṃ upādāya kusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Kusalā vedanā saphalā savipākā iṭṭhaphalā kantaphalā manuññaphalā asecanakaphalā sukhudrayā sukhavipākāti? Āmantā. Kusalopi puggalo saphalo savipāko iṭṭhaphalo kantaphalo manuññaphalo asecanakaphalo sukhudrayo sukhavipākoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

98. Is a person designated in dependence on feeling? Yes. Is a wholesome person designated in dependence on wholesome feeling? It should not be said thus… and so on. Is a wholesome person designated in dependence on wholesome feeling? Yes. Are wholesome feelings fruitful, yielding results, having a desirable result, a pleasant result, an agreeable result, a perfectly satisfying result, having a happy consequence, and a happy result? Yes. Is a wholesome person also fruitful, yielding results, having a desirable result, a pleasant result, an agreeable result, a perfectly satisfying result, having a happy consequence, and a happy result? It should not be said thus… and so on.

99. Vedanaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Akusalaṃ [T 0.0048] vedanaṃ upādāya akusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… akusalaṃ vedanaṃ upādāya akusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Akusalā vedanā saphalā savipākā aniṭṭhaphalā akantaphalā [P 0.0036] amanuññaphalā secanakaphalā dukkhudrayā dukkhavipākāti? Āmantā. Akusalopi puggalo saphalo savipāko aniṭṭhaphalo akantaphalo amanuññaphalo secanakaphalo dukkhudrayo dukkhavipākoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

99. Is a person designated in dependence on feeling? Yes. Is an unwholesome person designated in dependence on unwholesome feeling? This should not be said… and so on. Is an unwholesome person designated in dependence on unwholesome feeling? Yes. Are unwholesome feelings fruitful, yielding results, having an undesirable result, an unpleasant result, a disagreeable result, a sullied result, having a painful consequence, and a painful result? Yes. Is an unwholesome person also fruitful, yielding results, having an undesirable result, an unpleasant result, a disagreeable result, a sullied result, having a painful consequence, and a painful result? This should not be said… and so on.

100. Vedanaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Abyākataṃ vedanaṃ upādāya abyākatassa puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… abyākataṃ vedanaṃ upādāya abyākatassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Abyākatā vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā vipariṇāmadhammāti? Āmantā. Abyākatopi puggalo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno khayadhammo vayadhammo virāgadhammo nirodhadhammo vipariṇāmadhammoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

100. Is a person designated in dependence on feeling? Yes. Is an indeterminate person designated in dependence on indeterminate feeling? This should not be said… and so on. Is an indeterminate person designated in dependence on indeterminate feeling? Yes. Are indeterminate feelings impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? Yes. Is an indeterminate person also impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? This should not be said… and so on.

101. Saññaṃ upādāya… saṅkhāre upādāya… viññāṇaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Kusalaṃ viññāṇaṃ upādāya kusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ [V 0.0040] vattabbe…pe… kusalaṃ viññāṇaṃ upādāya kusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Kusalaṃ viññāṇaṃ saphalaṃ savipākaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ kantaphalaṃ manuññaphalaṃ asecanakaphalaṃ [T 0.0049] sukhudrayaṃ sukhavipākanti[M 0.0036]? Āmantā. Kusalopi puggalo saphalo savipāko iṭṭhaphalo kantaphalo manuññaphalo asecanakaphalo sukhudrayo sukhavipākoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

101. Is a person designated in dependence on perception… in dependence on formations… in dependence on consciousness? Yes. Is a wholesome person designated in dependence on wholesome consciousness? This should not be said… and so on. Is a wholesome person designated in dependence on wholesome consciousness? Yes. Is wholesome consciousness fruitful, yielding results, having a desirable result, a pleasant result, an agreeable result, an unsullied result, having a happy consequence, and a happy result? Yes. Is a wholesome person also fruitful, yielding results, having a desirable result, a pleasant result, an agreeable result, an unsullied result, having a happy consequence, and a happy result? This should not be said… and so on.

102. Viññāṇaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Akusalaṃ [P 0.0037] viññāṇaṃ upādāya akusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… akusalaṃ viññāṇaṃ upādāya akusalassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Akusalaṃ viññāṇaṃ saphalaṃ savipākaṃ aniṭṭhaphalaṃ akantaphalaṃ amanuññaphalaṃ secanakaphalaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākanti? Āmantā. Akusalopi puggalo saphalo savipāko aniṭṭhaphalo akantaphalo amanuññaphalo secanakaphalo dukkhudrayo dukkhavipākoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

102. Is a person designated in dependence on consciousness? Yes. Is an unwholesome person designated in dependence on unwholesome consciousness? This should not be said… and so on. Is an unwholesome person designated in dependence on unwholesome consciousness? Yes. Is unwholesome consciousness fruitful, yielding results, having an undesirable result, an unpleasant result, a disagreeable result, a sullied result, having a painful consequence, and a painful result? Yes. Is an unwholesome person also fruitful, yielding results, having an undesirable result, an unpleasant result, a disagreeable result, a sullied result, having a painful consequence, and a painful result? This should not be said… and so on.

103. Viññāṇaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Abyākataṃ viññāṇaṃ upādāya abyākatassa puggalassa paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… abyākataṃ viññāṇaṃ upādāya abyākatassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Abyākataṃ viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhammaṃ vipariṇāmadhammanti? Āmantā. Abyākatopi puggalo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno khayadhammo vayadhammo virāgadhammo nirodhadhammo vipariṇāmadhammoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

103. Is a person designated in dependence on consciousness? Yes. Is an indeterminate person designated in dependence on indeterminate consciousness? This should not be said… and so on. Is an indeterminate person designated in dependence on indeterminate consciousness? Yes. Is indeterminate consciousness impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? Yes. Is an indeterminate person also impermanent, conditioned, dependently arisen, of a nature to be destroyed, of a nature to perish, of a nature to fade away, of a nature to cease, of a nature to change? This should not be said… and so on.

104. Cakkhuṃ upādāya “cakkhumā puggalo”ti vattabboti? Āmantā[T 0.0050]. Cakkhumhi niruddhe “cakkhumā puggalo niruddho”ti vattabboti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sotaṃ upādāya… ghānaṃ upādāya… jivhaṃ upādāya… kāyaṃ [P 0.0038] upādāya… manaṃ upādāya “manavā puggalo”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Manamhi niruddhe “manavā puggalo niruddho”ti vattabboti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

104. In dependence on the eye, should it be said, 'a person is one who has an eye'? Yes. When the eye has ceased, should it be said, 'the person who has an eye has ceased'? This should not be said… and so on. In dependence on the ear… in dependence on the nose… in dependence on the tongue… in dependence on the body… in dependence on the mind, should it be said, 'a person is one who has a mind'? Yes. When the mind has ceased, should it be said, 'the person who has a mind has ceased'? This should not be said.

105. Micchādiṭṭhiṃ upādāya “micchādiṭṭhiyo puggalo”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Micchādiṭṭhiyā niruddhāya “micchādiṭṭhiyo puggalo niruddho”ti vattabboti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe. Micchāsaṅkappaṃ upādāya… micchāvācaṃ upādāya… micchākammantaṃ upādāya… micchāājīvaṃ upādāya [V 0.0041] … micchāvāyāmaṃ upādāya… micchāsatiṃ upādāya… micchāsamādhiṃ upādāya “micchāsamādhiyo puggalo”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Micchāsamādhimhi niruddhe “micchāsamādhiyo puggalo niruddho”ti vattabboti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

105. In dependence on wrong view, should it be said, 'a person is one who has wrong view'? Yes. When wrong view has ceased, should it be said, 'the person who has wrong view has ceased'? This should not be said. In dependence on wrong intention… in dependence on wrong speech… in dependence on wrong action… in dependence on wrong livelihood… in dependence on wrong effort… in dependence on wrong mindfulness… in dependence on wrong concentration, should it be said, 'a person is one who has wrong concentration'? Yes. When wrong concentration has ceased, should it be said, 'the person who has wrong concentration has ceased'? This should not be said.

106. Sammādiṭṭhiṃ [M 0.0037] upādāya “sammādiṭṭhiyo puggalo”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Sammādiṭṭhiyā niruddhāya “sammādiṭṭhiyo puggalo niruddho”ti vattabboti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sammāsaṅkappaṃ upādāya… sammāvācaṃ upādāya… sammākammantaṃ upādāya… sammāājīvaṃ upādāya… sammāvāyāmaṃ upādāya… sammāsatiṃ upādāya… sammāsamādhiṃ [T 0.0051] upādāya “sammāsamādhiyo puggalo”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Sammāsamādhimhi [P 0.0039] niruddhe “sammāsamādhiyo puggalo niruddho”ti vattabboti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

106. In dependence on right view, should it be said, 'a person is one who has right view'? Yes. When right view has ceased, should it be said, 'the person who has right view has ceased'? This should not be said… and so on. In dependence on right intention… in dependence on right speech… in dependence on right action… in dependence on right livelihood… in dependence on right effort… in dependence on right mindfulness… in dependence on right concentration, should it be said, 'a person is one who has right concentration'? Yes. When right concentration has ceased, should it be said, 'the person who has right concentration has ceased'? This should not be said… and so on.

107. Rūpaṃ upādāya, vedanaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ upādāya dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… rūpaṃ upādāya, vedanaṃ upādāya, saññaṃ upādāya, saṅkhāre upādāya, viññāṇaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Pañcannaṃ khandhānaṃ upādāya pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

107. Is a person designated in dependence on form and in dependence on feeling? Yes. In dependence on two aggregates, are two persons designated? This should not be said… and so on. Is a person designated in dependence on form, in dependence on feeling, in dependence on perception, in dependence on formations, and in dependence on consciousness? Yes. In dependence on the five aggregates, are five persons designated? This should not be said… and so on.

108. Cakkhāyatanaṃ upādāya, sotāyatanaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Dvinnaṃ āyatanānaṃ upādāya dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… cakkhāyatanaṃ upādāya, sotāyatanaṃ upādāya…pe… dhammāyatanaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Dvādasannaṃ āyatanānaṃ upādāya dvādasannaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

108. Is there the designation of a person in dependence on the eye-base and in dependence on the ear-base? Yes. In dependence on two bases, is there the designation of two persons? It should not be said thus... Is there the designation of a person in dependence on the eye-base, in dependence on the ear-base... in dependence on the mind-object-base? Yes. In dependence on the twelve bases, is there the designation of twelve persons? It should not be said thus...

109. Cakkhudhātuṃ upādāya, sotadhātuṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Dvinnaṃ dhātūnaṃ upādāya dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… cakkhudhātuṃ upādāya, sotadhātuṃ upādāya…pe… dhammadhātuṃ upādāya [T 0.0052] puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā[P 0.0040]. Aṭṭhārasannaṃ dhātūnaṃ upādāya aṭṭhārasannaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

109. Is there the designation of a person in dependence on the eye-element and in dependence on the ear-element? Yes. In dependence on two elements, is there the designation of two persons? It should not be said thus... Is there the designation of a person in dependence on the eye-element, in dependence on the ear-element... in dependence on the mind-object-element? Yes. In dependence on the eighteen elements, is there the designation of eighteen persons? It should not be said thus...

110. Cakkhundriyaṃ [V 0.0042] upādāya, sotindriyaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Dvinnaṃ indriyānaṃ upādāya dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… cakkhundriyaṃ upādāya, sotindriyaṃ upādāya…pe… aññātāvindriyaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Bāvīsatīnaṃ bāvīsatiyā (?) indriyānaṃ upādāya bāvīsatīnaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

110. Is there the designation of a person in dependence on the eye-faculty and in dependence on the ear-faculty? Yes. In dependence on two faculties, is there the designation of two persons? It should not be said thus... Is there the designation of a person in dependence on the eye-faculty, in dependence on the ear-faculty... in dependence on the faculty of final knowledge? Yes. In dependence on the twenty-two faculties, is there the designation of twenty-two persons? It should not be said thus...

111. Ekavokārabhavaṃ [M 0.0038] upādāya ekassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Catuvokārabhavaṃ upādāya catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… ekavokārabhavaṃ upādāya ekassa puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Pañcavokārabhavaṃ upādāya pañcannaṃ puggalānaṃ paññattīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… ekavokārabhave ekova puggaloti? Āmantā. Catuvokārabhave cattārova cattāro (?) puggalāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… ekavokārabhave ekova puggaloti? Āmantā. Pañcavokārabhave pañceva puggalāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

111. Is there the designation of one person in dependence on the one-constituent existence? Yes. In dependence on the four-constituent existence, is there the designation of four persons? It should not be said thus... Is there the designation of one person in dependence on the one-constituent existence? Yes. In dependence on the five-constituent existence, is there the designation of five persons? It should not be said thus... In the one-constituent existence, is there only one person? Yes. In the four-constituent existence, are there only four persons? It should not be said thus... In the one-constituent existence, is there only one person? Yes. In the five-constituent existence, are there only five persons? It should not be said thus...

112. Yathā [P 0.0041] rukkhaṃ upādāya chāyāya paññatti, evamevaṃ rūpaṃ [T 0.0053] upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? ( ) (āmantā) (?) evaṃ anantaravārattayepi Yathā rukkhaṃ upādāya chāyāya paññatti, rukkhopi anicco chāyāpi aniccā, evamevaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññatti, rūpampi aniccaṃ puggalopi aniccoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… yathā rukkhaṃ upādāya chāyāya paññatti, añño rukkho aññā chāyā, evamevaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññatti, aññaṃ rūpaṃ añño puggaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

112. Just as there is the designation of a shadow in dependence on a tree, so too is there the designation of a person in dependence on form? Yes. Just as there is the designation of a shadow in dependence on a tree—the tree is impermanent and the shadow is also impermanent—so too is there the designation of a person in dependence on form—form is impermanent and the person is also impermanent? It should not be said thus... Just as there is the designation of a shadow in dependence on a tree—the tree is one thing and the shadow is another—so too is there the designation of a person in dependence on form—form is one thing and the person is another? It should not be said thus...

113. Yathā gāmaṃ upādāya gāmikassa paññatti, evamevaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti? Yathā gāmaṃ upādāya gāmikassa paññatti, añño gāmo añño gāmiko, evamevaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññatti, aññaṃ rūpaṃ añño puggaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

113. Just as there is the designation of a villager in dependence on a village, so too is there the designation of a person in dependence on form? Yes. Just as there is the designation of a villager in dependence on a village—the village is one thing and the villager is another—so too is there the designation of a person in dependence on form—form is one thing and the person is another? It should not be said thus...

114. Yathā raṭṭhaṃ upādāya rañño paññatti, evamevaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññattīti[V 0.0043]? Yathā raṭṭhaṃ upādāya rañño paññatti, aññaṃ raṭṭhaṃ añño rājā, evamevaṃ rūpaṃ upādāya puggalassa paññatti, aññaṃ rūpaṃ añño puggaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

114. Just as a king is designated in dependence on a kingdom, is a person designated in dependence on form? Yes. Just as a king is designated in dependence on a kingdom—the kingdom being one thing and the king another—so too is a person designated in dependence on form—form being one thing and the person another? It should not be said so…pe…

115. Yathā na nigaḷo negaḷiko, yassa nigaḷo so negaḷiko, evamevaṃ na rūpaṃ rūpavā, yassa rūpaṃ so rūpavāti? Yathā na nigaḷo negaḷiko, yassa nigaḷo so negaḷiko, añño nigaḷo añño negaḷiko, evamevaṃ na rūpaṃ rūpavā, yassa rūpaṃ so rūpavā, aññaṃ rūpaṃ añño rūpavāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

115. Just as a fetter is not the one fettered, but he who has the fetter is the one fettered, so too is form not the one possessing form, but he who has form is the one possessing form? Yes. Just as a fetter is not the one fettered—the fetter being one thing and the one fettered another—so too is form not the one possessing form—form being one thing and the one possessing form another? It should not be said so…pe…

116. Citte [M 0.0039] citte puggalassa paññattīti? Āmantā. Citte [T 0.0054] citte puggalo jāyati jīyati mīyati cavati upapajjatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ soti vā aññoti vāti? Āmantā[P 0.0042]. Dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ kumārakoti vā kumārikāti vāti? Vattabbaṃ.

116. Is a person designated with every mind-moment? Yes. Is a person born, does he age, die, pass away, and get reborn with every mind-moment? It should not be said so…pe… When a second mind-moment has arisen, should it not be said, 'He is the same' or 'He is another'? Yes. When a second mind-moment has arisen, should it not be said, 'He is a boy' or 'She is a girl'? It should be said.

Ājānāhi niggahaṃ. Hañci dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – “soti vā aññoti vā,” tena vata re vattabbe – “dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – ‘kumārakoti vā kumārikāti vā’”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – soti vā aññoti vā, dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – kumārakoti vā kumārikāti vā’”ti micchā.

Acknowledge the refutation. If, when a second mind-moment has arisen, it should not be said, 'He is the same' or 'He is another,' then indeed it should be said, 'When a second mind-moment has arisen, it should not be said, "He is a boy" or "She is a girl."' The statement you make—that 'it should be said, "When a second mind-moment has arisen, it should not be said, ‘He is the same’ or ‘He is another,’" and "When a second mind-moment has arisen, it should be said, ‘He is a boy’ or ‘She is a girl’"'—is wrong.

Hañci vā pana dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – “kumārakoti vā kumārikā”ti vā, tena vata re vattabbe – “dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – ‘soti vā aññoti vā’”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – soti vā aññoti vā, dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – kumārakoti vā kumārikāti vā’”ti micchā.

If, however, when a second mind-moment has arisen, it should be said, 'He is a boy' or 'She is a girl,' then indeed it should be said, 'When a second mind-moment has arisen, it should be said, "He is the same person" or "He is another person."' The statement you make—that 'it should be said: "When a second mind-moment has arisen, it should not be said, ‘He is the same person’ or ‘He is another person,’" and "When a second mind-moment has arisen, it should be said, ‘He is a boy’ or ‘She is a girl’"'—is wrong.

117. Dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – “soti vā aññoti vā”ti? Āmantā. Dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – “itthīti vā purisoti vā gahaṭṭhoti vā pabbajitoti vā devoti vā manussoti vā”ti? Vattabbaṃ.

117. When a second mind-moment has arisen, should it not be said, 'He is the same or another'? Yes. When a second mind-moment has arisen, should it not be said, 'a woman' or 'a man', 'a householder' or 'one gone forth', 'a deva' or 'a human being'? It should be said.

Ājānāhi [V 0.0044] niggahaṃ. Hañci dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – “soti vā aññoti vā,” tena vata re vattabbe – “dutiye citte [T 0.0055] uppanne na vattabbaṃ – ‘devoti vā manussoti vā’”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – soti vā aññoti vā, dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – devoti vā manussoti vā’”ti micchā.

Acknowledge the refutation. If, when a second consciousness arises, it should not be said, 'It is the same or another,' then it should indeed be said, 'When a second consciousness arises, it should not be said, “It is a deva or a human being.”' That which you stated there—'It should indeed be said: “When a second consciousness arises, it should not be said, ‘It is the same or another,’ but when a second consciousness arises, it should be said, ‘It is a deva or a human being’”'—is wrong.

Hañci vā pana dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – “devoti vā manussoti vā,” tena vata re vattabbe – “dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – ‘soti vā aññoti vā’”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘dutiye citte uppanne na vattabbaṃ – soti vā aññoti vā, dutiye citte uppanne vattabbaṃ – devoti vā manussoti vā’”ti micchā…pe….

Or if, when a second consciousness arises, it should be said, 'It is a deva or a human being,' then it should indeed be said, 'When a second consciousness arises, it should be said, “It is the same or another.”' That which you stated there—'It should indeed be said: “When a second consciousness arises, it should not be said, ‘It is the same or another,’ but when a second consciousness arises, it should be said, ‘It is a deva or a human being’”'—is wrong… and so on.

118. Na [M 0.0040] vattabbaṃ – “puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenā”ti? Āmantā. Nanu [P 0.0043] yo passati yaṃ passati yena passati, so passati taṃ passati tena passatīti? Āmantā. Hañci yo passati yaṃ passati yena passati, so passati taṃ passati tena passati; tena vata re vattabbe – “puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenā”ti.

118. Should it not be said, 'A person is found in a real and ultimate sense'? Yes. Is it not so that the one who sees, what one sees, and with what one sees—that very one sees that very thing with that very instrument? Yes. If the one who sees, what one sees, and with what one sees—that very one sees that very thing with that very instrument, then it should indeed be said, 'A person is found in a real and ultimate sense.'

119. Na vattabbaṃ – “puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenā”ti? Āmantā. Nanu yo suṇāti…pe… yo ghāyati… yo sāyati… yo phusati… yo vijānāti yaṃ vijānāti yena vijānāti, so vijānāti taṃ vijānāti tena vijānātīti? Āmantā. Hañci yo vijānāti yaṃ vijānāti yena vijānāti, so vijānāti taṃ vijānāti tena vijānāti; tena vata re vattabbe – “puggalo upalabbhati [T 0.0056] saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenā”ti.

119. Should it not be said, 'A person is found in a real and ultimate sense'? Yes. Is it not so that the one who hears… and so on… who smells… who tastes… who touches… who cognizes, what one cognizes, and with what one cognizes—that very one cognizes that very thing with that very instrument? Yes. If the one who cognizes, what one cognizes, and with what one cognizes—that very one cognizes that very thing with that very instrument, then it should indeed be said, 'A person is found in a real and ultimate sense.'

120. Puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti? Āmantā. Nanu yo na passati yaṃ na passati yena na passati, so na passati taṃ na passati tena na passatīti? Āmantā. Hañci yo na passati yaṃ na passati yena na passati, so na passati taṃ na passati tena na passati; no ca vata re vattabbe – “puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenā”ti.

120. Is a person found in a real and ultimate sense? Yes. Is it not so that the one who does not see, what one does not see, and with what one does not see—that very one does not see that very thing with that very instrument? Yes. If the one who does not see, what one does not see, and with what one does not see—that very one does not see that very thing with that very instrument, then it should not be said, 'A person is found in a real and ultimate sense.'

Puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti? Āmantā. Nanu yo na suṇāti…pe… yo [V 0.0045] na ghāyati… yo na sāyati… yo na phusati… yo na vijānāti yaṃ na vijānāti yena na vijānāti, so na vijānāti taṃ na vijānāti tena na vijānātīti? Āmantā. Hañci yo na vijānāti yaṃ na vijānāti yena na vijānāti, so na vijānāti taṃ na vijānāti tena na vijānāti; no ca vata re [P 0.0044] vattabbe – “puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenā”ti.

Is a person found in a real and ultimate sense? Yes. Is it not so that the one who does not hear… and so on… who does not smell… who does not taste… who does not touch… who does not cognize, what one does not cognize, and with what one does not cognize—that very one does not cognize that very thing with that very instrument? Yes. If the one who does not cognize, what one does not cognize, and with what one does not cognize—that very one does not cognize that very thing with that very instrument, then it should not be said, 'A person is found in a real and ultimate sense.'

121. Na vattabbaṃ – “puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenā”ti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “passāmahaṃ, bhikkhave, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmī”ti ma. ni. 1.213 thokaṃ visadisaṃ! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti.

121. Should it not be said, 'A person is found in a real and ultimate sense'? Yes. But has not the Blessed One said: 'Bhikkhus, with the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human, I see beings passing away and being reborn—inferior and superior, of good and bad appearance, in good and bad destinations—and I know beings who fare according to their kamma'? Is there not such a sutta? Yes. In that case, a person is found in a real and ultimate sense.

122. Vuttaṃ [M 0.0041] bhagavatā – “passāmahaṃ, bhikkhave, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte cavamāne upapajjamāne [T 0.0057] hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmī”ti katvā teneva kāraṇena puggalo upalabbhati saccikaṭṭhaparamatthenāti? Āmantā. Bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena rūpaṃ passati puggalaṃ passatīti? Rūpaṃ passati. Rūpaṃ puggalo, rūpaṃ cavati, rūpaṃ upapajjati, rūpaṃ yathākammūpaganti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

122. Is it because the Blessed One has said, 'Bhikkhus, with the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human… I know beings who fare according to their kamma,' that for this very reason a person is found in a real and ultimate sense? Yes. With the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human, does the Blessed One see form or does he see a person? He sees form. Is form a person? Does form pass away? Is form reborn? Does form fare according to its kamma? It should not be said thus.

Bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena rūpaṃ passati puggalaṃ passatīti? Puggalaṃ passati. Puggalo rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ rūpadhātu nīlaṃ pītakaṃ lohitakaṃ odātaṃ cakkhuviññeyyaṃ cakkhusmiṃ paṭihaññati, cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

With the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human, does the Blessed One see form or does he see a person? He sees a person. Is a person form, the form-base, the form-element? Is a person blue, yellow, red, or white? Is a person cognizable by eye-consciousness, does a person impinge on the eye, does a person come into the range of the eye? It should not be said thus.

Bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena rūpaṃ passati puggalaṃ passatīti? Ubho passati. Ubho rūpaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ rūpadhātu, ubho nīlā, ubho pītakā, ubho lohitakā, ubho odātā, ubho cakkhuviññeyyā, ubho [P 0.0045] cakkhusmiṃ paṭihaññanti, ubho [V 0.0046] cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, ubho cavanti, ubho upapajjanti, ubho yathākammūpagāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe.

With the divine eye, which is purified and surpasses the human, does the Blessed One see form or does he see a person? He sees both. Are both form, the form-base, and the form-element? Are both blue, yellow, red, and white? Are both cognizable by eye-consciousness? Do both impinge on the eye? Do both come into the range of the eye? Do both pass away? Are both reborn? Do both fare according to their kamma? It should not be said thus.

Upādāpaññattānuyogo.

The Exposition on Derived Designation.

13. Purisakārānuyogo

13. The Exposition on Human Action

123. Kalyāṇapāpakāni kammāni upalabbhantīti? Āmantā. Kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

123. Are wholesome and unwholesome kammas found? Yes. Is a doer or an instigator of wholesome and unwholesome kammas found? It should not be said thus… and so on.

124. Kalyāṇapāpakāni kammāni upalabbhantīti, kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ [T 0.0058] kammānaṃ kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Āmantā. Tassa kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

124. Since wholesome and unwholesome kammas are found, is a doer or an instigator of wholesome and unwholesome kammas also found? Yes. Is a doer and an instigator of that one found? It should not be said thus… and so on.

125. Tassa kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Āmantā. Tassa tasseva natthi dukkhassa antakiriyā, natthi vaṭṭupacchedo, natthi anupādāparinibbānanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

125. Is a doer and instigator of that [doer and instigator] apprehended? Yes. For that very one, is there no making an end of suffering, no cutting off of the round of existence, no final Nibbāna without clinging? It should not be said thus…

126. Kalyāṇapāpakāni [M 0.0042] kammāni upalabbhantīti, kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Āmantā. Puggalo upalabbhatīti, puggalassa kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

126. Given that wholesome and unwholesome kamma are apprehended, is a doer or instigator of wholesome and unwholesome kamma apprehended? Yes. Given that a person is apprehended, is a doer or instigator of a person apprehended? It should not be said thus…

127. Kalyāṇapāpakāni kammāni upalabbhantīti, kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Āmantā. Nibbānaṃ upalabbhatīti, nibbānassa kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Na [P 0.0046] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

127. Given that wholesome and unwholesome kamma are apprehended, is a doer or instigator of wholesome and unwholesome kamma apprehended? Yes. Given that Nibbāna is apprehended, is a doer or instigator of Nibbāna apprehended? It should not be said thus…

128. Kalyāṇapāpakāni kammāni upalabbhantīti, kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ kattā kāretā [V 0.0047] upalabbhatīti? Āmantā. Mahāpathavī upalabbhatīti, mahāpathaviyā kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

128. Given that wholesome and unwholesome kamma are apprehended, is a doer or instigator of wholesome and unwholesome kamma apprehended? Yes. Given that the great earth is apprehended, is a doer or instigator of the great earth apprehended? It should not be said thus…

129. Kalyāṇapāpakāni kammāni upalabbhantīti, kalyāṇapāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Āmantā. Mahāsamuddo upalabbhatīti, mahāsamuddassa kattā kāretā upalabbhatīti? Na [T 0.0059] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

129. Given that wholesome and unwholesome kamma are apprehended, is a doer or instigator of wholesome and unwholesome kamma apprehended? Yes. Given that the great ocean is apprehended, is a doer or instigator of the great ocean apprehended? It should not be said thus…
