Atthāyasmato sāriputtassa dibbacakkhunti? Āmantā. Nanu āyasmā sāriputto etadavoca –

Does the Venerable Sāriputta have the divine eye? Yes. But did not the Venerable Sāriputta say this:

“Neva [T 0.0281] pubbenivāsāya, napi dibbassa cakkhuno;

Cetopariyāya iddhiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā;

Cutiyā upapattiyā, paṇidhi me na vijjatī”ti theragā. 996 theragāthāyaṃ.

“Neither for the recollection of past lives, nor for the divine eye, nor for the knowledge of the minds of others, nor for psychic power, nor for the purification of the hearing element, nor for [the knowledge of] passing away and rebirth—is there any aspiration in me.”

Attheva [P 0.0258][V 0.0216] suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “yathākammūpagataṃ ñāṇaṃ dibbacakkhu”nti.

Is there indeed such a discourse? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said, 'The knowledge of how beings fare according to their deeds is the divine eye.'

Yathākammūpagatañāṇakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on the Knowledge of How Beings Fare According to Their Deeds is concluded.

3. Tatiyavaggo

3. The Third Chapter

(30) 10. Saṃvarakathā

(30) 10. Discourse on Restraint

379. Atthi devesu saṃvaroti? Āmantā. Atthi devesu asaṃvaroti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

379. Is there restraint among the devas? Yes. Is there non-restraint among the devas? It should not be said so... and so on.

Natthi devesu asaṃvaroti? Āmantā. Natthi devesu saṃvaroti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there no non-restraint among the devas? Yes. Is there no restraint among the devas? It should not be said so... and so on.

Nanu [M 0.0195] asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaroti? Āmantā. Atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is it not so that virtue is restraint from non-restraint, and is there restraint among the devas? Yes. Is there non-restraint among the devas, from which non-restraint, virtue is restraint? It should not be said so... and so on.

Ājānāhi niggahaṃ. Hañci asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro, tena vata re vattabbe – “atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīla”nti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho – ‘asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīla’”nti micchā.

Acknowledge the refutation. If indeed virtue is restraint from non-restraint, and there is restraint among the devas, then indeed it should be said, 'There is non-restraint among the devas, from which non-restraint, virtue is restraint.' That which you say there—that it should be said, 'Virtue is restraint from non-restraint; there is restraint among the devas,' but not, 'There is non-restraint among the devas, from which non-restraint, virtue is restraint'—is wrong.

No [T 0.0282] ce pana vattabbe – “atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīla”nti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro”ti. Yaṃ tattha vadesi – “vattabbe kho ‘asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīlaṃ, atthi devesu saṃvaro,’ no ca vattabbe – ‘atthi devesu asaṃvaro, yamhā asaṃvarā saṃvaro sīla’”nti micchā.

But if it should not be said, 'There is non-restraint among the devas, from which non-restraint, virtue is restraint,' then indeed it should not be said, 'Virtue is restraint from non-restraint; there is restraint among the devas.' That which you say there—that it should be said, 'Virtue is restraint from non-restraint; there is restraint among the devas,' but not, 'There is non-restraint among the devas, from which non-restraint, virtue is restraint'—is wrong.

Atthi [P 0.0259][V 0.0217] manussesu saṃvaro, atthi tattha asaṃvaroti? Āmantā. Atthi devesu saṃvaro, atthi tattha asaṃvaroti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there restraint among humans, and is there non-restraint there? Yes. Is there restraint among the devas, and is there non-restraint there? It should not be said so... and so on.

Atthi devesu saṃvaro, natthi tattha asaṃvaroti? Āmantā. Atthi manussesu saṃvaro, natthi tattha asaṃvaroti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there restraint among the devas, and is there no non-restraint there? Yes. Is there restraint among humans, and is there no non-restraint there? It should not be said so... and so on.

380. Atthi devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇīti? Āmantā. Atthi devesu pāṇātipātoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

380. Is there abstinence from the destruction of living beings among the devas? Yes. Is there destruction of living beings among the devas? It should not be said so... and so on.

Atthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇīti? Āmantā. Atthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there abstinence from liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among the devas? Yes. Are there liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among the devas? It should not be said so... and so on.

Natthi devesu pāṇātipātoti? Āmantā. Natthi devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there no destruction of living beings among the devas? Yes. Is there no abstinence from the destruction of living beings among the devas? It should not be said so... and so on.

Natthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti? Āmantā. Natthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Are there no liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among the devas? Yes. Is there no abstinence from liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among the devas? It should not be said so... and so on.

Atthi manussesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, atthi tattha pāṇātipātoti[T 0.0283]? Āmantā. Atthi devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, atthi tattha pāṇātipātoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there abstinence from the destruction of living beings among humans, and is there destruction of living beings there? Yes. Is there abstinence from the destruction of living beings among the devas, and is there destruction of living beings there? This should not be said... and so on.

Atthi [M 0.0196] manussesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti? Āmantā. Atthi devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, atthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there abstinence from liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among humans, and are there such intoxicants there? Yes. Is there abstinence from liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among the devas, and are there such intoxicants there? This should not be said... and so on.

Atthi [P 0.0260] devesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, natthi tattha pāṇātipātoti? Āmantā. Atthi manussesu pāṇātipātā veramaṇi, natthi tattha pāṇātipātoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there abstinence from the destruction of living beings among the devas, and is there no destruction of living beings there? Yes. Is there abstinence from the destruction of living beings among humans, and is there no destruction of living beings there? This should not be said... and so on.

Atthi [V 0.0218] devesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, natthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti? Āmantā. Atthi manussesu surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇi, natthi tattha surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there abstinence from liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among the devas, and are there no such intoxicants there? Yes. Is there abstinence from liquor, wine, and other intoxicants, which are a basis for heedlessness, among humans, and are there no such intoxicants there? This should not be said... and so on.

Natthi devesu saṃvaroti? Āmantā. Sabbe devā pāṇātipātino adinnādāyino kāmesumicchācārino musāvādino surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyinoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… tena hi atthi devesu saṃvaroti.

Is there no restraint among the devas? Yes. Are all devas destroyers of living beings, takers of what is not given, committers of sexual misconduct, speakers of falsehood, and consumers of liquor, wine, and other intoxicants which are a basis for heedlessness? This should not be said... and so on. Therefore, there is restraint among the devas.

Saṃvarakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Restraint is concluded.

3. Tatiyavaggo

3. The Third Chapter

(31) 11. Asaññakathā

3. (31) 11. Discourse on the Non-percipient

381. Asaññasattesu [T 0.0284] saññā atthīti? Āmantā. Saññābhavo saññāgati saññāsattāvāso saññāsaṃsāro saññāyoni saññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there perception among non-percipient beings? Yes. Is that a becoming with perception, a destination with perception, an abode of percipient beings, a round of existence with perception, a realm of origin with perception, a gaining of a state of being with perception? This should not be said... and so on.

Nanu asaññabhavo asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Hañci asaññabhavo asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe – “asaññasattesu saññā atthī”ti.

381. Is it not a becoming without perception, a destination without perception, an abode of non-percipient beings, a round of existence without perception, a realm of origin without perception, a gaining of a state of being without perception? Yes. If it is a becoming without perception, a destination without perception, an abode of non-percipient beings, a round of existence without perception, a realm of origin without perception, a gaining of a state of being without perception, then it should not be said, 'There is perception among non-percipient beings.'

Asaññasattesu [M 0.0197] saññā atthīti? Āmantā[P 0.0261]. Pañcavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there perception among non-percipient beings? Yes. Is that a five-constituent existence, a destination, an abode of beings, a round of existence, a realm of origin, an acquisition of individuality? This should not be said... and so on.

Nanu ekavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā[V 0.0219]. Hañci ekavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe – “asaññasattesu saññā atthī”ti.

Is it not a one-constituent existence, a destination, an abode of beings, a round of existence, a realm of origin, the gaining of individual existence? Yes. If it is a one-constituent existence, a destination, an abode of beings, a round of existence, a realm of origin, the gaining of individual existence, then it should not be said, 'There is perception among non-percipient beings.'

Asaññasattesu saññā atthīti? Āmantā. Tāya saññāya saññākaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there perception among non-percipient beings? Yes. By that perception, does one perform the function of perception? This should not be said... and so on.

382. Manussesu saññā atthi, so ca saññābhavo saññāgati saññāsattāvāso [T 0.0285] saññāsaṃsāro saññāyoni saññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Asaññasattesu saññā atthi, so ca saññābhavo saññāgati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Among humans, is there perception, and is that a becoming with perception, a destination with perception, an abode of percipient beings, a round of existence with perception, a realm of origin with perception, a gaining of a state of being with perception? Yes. Among non-percipient beings, is there perception, and is that a becoming with perception, a destination with perception, an abode of beings, a round of existence, a realm of origin, a gaining of individual existence? This should not be said... and so on.

Manussesu saññā atthi, so ca pañcavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Asaññasattesu saññā atthi, so ca pañcavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

382. Among humans, is there perception, and is that a five-constituent existence, a destination, an abode of beings, a round of existence, a realm of origin, an acquisition of individuality? Yes. Among non-percipient beings, is there perception, and is that a five-constituent existence, a destination, an abode of beings, a round of existence, a realm of origin, an acquisition of individuality? This should not be said... and so on.

Manussesu saññā atthi, tāya saññāya saññākaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Asaññasattesu saññā atthi, tāya saññāya saññākaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Among humans, is there perception, and by that perception, does one perform the function of perception? Yes. Among non-percipient beings, is there perception, and by that perception, does one perform the function of perception? This should not be said... and so on.

Asaññasattesu saññā atthi, so ca asaññabhavo asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Manussesu [P 0.0262] saññā atthi, so ca asaññabhavo asaññagati…pe… asaññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Among non-percipient beings, is there perception, and is that a becoming without perception, a destination without perception, an abode of non-percipient beings, a round of existence without perception, a realm of origin without perception, a gaining of a state of being without perception? Yes. Among humans, is there perception, and is that a becoming without perception, a destination without perception... and so on... a gaining of a state of being without perception? This should not be said... and so on.

Asaññasattesu saññā atthi, so ca ekavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Manussesu saññā atthi, so ca ekavokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Among non-percipient beings, is there perception, and is that a one-constituent existence, a destination, an abode of beings, a round of existence, a realm of origin, an acquisition of individuality? Yes. Among humans, is there perception, and is that a one-constituent existence, a destination... and so on... an acquisition of individuality? This should not be said... and so on.

Asaññasattesu [M 0.0198] saññā atthi, na ca tāya saññāya saññākaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Manussesu saññā atthi, na ca tāya saññāya saññākaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Among non-percipient beings, is there perception, and yet by that perception one does not perform the function of perception? Yes. Among humans, is there perception, and yet by that perception one does not perform the function of perception? This should not be said... and so on.

383. Na vattabbaṃ – “asaññasattesu saññā atthī”ti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “santi, bhikkhave, asaññasattā nāma devā; saññuppādā ca pana te devā tamhā kāyā cavantī”ti dī. ni. 1.68! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi asaññasattesu saññā atthīti.

Should it not be said, 'There is perception among non-percipient beings'? Yes. But has it not been said by the Blessed One: 'Monks, there are devas called non-percipient beings; and with the arising of perception, those devas pass away from that plane'? Is there indeed such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, there is perception among non-percipient beings.

Asaññasattesu [T 0.0286][V 0.0220] saññā atthīti? Kiñci kañci (syā.) kāle atthi, kiñci kāle natthīti. Kiñci kāle saññasattā kiñci kāle asaññasattā, kiñci kāle saññabhavo kiñci kāle asaññabhavo, kiñci kāle pañcavokārabhavo kiñci kāle ekavokārabhavoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

383. Is there perception among non-percipient beings? At some times there is, at other times there is not. At some times are they percipient beings, at other times non-percipient beings; at some times is it a becoming with perception, at other times a becoming without perception; at some times a five-constituent existence, at other times a one-constituent existence? This should not be said... and so on.

Asaññasattesu saññā kiñci kāle atthi, kiñci kāle natthīti? Āmantā. Kaṃ kālaṃ atthi, kaṃ kālaṃ natthīti? Cutikāle upapattikāle atthi, ṭhitikāle natthīti. Cutikāle upapattikāle saññasattā, ṭhitikāle asaññasattā; cutikāle upapattikāle saññabhavo, ṭhitikāle asaññabhavo; cutikāle upapattikāle pañcavokārabhavo, ṭhitikāle ekavokārabhavoti? Na [P 0.0263] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there perception among non-percipient beings at some times and not at others? Yes. At what time is there perception, and at what time is there not? At the time of decease and rebirth there is perception; during the period of continuance there is not. At the time of decease and rebirth are they percipient beings; during the period of continuance non-percipient beings. At the time of decease and rebirth is it a becoming with perception; during the period of continuance a becoming without perception. At the time of decease and rebirth is it a five-constituent existence; during the period of continuance a one-constituent existence? This should not be said... and so on.

Asaññakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on the Non-percipient is concluded.

3. Tatiyavaggo

3. The Third Chapter

(32) 12. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakathā

(32) 12. Discourse on the Sphere of Neither Perception Nor Non-Perception

384. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane [T 0.0287] na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti? Āmantā. Asaññabhavo [V 0.0221] asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

384. Is it not to be said that in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, 'perception exists'? Yes. Is that a non-percipient existence, a non-percipient destination, an abode of non-percipient beings, a non-percipient round of rebirth, a non-percipient birth, an attainment of a non-percipient individual existence? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nanu [M 0.0199] saññābhavo saññāgati saññāsattāvāso saññāsaṃsāro saññāyoni saññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Hañci saññābhavo saññāgati…pe… saññattabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe – “nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – ‘saññā atthī’”ti.

Is it not a percipient existence, a percipient destination, an abode of percipient beings, a percipient round of rebirth, a percipient birth, an attainment of a percipient individual existence? Yes. If it is a percipient existence, a percipient destination… and so on… an attainment of a percipient individual existence, then it is not right to say, 'In the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, “Perception exists.”'

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti? Āmantā. Ekavokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is it not to be said that in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, 'perception exists'? Yes. Is that a one-constituent existence, a destination… and so on… an attainment of individual existence? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nanu catuvokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Hañci catuvokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe – “nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – ‘saññā atthī’”ti.

Is it not a four-constituent existence, a destination… and so on… an attainment of individual existence? Yes. If it is a four-constituent existence, a destination… and so on… an attainment of individual existence, then it is not right to say, 'In the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, “Perception exists.”'

385. Asaññasattesu na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthi”, so ca asaññabhavo asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthi,” so ca asaññabhavo asaññagati asaññasattāvāso asaññasaṃsāro asaññayoni asaññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti[T 0.0288]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

385. Regarding non-percipient beings, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a non-percipient existence, a non-percipient destination, an abode of non-percipient beings, a non-percipient round of rebirth, a non-percipient birth, an attainment of a non-percipient individual existence? Yes. Regarding the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a non-percipient existence, a non-percipient destination, an abode of non-percipient beings, a non-percipient round of rebirth, a non-percipient birth, an attainment of a non-percipient individual existence? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Asaññasattesu na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthi,” so ca ekavokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane [P 0.0264] na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthi,” so ca ekavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Regarding non-percipient beings, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a one-constituent existence, a destination… and so on… an attainment of individual existence? Yes. Regarding the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a one-constituent existence, a destination, an abode of beings, a round of rebirth, a birth, an attainment of individual existence? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthi,” so ca saññābhavo saññāgati…pe… saññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Asaññasattesu na vattabbaṃ – “saññā [V 0.0222] atthi,” so ca saññābhavo saññāgati…pe… saññattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Regarding the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a percipient existence, a percipient destination… and so on… an attainment of a percipient individual existence? Yes. Regarding non-percipient beings, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a percipient existence, a percipient destination… and so on… an attainment of a percipient individual existence? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthi,” so ca catuvokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Asaññasattesu na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthi,” so ca catuvokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Regarding the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a four-constituent existence, a destination… and so on… an attainment of individual existence? Yes. Regarding non-percipient beings, it is not to be said, 'Perception exists'; and is that a four-constituent existence, a destination… and so on… an attainment of individual existence? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane [M 0.0200] na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti? Āmantā. Nanu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavoti? Āmantā. Hañci nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, no ca vata re vattabbe – “nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – ‘saññā atthī’”ti.

Is it not to be said that in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, 'perception exists'? Yes. Is not the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception a four-constituent existence? Yes. If the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence, then it is not right to say, 'In the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, “Perception exists.”'

386. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo nevasaññānāsaññāyatane [T 0.0289] na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti? Āmantā. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo ākāsānañcāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

386. The sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence; in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, is it not to be said, 'perception exists'? Yes. The sphere of infinite space is a four-constituent existence; in the sphere of infinite space, is it not to be said, 'perception exists'? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti? Āmantā. Viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, ākiñcaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

The sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence; in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, is it not to be said, 'perception exists'? Yes. The sphere of infinite consciousness… and so on… the sphere of nothingness is a four-constituent existence; in the sphere of nothingness, is it not to be said, 'perception exists'? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ [P 0.0265] catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Āmantā. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

The sphere of infinite space is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? Yes. The sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Āmantā. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

The sphere of infinite consciousness… and so on… the sphere of nothingness is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? Yes. The sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane [V 0.0223] na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti vā “natthī”ti vāti? Āmantā[T 0.0290]. Nanu nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavoti? Āmantā. Hañci nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, no ca vata re vattabbe – “nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – ‘saññā atthī’ti vā ‘natthī’ti vā”ti.

Is it not to be said that in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, 'perception exists' or 'does not exist'? Yes. Is not the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception a four-constituent existence? Yes. If the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence, then it is not right to say, 'In the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said, “Perception exists” or “does not exist.”'

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti vā “natthī”ti vāti? Āmantā. Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ…pe… viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, ākiñcaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti vā “natthī”ti vāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

The sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence; in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, is it not to be said, 'perception exists' or 'does not exist'? Yes. The sphere of infinite space… and so on… the sphere of infinite consciousness… and so on… the sphere of nothingness is a four-constituent existence; in the sphere of nothingness, is it not to be said, 'perception exists' or 'does not exist'? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ [M 0.0201] catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Āmantā. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

The sphere of infinite space is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? Yes. The sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Āmantā. Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ catuvokārabhavo, atthi tattha saññāti? Na [P 0.0266] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

The sphere of infinite consciousness… and so on… the sphere of nothingness is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? Yes. The sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception is a four-constituent existence; is there perception there? It is not to be said thus… and so on….

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatane vattabbaṃ (?) – “saññā atthī”ti vā “natthī”ti vāti? Āmantā. Nanu nevasaññānāsaññāyatananti? Āmantā. Hañci nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe – “nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – ‘saññā atthī’ti vā ‘natthī’ti vā”ti.

Is it not to be said that in the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, 'perception exists' or 'does not exist'? Yes. Is it not the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception? Yes. If it is the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, then indeed it is to be said: 'In the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, it is not to be said: “Perception exists” or “does not exist.”'

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatananti katvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatane na vattabbaṃ – “saññā atthī”ti vā “natthī”ti vāti? Āmantā. Adukkhamasukhā vedanāti katvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya adukkhamasukhā vedanā (sī. ka.) na vattabbaṃ – “vedanā”ti vā “avedanā”ti vāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking it as the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception, should it not be said of the sphere of neither-perception-nor-non-perception: 'There is perception' or 'There is no perception'? Yes. Taking it as feeling that is neither-painful-nor-pleasant, should it not be said of feeling that is neither-painful-nor-pleasant: 'It is feeling' or 'It is not feeling'? It should not be said thus… and so on.

Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanakathā niṭṭhitā.

The discussion on the Sphere of Neither-Perception-Nor-Non-Perception is concluded.

Tatiyavaggo.

The Third Chapter.

Tassuddānaṃ –

The summary:

Balaṃ [T 0.0291][V 0.0224] sādhāraṇaṃ ariyaṃ, sarāgaṃ cittaṃ vimuccati;

Vimuttaṃ vimuccamānaṃ, atthi cittaṃ vimuccamānaṃ.

Strength, common, noble; the mind with lust is liberated; the liberated, the one being liberated; there is a mind being liberated.

Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa, diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ pahīnaṃ;

Aṭṭhamakassa puggalassa, natthi pañcindriyāni cakkhuṃ.

For the eighth person, the obsession with views is abandoned; for the eighth person, the five faculties and the eye faculty are not present.

Sotaṃ dhammupatthaddhaṃ, yathākammūpagataṃ ñāṇaṃ;

Devesu saṃvaro asañña-sattesu saññā evameva bhavagganti.

The ear supported by the Dhamma; knowledge of beings' destination according to their kamma; restraint among devas; perception in non-percipient beings; and likewise up to the peak of existence.

4. Catutthavaggo

The Fourth Chapter

(33) 1. Gihissa arahātikathā

(33) 1. Discussion on Whether a Householder Can Be an Arahant

387. Gihissa [M 0.0202][P 0.0267] arahāti? Āmantā. Atthi arahato gihisaṃyojananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… natthi arahato gihisaṃyojananti? Āmantā. Hañci natthi arahato gihisaṃyojanaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “gihissa arahā”ti.

Is a householder an Arahant? Yes. Does an Arahant have the fetter of the household life? That should not be said… and so on. Does an Arahant not have the fetter of the household life? Yes. If an Arahant does not have the fetter of the household life, then it should certainly not be said: ‘A householder is an Arahant.’

Gihissa arahāti? Āmantā. Nanu arahato gihisaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammanti? Āmantā. Hañci arahato gihisaṃyojanaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṅkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “gihissa arahā”ti.

Is a householder an Arahant? Yes. But surely, has not the fetter of the household life been abandoned by an Arahant, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, brought to non-existence, and is of a nature not to arise in the future? Yes. If the fetter of the household life has been abandoned by an Arahant, cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, brought to non-existence, and is of a nature not to arise in the future, then it should certainly not be said: ‘A householder is an Arahant.’

Gihissa arahāti? Āmantā. Atthi koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ [T 0.0292] appahāya diṭṭheva dhamme [V 0.0225] dukkhassantakaroti ma. ni. 2.186? Natthi. Hañci natthi koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro, no ca vata re vattabbe – “gihissa arahā”ti.

4. Is a householder an Arahant? Yes. Is there any householder who, without abandoning the fetter of the household life, makes an end of suffering in this very life? No. If there is no householder who, without abandoning the fetter of the household life, makes an end of suffering in this very life, then it should certainly not be said: ‘A householder is an Arahant.’

Gihissa arahāti? Āmantā. Nanu vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – “atthi nu kho, bho gotama, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaro”ti? “Natthi kho, vaccha, koci gihī gihisaṃyojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaro”ti. Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā[P 0.0268]. Tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “gihissa arahā”ti.

Is a householder an Arahant? Yes. But surely, did not the wanderer Vacchagotta say this to the Blessed One: ‘Venerable Gotama, is there any householder who, without abandoning the fetter of the household life, makes an end of suffering after the breakup of the body?’ ‘Vaccha, there is no householder who, without abandoning the fetter of the household life, makes an end of suffering after the breakup of the body.’ Is there such a sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said: ‘A householder is an Arahant.’

Gihissa arahāti? Āmantā. Arahā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, methunaṃ uppādeyya, puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvaseyya, kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhaveyya, mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāreyya, jātarūparajataṃ sādiyeyya, ajeḷakaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, kukkuṭasūkaraṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, hatthigavassavaḷavaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, tittiravaṭṭakamorakapiñjaraṃ … kapiñjalaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.) paṭiggaṇheyya, cittavaṇḍavālamoḷiṃ pītavaṇṭavālamoḷikaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.) dhāreyya, odātāni vatthāni dīghadasāni dhāreyya, yāvajīvaṃ agāriyabhūto assāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

387. Is a householder an Arahant? Yes. Would an Arahant engage in sexual intercourse, initiate sexual intercourse, dwell in a bed crowded with children, enjoy Kāsi sandalwood, wear garlands, perfumes, and ointments, accept gold and silver, receive goats and sheep, receive chickens and pigs, receive elephants, cattle, horses, and mares, receive francolins, quails, peacocks, and partridges, wear a painted headband and a topknot, wear white robes with long fringes, and remain a householder for life? That should not be said… and so on.

Na [M 0.0203] vattabbaṃ – “gihissa arahā”ti? Āmantā. Nanu yaso kulaputto, uttiyo gahapati, setu māṇavo, gihibyañjanena arahattaṃ pattoti? Āmantā. Hañci yaso kulaputto, uttiyo gahapati, setu māṇavo, gihibyañjanena arahattaṃ [T 0.0293] patto, tena vata re vattabbe – “gihissa arahā”ti.

Should it not be said: ‘A householder is an Arahant’? Yes. But surely, did not Yasa the clansman, Uttiya the householder, and Setu the young man attain Arahantship while in the guise of a householder? Yes. If Yasa the clansman, Uttiya the householder, and Setu the young man attained Arahantship while in the guise of a householder, then it should certainly be said: ‘A householder is an Arahant.’

Gihissa arahātikathā niṭṭhitā.

The discussion on whether a householder can be an Arahant is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

The Fourth Chapter

(34) 2. Upapattikathā

(34) 2. Discussion on Rebirth

388. Saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Saha upapattiyā sotāpanno hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Is one a Stream-enterer simultaneously with rebirth? That should not be said… and so on.

Saha [V 0.0226] upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā[P 0.0269]. Saha upapattiyā sakadāgāmī hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Is one a Once-returner simultaneously with rebirth? That should not be said… and so on.

Saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Saha upapattiyā anāgāmī hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

4. Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Is one a Non-returner simultaneously with rebirth? That should not be said… and so on.

Saha upapattiyā sotāpanno na hotīti? Āmantā. Hañci saha upapattiyā sotāpanno na hoti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “saha upapattiyā arahā”ti.

Is one not a Stream-enterer simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. If one is not a Stream-enterer simultaneously with rebirth, then it should certainly not be said: ‘One is an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth.’

Saha upapattiyā sakadāgāmī na hotīti? Āmantā. Hañci saha upapattiyā sakadāgāmī na hoti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “saha upapattiyā arahā”ti.

388. Is one not a Once-returner simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. If one is not a Once-returner simultaneously with rebirth, then it should certainly not be said: ‘One is an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth.’

Saha upapattiyā anāgāmī na hotīti? Āmantā. Hañci [T 0.0294] saha upapattiyā anāgāmī na hoti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “saha upapattiyā arahā”ti.

Is one not a Non-returner simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. If one is not a Non-returner simultaneously with rebirth, then it should certainly not be said: ‘One is an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth.’

389. Saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Sāriputto thero saha upapattiyā arahāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe. Mahāmoggallāno thero [M 0.0204] …pe… mahākassapo thero…pe… mahākaccāno thero…pe… mahākoṭṭhiko thero…pe… mahāpanthako thero saha upapattiyā arahāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Was the Elder Sāriputta an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? That should not be said. Was the Elder Mahāmoggallāna… and so on… the Elder Mahākassapa… and so on… the Elder Mahākaccāna… and so on… the Elder Mahākoṭṭhika… and so on… the Elder Mahāpanthaka an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? That should not be said… and so on.

Sāriputto thero na saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Hañci sāriputto thero na saha upapattiyā arahā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “saha upapattiyā arahā”ti.

Was the Elder Sāriputta not an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. If the Elder Sāriputta was not an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth, then it should certainly not be said: ‘One is an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth.’

Mahāmoggallāno thero…pe… mahākassapo thero…pe… mahākaccāno thero…pe… mahākoṭṭhiko thero…pe… mahāpanthako thero na saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Hañci [P 0.0270] mahāpanthako thero na saha upapattiyā arahā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “saha upapattiyā arahā”ti.

Was the Elder Mahāmoggallāna… and so on… the Elder Mahākassapa… and so on… the Elder Mahākaccāna… and so on… the Elder Mahākoṭṭhika… and so on… the Elder Mahāpanthaka not an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. If the Elder Mahāpanthaka was not an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth, then it should certainly not be said: ‘One is an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth.’

390. Saha [V 0.0227] upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Upapattesiyena cittena arahattaṃ sacchikaroti lokiyena sāsavena…pe… saṃkilesiyenāti[T 0.0295]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Does one realize Arahantship with the rebirth-linking consciousness, which is worldly, with taints… and so on… subject to defilement? That should not be said… and so on.

Saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ niyyānikaṃ khayagāmī bodhagāmī apacayagāmī anāsavaṃ…pe… asaṃkilesiyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Is the rebirth-linking consciousness liberating, leading to destruction, leading to enlightenment, leading to the wearing away [of defilements], taintless… (and so on)… undefiled? That should not be said… (and so on).

Nanu upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ na khayagāmi na bodhagāmi na apacayagāmi sāsavaṃ…pe… saṃkilesiyanti? Āmantā. Hañci upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ na khayagāmi na bodhagāmi na apacayagāmi sāsavaṃ…pe… saṃkilesiyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “saha upapattiyā arahā”ti.

But surely, is the rebirth-linking consciousness not liberating, not leading to destruction, not leading to enlightenment, not leading to the wearing away [of defilements], with taints… (and so on)… defiled? Yes. If the rebirth-linking consciousness is not liberating, not leading to destruction, not leading to enlightenment, not leading to the wearing away [of defilements], with taints… (and so on)… defiled, then it should certainly not be said: ‘One is an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth.’

Saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Upapattesiyena cittena rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati, anottappaṃ pajahatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Does one abandon lust, hatred, delusion, and lack of moral dread with the rebirth-linking consciousness? That should not be said… (and so on).

Saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ maggo… satipaṭṭhānaṃ…pe… sammappadhānaṃ… iddhipādo… indriyaṃ… balaṃ… bojjhaṅgoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Is the rebirth-linking consciousness the path… the foundations of mindfulness… (and so on)… the right efforts… the bases for spiritual power… the spiritual faculties… the spiritual powers… the factors of enlightenment? That should not be said… (and so on).

Saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Upapattesiyena cittena dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na [M 0.0205] hevaṃ vattabbe …pe… saha upapattiyā arahāti? Āmantā. Cuticittaṃ [P 0.0271] maggacittaṃ upapattesiyaṃ cittaṃ phalacittanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Does one fully understand suffering, abandon its origin, realize its cessation, and develop the path with the rebirth-linking consciousness? That should not be said… (and so on). Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes. Is the deceasing consciousness the path-consciousness, and the rebirth-linking consciousness the fruition-consciousness? That should not be said… (and so on).

Upapattikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion on Rebirth is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter

(35) 3. Anāsavakathā

4. (35) 3. The Discourse on the Taintless

391. Arahato [T 0.0296][V 0.0228] sabbe dhammā anāsavāti? Āmantā. Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmimaggo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmimaggo anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattamaggo arahattaphalaṃ, satipaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānaṃ iddhipādo indriyaṃ balaṃ bojjhaṅgoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Are all phenomena of an Arahant taintless? Yes. Are they the path, the fruition, Nibbāna, the path of stream-entry, the fruition of stream-entry, the path of once-returning, the fruition of once-returning, the path of non-returning, the fruition of non-returning, the path of Arahantship, the fruition of Arahantship, the foundations of mindfulness, the right strivings, the bases of spiritual power, the spiritual faculties, the spiritual powers, the factors of awakening? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Arahato sabbe dhammā anāsavāti? Āmantā. Arahato cakkhuṃ anāsavanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe…. Arahato cakkhuṃ anāsavanti? Āmantā. Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ…pe… bojjhaṅgoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

391. Are all phenomena of an Arahant taintless? Yes. Is the eye of an Arahant taintless? It should not be said so… (and so on). Is the eye of an Arahant taintless? Yes. Is it the path, the fruition, Nibbāna, the path of stream-entry, the fruition of stream-entry… (and so on)… the factors of awakening? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Arahato sotaṃ…pe… arahato ghānaṃ… arahato jivhā… arahato kāyo anāsavoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe …pe… arahato kāyo anāsavoti? Āmantā. Maggo phalaṃ nibbānaṃ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṃ…pe… bojjhaṅgoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the ear of an Arahant… (and so on)… is the nose of an Arahant… is the tongue of an Arahant… is the body of an Arahant taintless? It should not be said so… (and so on). Is the body of an Arahant taintless? Yes. Is it the path, the fruition, Nibbāna, the path of stream-entry, the fruition of stream-entry… (and so on)… the factors of awakening? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Arahato kāyo anāsavoti? Āmantā. Arahato kāyo paggahaniggahupago chedanabhedanupago kākehi gijjhehi kulalehi sādhāraṇoti? Āmantā. Anāsavo [P 0.0272] dhammo paggahaniggahupago chedanabhedanupago kākehi gijjhehi kulalehi sādhāraṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe [T 0.0297]…pe….

Is the body of an Arahant taintless? Yes. Is the body of an Arahant subject to being taken up and put down, to cutting and breaking, common to crows, vultures, and hawks? Yes. Is a taintless phenomenon subject to being taken up and put down, to cutting and breaking, common to crows, vultures, and hawks? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Arahato kāye visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti? Āmantā. Anāsave dhamme visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Can poison, a weapon, or fire affect the body of an Arahant? Yes. Can poison, a weapon, or fire affect a taintless phenomenon? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Labbhā [M 0.0206] arahato kāyo addubandhanena bandhituṃ, rajjubandhanena bandhituṃ, saṅkhalikabandhanena bandhituṃ, gāmabandhanena bandhituṃ, nigamabandhanena bandhituṃ, nagarabandhanena bandhituṃ, janapadabandhanena bandhituṃ[V 0.0229], kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitunti? Āmantā. Labbhā anāsavo dhammo addubandhanena bandhituṃ, rajjubandhanena bandhituṃ, saṅkhalikabandhanena bandhituṃ, gāmanigamanagarajanapadabandhanena bandhituṃ, kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitunti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Can the body of an Arahant be bound with strong bonds, with a rope, with chains, with village-bonds, with town-bonds, with city-bonds, with country-bonds, or with the five-fold bonds? Yes. Can a taintless phenomenon be bound with strong bonds, with a rope, with chains, with the bonds of a village, town, city, and country, or with the five-fold bonds? It should not be said so… (and so on).

392. Yadi arahā puthujjanassa cīvaraṃ deti, anāsavaṃ hutvā sāsavaṃ hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… anāsavaṃ hutvā sāsavaṃ hotīti? Āmantā. Taññeva anāsavaṃ taṃ sāsavanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… taññeva anāsavaṃ taṃ sāsavanti? Āmantā. Maggo anāsavo hutvā sāsavo hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… phalaṃ… satipaṭṭhānaṃ… sammappadhānaṃ… iddhipādo… indriyaṃ… balaṃ… bojjhaṅgo anāsavo hutvā sāsavo hotīti? Na [P 0.0273] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

If an Arahant gives a robe to a worldling, does what is taintless become tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on). Does what is taintless become tainted? Yes. Is that very thing which is taintless the same as that which is tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on). Is that very thing which is taintless the same as that which is tainted? Yes. Does the path, being taintless, become tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on). Does the fruition… the foundations of mindfulness… the right strivings… the bases of spiritual power… the spiritual faculties… the spiritual powers… the factors of awakening, being taintless, become tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Yadi arahā puthujjanassa piṇḍapātaṃ deti, senāsanaṃ deti[T 0.0298], gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ deti, anāsavo hutvā sāsavo hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… anāsavo hutvā sāsavo hotīti? Āmantā. Taññeva anāsavaṃ taṃ sāsavanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… taññeva anāsavaṃ taṃ sāsavanti? Āmantā. Maggo anāsavo hutvā sāsavo hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… phalaṃ… satipaṭṭhānaṃ… sammappadhānaṃ… iddhipādo… indriyaṃ… balaṃ… bojjhaṅgo anāsavo hutvā sāsavo hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

392. If an Arahant gives almsfood to a worldling, gives lodging, gives medicines and requisites for the sick, does what is taintless become tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on). Does what is taintless become tainted? Yes. Is that very thing which is taintless the same as that which is tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on). Is that very thing which is taintless the same as that which is tainted? Yes. Does the path, being taintless, become tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on). Does the fruition… the foundations of mindfulness… the right strivings… the bases of spiritual power… the spiritual faculties… the spiritual powers… the factors of awakening, being taintless, become tainted? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Yadi puthujjano arahato cīvaraṃ deti, sāsavaṃ hutvā anāsavaṃ hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sāsavaṃ hutvā anāsavaṃ hotīti? Āmantā. Taññeva sāsavaṃ taṃ anāsavanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… taññeva sāsavaṃ taṃ anāsavanti? Āmantā. Rāgo sāsavo hutvā anāsavo hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… doso…pe… moho…pe… anottappaṃ sāsavaṃ hutvā anāsavaṃ hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

If a worldling gives a robe to an Arahant, does what is tainted become taintless? It should not be said so… (and so on). Does what is tainted become taintless? Yes. Is that very thing which is tainted the same as that which is taintless? It should not be said so… (and so on). Is that very thing which is tainted the same as that which is taintless? Yes. Does lust, being tainted, become taintless? It should not be said so… (and so on). Does hatred… (and so on)… does delusion… (and so on)… does lack of moral dread, being tainted, become taintless? It should not be said so… (and so on).

Yadi puthujjano arahato piṇḍapātaṃ deti, senāsanaṃ deti, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ deti, sāsavo hutvā anāsavo hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sāsavo hutvā anāsavo hotīti? Āmantā. Taññeva [P 0.0274] sāsavaṃ taṃ anāsavanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… taññeva sāsavaṃ [M 0.0207] taṃ anāsavanti? Āmantā. Rāgo sāsavo hutvā anāsavo [V 0.0230] hotīti[T 0.0299]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… doso…pe… moho…pe… anottappaṃ sāsavaṃ hutvā anāsavaṃ hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

If a worldling gives almsfood to an Arahant, gives lodging, gives medicines and requisites for the sick, does it, being an object for the taints, become not an object for the taints? It should not be said so…and so on. Does it, being an object for the taints, become not an object for the taints? Yes. Is that very thing which is an object for the taints the same as that which is not an object for the taints? It should not be said so…and so on. Is that very thing which is an object for the taints the same as that which is not an object for the taints? Yes. Does lust, being an object for the taints, become not an object for the taints? It should not be said so…and so on. Does hatred…and so on…does delusion…and so on…does lack of moral dread, being an object for the taints, become not an object for the taints? It should not be said so…and so on.

Na vattabbaṃ – “arahato sabbe dhammā anāsavā”ti? Āmantā. Nanu arahā anāsavoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahā anāsavo, tena vata re vattabbe – “arahato sabbe dhammā anāsavā”ti.

Should it not be said, 'All phenomena of an Arahant are free from the taints'? Yes. Is not the Arahant free from the taints? Yes. If the Arahant is free from the taints, then indeed it should be said, 'All phenomena of an Arahant are free from the taints.'

Anāsavakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Freedom from the Taints is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter

(36) 4. Samannāgatakathā

4. (36) 4. Discourse on Being Endowed

393. Arahā catūhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā catūhi phassehi catūhi vedanāhi catūhi saññāhi catūhi cetanāhi catūhi cittehi catūhi saddhāhi catūhi vīriyehi catūhi satīhi catūhi samādhīhi catūhi paññāhi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is an Arahant endowed with the four fruits? Yes. Is an Arahant endowed with four contacts, four feelings, four perceptions, four volitions, four consciousnesses, four faiths, four energies, four mindfulnesses, four concentrations, and four wisdoms? It should not be said so… and so on.

Anāgāmī tīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmī tīhi phassehi…pe… tīhi paññāhi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

393. Is a Non-returner endowed with the three fruits? Yes. Is a Non-returner endowed with three contacts… and so on… with three wisdoms? It should not be said so… and so on.

Sakadāgāmī dvīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmī dvīhi phassehi…pe… dvīhi paññāhi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a Once-returner endowed with the two fruits? Yes. Is a Once-returner endowed with two contacts… and so on… with two wisdoms? It should not be said so… and so on.

Arahā [P 0.0275] sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā [T 0.0300] sotāpanno sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṅkolo, ekabījīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… arahā sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe [V 0.0231] …pe… arahā anāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā anāgāmī, antarāparinibbāyī, upahaccaparinibbāyī, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Is an Arahant a stream-enterer, one who at most returns seven times, a family-to-family traverser, or one with a single seed? It should not be said so… and so on. Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of once-returning? Yes. Is an Arahant a once-returner? It should not be said so… and so on. Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of non-returning? Yes. Is an Arahant a non-returner, one who attains Nibbāna in the interval, one who attains Nibbāna upon impact, one who attains Nibbāna without exertion, one who attains Nibbāna with exertion, or one who goes upstream to the Akaniṭṭha realm? It should not be said so… and so on.

Anāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmī sotāpanno sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṅkolo, ekabījīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe [M 0.0208]…pe… anāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmī sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a Non-returner endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Is a Non-returner a stream-enterer, one who at most returns seven times, a family-to-family traverser, or one with a single seed? It should not be said so… and so on. Is a Non-returner endowed with the fruition of once-returning? Yes. Is a Non-returner a once-returner? It should not be said so… and so on.

Sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmī sotāpanno sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṅkolo, ekabījīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a Once-returner endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Is a Once-returner a stream-enterer, one who at most returns seven times, a family-to-family traverser, or one with a single seed? It should not be said so… and so on.

394. Sotāpattiphalena samannāgato “sotāpanno”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Arahā sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva arahā, so sotāpannoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruition of stream-entry be called a 'stream-enterer'? Yes. Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Is that very Arahant then a stream-enterer? It should not be said so… and so on.

Sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgato “sakadāgāmī”ti vattabboti? Āmantā[P 0.0276]. Arahā sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva arahā, so sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

394. Should one endowed with the fruition of once-returning be called a 'once-returner'? Yes. Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of once-returning? Yes. Is that very Arahant then a once-returner? It should not be said so… and so on.

Anāgāmiphalena samannāgato “anāgāmī”ti vattabboti? Āmantā[T 0.0301]. Arahā anāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva arahā, so anāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruition of non-returning be called a 'non-returner'? Yes. Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of non-returning? Yes. Is that very Arahant then a non-returner? It should not be said so… and so on.

Sotāpattiphalena samannāgato “sotāpanno”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Anāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva anāgāmī, so sotāpannoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruition of stream-entry be called a 'stream-enterer'? Yes. Is a Non-returner endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Is that very Non-returner then a stream-enterer? It should not be said so… and so on.

Sakadāgāmiphalena [V 0.0232] samannāgato “sakadāgāmī”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Anāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva anāgāmī, so sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruition of once-returning be called a 'once-returner'? Yes. Is a Non-returner endowed with the fruition of once-returning? Yes. Is that very Non-returner then a once-returner? It should not be said so… and so on.

Sotāpattiphalena samannāgato “sotāpanno”ti vattabboti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva sakadāgāmī, so sotāpannoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruition of stream-entry be called a 'stream-enterer'? Yes. Is a Once-returner endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Is that very Once-returner then a stream-enterer? It should not be said so… and so on.

395. Arahā sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu arahā sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahā sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahā sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Has not an Arahant transcended the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. If an Arahant has transcended the fruition of stream-entry, then it should not be said, 'An Arahant is endowed with the fruition of stream-entry.'

Arahā [M 0.0209] sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā [P 0.0277] sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ rāgaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ dosaṃ, apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

395. Has an Arahant transcended the fruition of stream-entry and is he endowed with it? Yes. Has an Arahant transcended the path of stream-entry, identity view, doubt, adherence to rites and rituals, passion leading to the lower realms, aversion leading to the lower realms, and delusion leading to the lower realms, and is he endowed with that path? It should not be said so… and so on.

Arahā sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu [T 0.0302] arahā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahā sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of once-returning? Yes. Has not an Arahant transcended the fruition of once-returning? Yes. If an Arahant has transcended the fruition of once-returning, then it should not be said, 'An Arahant is endowed with the fruition of once-returning.'

Arahā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā sakadāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ, oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Has an Arahant transcended the fruition of once-returning and is he endowed with it? Yes. Has an Arahant transcended the path of once-returning, gross sensual desire, and gross ill will, and is he endowed with that path? It should not be said so… and so on.

Arahā anāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu arahā anāgāmiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahā anāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahā anāgāmiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is an Arahant endowed with the fruition of non-returning? Yes. Has not an Arahant transcended the fruition of non-returning? Yes. If an Arahant has transcended the fruition of non-returning, then it should not be said, 'An Arahant is endowed with the fruition of non-returning.'

Arahā [V 0.0233] anāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā anāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ, aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Has an Arahant transcended the fruition of non-returning and is he endowed with it? Yes. Has an Arahant transcended the path of non-returning, subtle sensual desire, and subtle ill will, and is he endowed with it? This should not be said… and so on.

Anāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu anāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci anāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “anāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is a Non-returner endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Has a Non-returner not transcended the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. If a Non-returner has transcended the fruition of stream-entry, then it should not be said, 'A Non-returner is endowed with the fruition of stream-entry.'

Anāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā[T 0.0303][P 0.0278]. Anāgāmī sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ…pe… apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Has a Non-returner transcended the fruition of stream-entry and is he endowed with it? Yes. Has a Non-returner transcended the path of stream-entry, identity view… and so on… delusion leading to the lower realms, and is he endowed with it? This should not be said… and so on.

Anāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu anāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci anāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “anāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is a Non-returner endowed with the fruition of once-returning? Yes. Has a Non-returner not transcended the fruition of once-returning? Yes. If a Non-returner has transcended the fruition of once-returning, then it should not be said: “A Non-returner is endowed with the fruition of once-returning.”

Anāgāmī [M 0.0210] sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmī sakadāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ, oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Has a Non-returner transcended the fruition of once-returning and is he endowed with it? Yes. Has a Non-returner transcended the path of once-returning, gross sensual desire, and gross ill will, and is he endowed with it? This should not be said… and so on.

Sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is a Once-returner endowed with the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. Has a Once-returner not transcended the fruition of stream-entry? Yes. If a Once-returner has transcended the fruition of stream-entry, then it should not be said: “A Once-returner is endowed with the fruition of stream-entry.”

Sakadāgāmī sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmī sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ…pe… apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Has a Once-returner transcended the fruition of stream-entry and is he endowed with it? Yes. Has a Once-returner transcended the path of stream-entry, identity view… and so on… delusion leading to the lower realms, and is he endowed with it? This should not be said… and so on.

396. Na [V 0.0234] vattabbaṃ – “arahā catūhi phalehi samannāgato”ti? Āmantā[T 0.0304]. Nanu arahatā cattāri phalāni paṭiladdhāni, tehi ca aparihīnoti? Āmantā[P 0.0279]. Hañci arahatā cattāri phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe – “arahā catūhi phalehi samannāgato”ti.

396. Should it not be said: “An Arahant is endowed with the four fruits”? Yes. Has an Arahant not attained the four fruits, and is without loss from them? Yes. If an Arahant has attained the four fruits and is without loss from them, then indeed it should be said: “An Arahant is endowed with the four fruits.”

Na vattabbaṃ – “anāgāmī tīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti? Āmantā. Nanu anāgāminā tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni, tehi ca aparihīnoti? Āmantā. Hañci anāgāminā tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe – “anāgāmī tīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti.

Should it not be said: “A Non-returner is endowed with the three fruits”? Yes. Has a Non-returner not attained the three fruits, and is without loss from them? Yes. If a Non-returner has attained the three fruits and is without loss from them, then indeed it should be said: “A Non-returner is endowed with the three fruits.”

Na vattabbaṃ – “sakadāgāmī dvīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti? Āmantā. Nanu sakadāgāminā dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni, tehi ca aparihīnoti? Āmantā. Hañci sakadāgāminā dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe – “sakadāgāmī dvīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti.

Should it not be said: “A Once-returner is endowed with the two fruits”? Yes. Has a Once-returner not attained the two fruits, and is without loss from them? Yes. If a Once-returner has attained the two fruits and is without loss from them, then indeed it should be said: “A Once-returner is endowed with the two fruits.”

Arahatā cattāri phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti, arahā catūhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahatā cattāro maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, arahā catūhi maggehi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Since an Arahant has attained the four fruits and is without loss from them, is an Arahant endowed with the four fruits? Yes. Since an Arahant has attained the four paths and is without loss from them, is an Arahant endowed with the four paths? This should not be said… and so on.

Anāgāminā tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti, anāgāmī tīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāminā [T 0.0305] tayo [M 0.0211] maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, anāgāmī tīhi maggehi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Since a Non-returner has attained the three fruits and is without loss from them, is a Non-returner endowed with the three fruits? Yes. Since a Non-returner has attained the three paths and is without loss from them, is a Non-returner endowed with the three paths? This should not be said… and so on.

Sakadāgāminā dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti, sakadāgāmī dvīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāminā [P 0.0280] dve maggā paṭiladdhā, tehi ca aparihīnoti, sakadāgāmī dvīhi maggehi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Since a Once-returner has attained the two fruits and is without loss from them, is a Once-returner endowed with the two fruits? Yes. Since a Once-returner has attained the two paths and is without loss from them, is a Once-returner endowed with the two paths? This should not be said… and so on.

Samannāgatakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion on Being Endowed is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter.

(37) 5. Upekkhāsamannāgatakathā

(37) 5. The Discussion on Being Endowed with Equanimity

397. Arahā [V 0.0235] chahi upekkhāhi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā chahi phassehi, chahi vedanāhi, chahi saññāhi…pe… chahi paññāhi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

397. Is an Arahant endowed with six kinds of equanimity? Yes. Is an Arahant endowed with six kinds of contacts, six kinds of feelings, six kinds of perceptions… up to six kinds of wisdom? This should not be said… and so on.

Arahā chahi upekkhāhi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahā cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanto sotena saddaṃ suṇāti, ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati, jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati, kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusati, manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti…pe… manasā dhammaṃ vijānanto cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, sotena saddaṃ suṇāti, ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyati, jivhāya rasaṃ sāyati, kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is an Arahant endowed with six kinds of equanimity? Yes. Does an Arahant, while seeing a form with the eye, hear a sound with the ear, smell an odor with the nose, taste a flavor with the tongue, feel a touch with the body, and cognize a phenomenon with the mind… and while cognizing a phenomenon with the mind, see a form with the eye, hear a sound with the ear, smell an odor with the nose, taste a flavor with the tongue, and feel a touch with the body? This should not be said… and so on.

Arahā chahi upekkhāhi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Satataṃ [T 0.0306] samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ chahi upekkhāhi samannāgato samohito samāhito (syā.), cha upekkhāyo paccupaṭṭhitāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is an Arahant endowed with six kinds of equanimity? Yes. Is an Arahant constantly, continuously, uninterruptedly endowed with six kinds of equanimity, absorbed, with the six equanimities present? This should not be said… and so on.

Na vattabbaṃ – “arahā chahi upekkhāhi samannāgato”ti? Āmantā. Nanu arahā chaḷaṅgupekkhoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahā chaḷaṅgupekkho, tena vata re vattabbe – “arahā chahi upekkhāhi samannāgato”ti…pe….

Should it not be said, 'An Arahant is endowed with six kinds of equanimity'? Yes. But is not an Arahant one who possesses six-factored equanimity? Yes. If an Arahant possesses six-factored equanimity, then indeed it should be said, 'An Arahant is endowed with six kinds of equanimity'… and so on.

Upekkhāsamannāgatakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion on Being Endowed with Equanimity is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter.

(38) 6. Bodhiyā buddhotikathā

(38) 6. The Discussion on 'Buddha through Enlightenment'

398. Bodhiyā [M 0.0212][P 0.0281] buddhoti? Āmantā. Bodhiyā niruddhāya vigatāya paṭipassaddhāya abuddho hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

398. Is one a Buddha through enlightenment? Yes. When enlightenment has ceased, vanished, and subsided, is one no longer a Buddha? This should not be said… and so on.

Bodhiyā [V 0.0236] buddhoti? Āmantā. Atītāya bodhiyā buddhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atītāya bodhiyā buddhoti? Āmantā. Tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through enlightenment? Yes. Is one a Buddha through past enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on. Is one a Buddha through past enlightenment? Yes. Does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? Yes. Through that enlightenment, does one fully understand suffering, abandon the origin, realize cessation, and develop the path? That should not be said… and so on.

Bodhiyā buddhoti? Āmantā. Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddhoti[T 0.0307]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through enlightenment? Yes. Is one a Buddha through future enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddhoti? Āmantā. Tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through future enlightenment? Yes. Does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? Yes. Through that enlightenment, does one fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? That should not be said… and so on.

Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na [P 0.0282] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, and does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? Yes. Is one a Buddha through past enlightenment, and does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Āmantā. Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, and through that enlightenment does one fully understand suffering, abandon the origin, realize cessation, and develop the path? Yes. Is one a Buddha through past enlightenment, and through that enlightenment does one fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? That should not be said… and so on.

Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, and does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? Yes. Is one a Buddha through future enlightenment, and does one perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Paccuppannāya [M 0.0213] bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti[V 0.0237]? Āmantā. Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, and through that enlightenment does one fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? Yes. Is one a Buddha through future enlightenment, and through that enlightenment does one fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? That should not be said… and so on.

Atītāya [T 0.0308] bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through past enlightenment, yet does not perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? Yes. Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, yet does not perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Āmantā. Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through past enlightenment, yet through that enlightenment does not fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? Yes. Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, yet through that enlightenment does not fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? That should not be said… and so on.

Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Āmantā. Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā bodhikaraṇīyaṃ karotīti? Na [P 0.0283] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through future enlightenment, yet does not perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? Yes. Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, yet does not perform what should be done for enlightenment through that enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Āmantā. Paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddho, na ca tāya bodhiyā dukkhaṃ parijānāti…pe… maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through future enlightenment, yet through that enlightenment does not fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? Yes. Is one a Buddha through present enlightenment, yet through that enlightenment does not fully understand suffering… and so on… and develop the path? That should not be said… and so on.

399. Atītāya bodhiyā buddho, anāgatāya bodhiyā buddho, paccuppannāya bodhiyā buddhoti? Āmantā. Tīhi bodhīhi buddhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

399. Is one a Buddha through past enlightenment, through future enlightenment, and through present enlightenment? Yes. Is one a Buddha through three enlightenments? That should not be said… and so on.

Tīhi bodhīhi buddhoti? Āmantā. Satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ tīhi bodhīhi samannāgato samohito, tisso bodhiyo paccupaṭṭhitāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through the three enlightenments? Yes. Is one constantly, continuously, and uninterruptedly endowed with and absorbed in the three enlightenments; are the three enlightenments present? That should not be said… and so on.

Na [T 0.0309] vattabbaṃ – “bodhiyā buddho”ti? Āmantā. Nanu bodhipaṭilābhā buddhoti? Āmantā. Hañci bodhipaṭilābhā buddho, tena vata re vattabbe – “bodhiyā buddho”ti.

Should it not be said, 'One is a Buddha through enlightenment'? Yes. But is not one a Buddha through the attainment of enlightenment? Yes. If one is a Buddha through the attainment of enlightenment, then indeed it should be said, 'One is a Buddha through enlightenment.'

Bodhipaṭilābhā [V 0.0238] buddhoti, bodhiyā buddhoti? Āmantā. Bodhipaṭilābhā bodhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is one a Buddha through the attainment of enlightenment, and is one a Buddha through enlightenment? Yes. Is the attainment of enlightenment enlightenment? That should not be said… and so on.

Bodhiyā buddhotikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on 'Buddha through Enlightenment' is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter

(39) 7. Lakkhaṇakathā

4. (39) 7. Discourse on the Marks

400. Lakkhaṇasamannāgato [M 0.0214] bodhisattoti? Āmantā. Padesalakkhaṇehi samannāgato padesabodhisattoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a Bodhisatta endowed with the marks? Yes. Is one endowed with partial marks a partial Bodhisatta? That should not be said… and so on.

Lakkhaṇasamannāgato bodhisattoti? Āmantā[P 0.0284]. Tibhāgalakkhaṇehi samannāgato tibhāgabodhisattoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

400. Is a Bodhisatta endowed with the marks? Yes. Is one endowed with one-third of the marks a one-third Bodhisatta? That should not be said… and so on.

Lakkhaṇasamannāgato bodhisattoti? Āmantā. Upaḍḍhalakkhaṇehi samannāgato upaḍḍhabodhisattoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a Bodhisatta endowed with the marks? Yes. Is one endowed with half the marks a half-Bodhisatta? That should not be said… and so on.

Lakkhaṇasamannāgato bodhisattoti? Āmantā. Cakkavattisatto lakkhaṇasamannāgato, cakkavattisatto bodhisattoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a Bodhisatta endowed with the marks? Yes. Is a being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch, who is endowed with the marks, a Bodhisatta? That should not be said… and so on.

Cakkavattisatto lakkhaṇasamannāgato, cakkavattisatto bodhisattoti? Āmantā. Yādiso bodhisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā dhammakkhānaṃ [T 0.0310] dhammadesanā, tādiso cakkavattisattassa pubbayogo pubbacariyā dhammakkhānaṃ dhammadesanāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch, who is endowed with the marks, a Bodhisatta? Yes. Are the previous striving, previous conduct, proclamation of the Dhamma, and teaching of the Dhamma of a being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch the same as those of a Bodhisatta? That should not be said… and so on.

401. Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti pacchā manussā dī. ni. 2.27; ma. ni. 3.205 vuttaṃ dissāya pucchati, evamevaṃ [V 0.0239] cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti pacchā manussāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Just as when a Bodhisatta is being born, devas receive him first and humans afterwards, even so when a being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch is being born, do devas receive him first and humans afterwards? That should not be said… and so on.

Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti – “attamanā, devi, hohi! Mahesakkho te putto uppanno”ti, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa cattāro naṃ devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti – “attamanā, devi, hohi! Mahesakkho te putto uppanno”ti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

401. Just as when a Bodhisatta is being born, four devaputtas, having received him, place him before his mother, saying, ‘Rejoice, O queen! A son of great power has been born to you,’ even so when a being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch is being born, do four devaputtas, having received him, place him before his mother, saying, ‘Rejoice, O queen! A son of great power has been born to you’? That should not be said… and so on.

Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti – ekā sītassa, ekā uṇhassa – yena bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu ca, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa [P 0.0285] jāyamānassa dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti – ekā sītassa, ekā uṇhassa – yena [M 0.0215] cakkavattisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātu cāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….
