Just as when a Bodhisatta is being born, two streams of water manifest from the sky—one of cool water, one of warm—with which they perform the water-ablutions for the Bodhisatta and his mother, even so when a being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch is being born, do two streams of water manifest from the sky—one of cool water, one of warm—with which they perform the water-ablutions for that being and his mother? It should not be said thus….

Yathā sampatijāto bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñca vācaṃ bhāsati – “aggohamasmi [T 0.0311] lokassa, jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, seṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, ayamantimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo”ti, evamevaṃ sampatijāto cakkavattisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarena abhimukho sattapadavītihārena gacchati setamhi chatte anudhāriyamāne, sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñca vācaṃ bhāsati – “aggohamasmi lokassa, jeṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, seṭṭhohamasmi lokassa, ayamantimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo”ti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Just as the Bodhisatta, immediately upon birth, having stood firmly on both feet, facing north, walks seven paces while a white parasol is held over him, surveys all the quarters, and utters a bull-like speech: ‘I am the chief in the world, I am the eldest in the world, I am the best in the world. This is the last birth; there is now no further becoming,’ even so does the being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch, immediately upon birth, having stood firmly on both feet, facing north, walk seven paces while a white parasol is held over him, survey all the quarters, and utter a bull-like speech: ‘I am the chief in the world, I am the eldest in the world, I am the best in the world. This is the last birth; there is now no further becoming’? It should not be said thus….

Yathā bodhisattassa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hoti, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa jāyamānassa mahato ālokassa mahato obhāsassa mahato bhūmicālassa pātubhāvo hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Just as when the Bodhisatta is being born there is the manifestation of a great light, a great radiance, and a great earthquake, even so when the being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch is being born is there the manifestation of a great light, a great radiance, and a great earthquake? It should not be said thus….

Yathā [V 0.0240] bodhisattassa pakatikāyo samantā byāmaṃ obhāsati, evamevaṃ cakkavattisattassa pakatikāyo samantā byāmaṃ obhāsatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Just as the natural body of a Bodhisatta shines for a fathom all around, even so does the natural body of a being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch shine for a fathom all around? It should not be said thus….

Yathā bodhisatto mahāsupinaṃ passati, evamevaṃ cakkavattisatto mahāsupinaṃ passatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Just as the Bodhisatta sees the great dream, so too does the being destined to be a wheel-turning monarch see the great dream? It should not be said thus….

402. Na vattabbaṃ – “lakkhaṇasamannāgato bodhisatto”ti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “dvattiṃsimāni, bhikkhave, mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni, yehi samannāgatassa [P 0.0286] mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā na aññā (ka.)! Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā [T 0.0312] cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. Tassimāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyathidaṃ – cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ[M 0.0216], maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanameva sattamaṃ. Parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati. Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivaṭṭacchado”ti dī. ni. 3.200. Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi lakkhaṇasamannāgato bodhisattoti.

402. Should it not be said: ‘A person endowed with the marks is a Bodhisatta’? Yes. Has it not been said by the Blessed One: ‘Bhikkhus, there are these thirty-two marks of a great man, endowed with which a great man has only two destinies, and no other. If he dwells in the household, he becomes a wheel-turning monarch, a righteous king who rules by Dhamma, a conqueror of the four quarters, who has attained stability in his country, and is possessed of the seven treasures. These are his seven treasures: the wheel-treasure, the elephant-treasure, the horse-treasure, the jewel-treasure, the woman-treasure, the householder-treasure, and the counselor-treasure as the seventh. He has more than a thousand sons who are brave, heroic in stature, crushers of enemy armies. He dwells having conquered this earth to its ocean bounds, without rod, without weapon, by means of Dhamma. But if he goes forth from the household life into homelessness, he becomes an Arahant, a Perfectly Enlightened One, who in the world has rolled back the veil.’ Is there such a sutta? Yes. Therefore, a person endowed with the marks is a Bodhisatta.

Lakkhaṇakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion on the Marks is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter

(40) 8. Niyāmokkantikathā

(40) 8. Discussion on Entering the Fixed Course

403. Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyoti ma. ni. 2.282 ghaṭikārasuttaṃ nissāya pucchati? Āmantā. Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato sāvakoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

403. Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and had lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. Was the Bodhisatta a disciple of the Blessed One Kassapa? It should not be said thus….

Bodhisatto [V 0.0241] kassapassa bhagavato sāvakoti? Āmantā. Sāvako hutvā buddho hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Was the Bodhisatta a disciple of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. Having been a disciple, does one become a Buddha? It should not be said thus….

Sāvako hutvā buddho hotīti? Āmantā. Anussaviyoti? Na [T 0.0313] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Having been a disciple, does one become a Buddha? Yes. Is he one who learns by hearsay? It should not be said thus….

Anussaviyoti[P 0.0287]? Āmantā. Nanu bhagavā sayambhūti? Āmantā. Hañci bhagavā sayambhū, no ca vata re vattabbe – “anussaviyo”ti.

Is he one who learns by hearsay? Yes. But is not the Blessed One self-awakened? Yes. If the Blessed One is self-awakened, then it cannot rightly be said that he is ‘one who learns by hearsay’.

Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyoti? Āmantā. Bhagavatā bodhiyā mūle tīṇeva sāmaññaphalāni abhisambuddhānīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and had lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. Did the Blessed One awaken to only three fruits of recluseship at the foot of the Bodhi tree? It should not be said thus….

Nanu bhagavatā bodhiyā mūle cattāri sāmaññaphalāni abhisambuddhānīti? Āmantā. Hañci bhagavatā bodhiyā mūle cattāri sāmaññaphalāni abhisambuddhāni, no ca vata re vattabbe – “bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo”ti.

But did not the Blessed One awaken to the four fruits of recluseship at the foot of the Bodhi tree? Yes. If the Blessed One awakened to the four fruits of recluseship at the foot of the Bodhi tree, then it should not be said that 'the Bodhisatta, in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, was one who entered the fixed course and had lived the holy life'.

404. Bodhisatto [M 0.0217] kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyoti? Āmantā. Bodhisatto dukkarakāriyaṃ akāsīti? Āmantā. Dassanasampanno puggalo dukkarakāriyaṃ kareyyāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

404. Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and had lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. Did the Bodhisatta perform strenuous practices? Yes. Would a person accomplished in vision perform strenuous practices? It should not be said thus….

Bodhisatto aparantapaṃ amaraṃ tapaṃ (saṃ. ni. 1.137) akāsi, aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisīti? Āmantā. Dassanasampanno puggalo aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddiseyyāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Did the Bodhisatta torment others and resort to another teacher? Yes. Would a person accomplished in vision resort to another teacher? It should not be said thus….

Āyasmā ānando bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, āyasmā ānando bhagavato sāvakoti? Āmantā. Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo[T 0.0314], bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato sāvakoti? Na [P 0.0288] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Was the Venerable Ānanda one who entered the fixed course and had lived the holy life in the Blessed One’s dispensation, and was the Venerable Ānanda a disciple of the Blessed One? Yes. Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and had lived the holy life in the Blessed One Kassapa’s dispensation, and was the Bodhisatta a disciple of the Blessed One Kassapa? It should not be said thus….

Citto [V 0.0242] gahapati hatthako āḷavako bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, citto gahapati hatthako āḷavako bhagavato sāvakoti? Āmantā. Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato sāvakoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Were the householder Citta and Hatthaka of Āḷavī, who had entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the Blessed One’s dispensation, disciples of the Blessed One? Yes. Was the Bodhisatta, who had entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, a disciple of the Blessed One Kassapa? It should not be said thus…

Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, na ca kassapassa bhagavato sāvakoti? Āmantā. Āyasmā ānando bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, na ca bhagavato sāvakoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, yet was not a disciple of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. Was the Venerable Ānanda one who entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One, yet was not a disciple of the Blessed One? It should not be said thus…

Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, na ca kassapassa bhagavato sāvakoti? Āmantā. Citto gahapati hatthako āḷavako bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, na ca bhagavato sāvakoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, yet was not a disciple of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. Were the householder Citta and Hatthaka of Āḷavī those who entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the Blessed One’s dispensation, yet were not disciples of the Blessed One? It should not be said thus…

Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, na ca kassapassa bhagavato sāvakoti? Āmantā. Sāvako jātiṃ vītivatto asāvako hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, yet was not a disciple of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. Does a disciple who has transcended birth become a non-disciple? It should not be said thus…

405. Na [M 0.0218] vattabbaṃ – “bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo”ti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā [T 0.0315] – “kassape ahaṃ, ānanda, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ acariṃ āyatiṃ sambodhāyā”ti! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā[P 0.0289]. Tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo”ti.

405. Should it not be said that 'the Bodhisatta, in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, entered the fixed course and lived the holy life'? It should not be said. But was it not said by the Blessed One: 'Ānanda, under the Blessed One Kassapa, I lived the holy life for the sake of future full enlightenment'? Is there such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should be said that 'the Bodhisatta, in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, entered the fixed course and lived the holy life.'

Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyoti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā –

Was the Bodhisatta one who entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. But was it not said by the Blessed One:

“Sabbābhibhū sabbavidūhamasmi,

Sabbesu dhammesu anupalitto;

Sabbañjaho [V 0.0243] taṇhakkhaye vimutto,

Sayaṃ abhiññāya kamuddiseyyaṃ.

“I am the all-surpassing, the all-knowing, undefiled amidst all things. Having abandoned all, freed in the destruction of craving, having realized this for myself through direct knowledge, whom should I point to as my teacher?

“Na me ācariyo atthi, sadiso me na vijjati;

Sadevakasmiṃ lokasmiṃ, natthi me paṭipuggalo.

I have no teacher; one like me is not to be found. In the world with its devas, there is no one who is my counterpart.

“Ahañhi arahā loke, ahaṃ satthā anuttaro;

Ekomhi sammāsambuddho, sītibhūtosmi nibbuto.

For I am the Arahant in the world, I am the unsurpassed Teacher; I alone am the Perfectly Enlightened One, become cool, fully extinguished.

“Dhammacakkaṃ pavattetuṃ, gacchāmi kāsinaṃ puraṃ;

Andhībhūtasmiṃ andhabhūtasmiṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.) lokasmiṃ, āhañchaṃ āhaññiṃ (ka.) amatadundubhi”nti dudrabhinti (ka.).

To set in motion the Wheel of Dhamma, I go to the city of the Kāsīs; in a world that has become blind, I shall beat the drum of the Deathless.”

“Yathā kho tvaṃ, āvuso, paṭijānāsi, arahasi anantajino”ti?

“Friend, according to your claim, you are worthy of being the endless conqueror.”

“Mādisā ve jinā honti, ye pattā āsavakkhayaṃ;

Jitā me pāpakā dhammā, tasmāhaṃ upaka jino”ti mahāva. 11; ma. ni. 1.285; 2.341.

“Indeed, conquerors are those like me, who have attained the destruction of the taints. Evil qualities have been conquered by me; therefore, Upaka, I am a conqueror.”

Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena [P 0.0290] hi na vattabbaṃ – “bodhisatto kassapassa [T 0.0316] bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo”ti.

Is there such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said: 'The Bodhisatta, in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, entered the fixed course and lived the holy life.'

Bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyoti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “‘idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasacca’nti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā [M 0.0219] udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi. ‘Taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyya’nti me, bhikkhave…pe… pariññātanti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi…pe… āloko udapādi. ‘Idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasacca’nti me, bhikkhave…pe… ‘taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ dukkhasamudayo (syā. kaṃ.) ariyasaccaṃ pahātabba’nti me, bhikkhave…pe… pahīnanti me, bhikkhave…pe… ‘idaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ dukkhanirodho (syā. kaṃ.) ariyasacca’nti me, bhikkhave…pe… ‘taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhaṃ [V 0.0244] ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabba’nti me, bhikkhave…pe… sacchikatanti me, bhikkhave…pe… ‘idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasacca’nti me, bhikkhave…pe… ‘taṃ kho panidaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabba’nti me, bhikkhave…pe… bhāvitanti me, bhikkhave, pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādī”ti mahāva. 15; saṃ. ni. 5.1081; paṭi. ma. 2.30. Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “bodhisatto kassapassa bhagavato pāvacane okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo”ti.

Was the Bodhisatta one who had entered the fixed course and lived the holy life in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa? Yes. But was it not said by the Blessed One: '“This is the noble truth of suffering”—concerning things unheard before, monks, there arose in me vision, knowledge, wisdom, insight, and light. “This noble truth of suffering is to be fully understood”… it has been fully understood—concerning things unheard before, monks, there arose in me vision… and light. “This is the noble truth of the origin of suffering”… “This noble truth of the origin of suffering is to be abandoned”… it has been abandoned… “This is the noble truth of the cessation of suffering”… “This noble truth of the cessation of suffering is to be realized”… it has been realized… “This is the noble truth of the path leading to the cessation of suffering”… “This noble truth of the path leading to the cessation of suffering is to be developed”… it has been developed—concerning things unheard before, monks, there arose in me vision, knowledge, wisdom, insight, and light.' Is there such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said: 'The Bodhisatta, in the dispensation of the Blessed One Kassapa, entered the fixed course and lived the holy life.'

Niyāmokkantikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion on Entering the Fixed Course is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter

(41) 9. Aparāpi samannāgatakathā

4. (41) 9. Another Discourse on Being Endowed

406. Arahattasacchikiriyāya [T 0.0317] paṭipanno puggalo tīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo catūhi phassehi [P 0.0291] catūhi vedanāhi catūhi saññāhi catūhi cetanāhi catūhi cittehi catūhi saddhāhi catūhi vīriyehi catūhi satīhi catūhi samādhīhi catūhi paññāhi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with three fruits? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with four contacts, four feelings, four perceptions, four volitions, four minds, four faiths, four energies, four mindfulnesses, four concentrations, and four wisdoms? It should not be said thus…

Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dvīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo tīhi phassehi tīhi vedanāhi…pe… tīhi paññāhi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

406. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with two fruits? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with three contacts, three feelings… three wisdoms? It should not be said thus…

Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya [M 0.0220] paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dvīhi phassehi dvīhi vedanāhi…pe… dvīhi paññāhi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning endowed with two contacts, two feelings... two instances of wisdom? It should not be said thus. …

Arahattasacchikiriyāya [V 0.0245] paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpanno sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṅkolo, ekabījīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship a stream-enterer, one who is reborn at most seven more times, a clan-to-clan goer, or a one-seeder? It should not be said thus. …

Arahattasacchikiriyāya [T 0.0318] paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of once-returning? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship a once-returner? It should not be said thus. …

Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmī antarāparinibbāyī, upahaccaparinibbāyī, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī, uddhaṃsoto akaniṭṭhagāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of non-returning? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship a non-returner: one who attains final Nibbāna in the intermediate state, one who attains final Nibbāna upon arrival, one who attains final Nibbāna without exertion, one who attains final Nibbāna with exertion, or one who goes upstream to the Akaniṭṭha realm? It should not be said thus. …

Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā[P 0.0292]. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpanno sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṅkolo, ekabījīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning a stream-enterer, one who is reborn at most seven more times, a clan-to-clan goer, or a one-seeder? It should not be said thus. …

Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the fruit of once-returning? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning a once-returner? It should not be said thus. …

Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpanno sattakkhattuparamo, kolaṅkolo, ekabījīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning a stream-enterer, one who is reborn at most seven more times, a clan-to-clan goer, or a one-seeder? It should not be said thus. …

407. Sotāpattiphalena samannāgato sotāpannoti vattabboti? Āmantā[T 0.0319]. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena [M 0.0221] samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo, so sotāpannoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

407. Should one endowed with the fruit of stream-entry be called a stream-enterer? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. But is that very person practicing for the realization of Arahantship a stream-enterer? It should not be said thus. …

Sakadāgāmiphalena [V 0.0246] samannāgato sakadāgāmīti vattabboti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo, so sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruit of once-returning be called a once-returner? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of once-returning? Yes. But is that very person practicing for the realization of Arahantship a once-returner? It should not be said thus. …

Anāgāmiphalena samannāgato anāgāmīti vattabboti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā[P 0.0293]. Sveva arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo, so anāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruit of non-returning be called a non-returner? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of non-returning? Yes. But is that very person practicing for the realization of Arahantship a non-returner? It should not be said thus. …

Sotāpattiphalena samannāgato sotāpannoti vattabboti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo, so sotāpannoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruit of stream-entry be called a stream-enterer? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. But is that very person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning a stream-enterer? It should not be said thus. …

Sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgato sakadāgāmīti vattabboti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo, so sakadāgāmīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruit of once-returning be called a once-returner? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the fruit of once-returning? Yes. But is that very person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning a once-returner? It should not be said thus. …

Sotāpattiphalena samannāgato sotāpannoti vattabboti? Āmantā[T 0.0320]. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sveva sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo, so sotāpannoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should one endowed with the fruit of stream-entry be called a stream-enterer? Yes. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. But is that very person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning a stream-enterer? It should not be said thus. …

408. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahattasacchikiriyāya [P 0.0294] paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti.

408. Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. But has not a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship transcended the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. If a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the fruit of stream-entry, then it should not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship is endowed with the fruit of stream-entry.”

Arahattasacchikiriyāya [M 0.0222][V 0.0247] paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ apāyagamanīyaṃ rāgaṃ apāyagamanīyaṃ dosaṃ apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the fruit of stream-entry; is he endowed with it? Yes. A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the path of stream-entry, identity view, doubt, adherence to rites and rituals, greed leading to the lower realms, hatred leading to the lower realms, and delusion leading to the lower realms; is he endowed with these? It should not be said thus. …

Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of once-returning? Yes. But has not a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship transcended the fruit of once-returning? Yes. If a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the fruit of once-returning, then it should not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship is endowed with the fruit of once-returning.”

Arahattasacchikiriyāya [T 0.0321] paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the fruit of once-returning; is he endowed with it? Yes. A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the path of once-returning, gross sensual desire, and gross ill will; is he endowed with them? It should not be said thus...

Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship endowed with the fruit of non-returning? Yes. But has not a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship transcended the fruit of non-returning? Yes. If a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the fruit of non-returning, then it should not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship is endowed with the fruit of non-returning.”

Arahattasacchikiriyāya [P 0.0295] paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo anāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the fruit of non-returning; is he endowed with it? Yes. A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship has transcended the path of non-returning, subtle sensual desire, and subtle ill will; is he endowed with them? It should not be said thus...

409. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ [V 0.0248] vītivatto, no [T 0.0322] ca vata re vattabbe – “anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti.

409. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. But has not a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning transcended the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. If a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has transcended the fruit of stream-entry, then it should not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning is endowed with the fruit of stream-entry.”

Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya [M 0.0223] paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto, sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ…pe… apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has transcended the fruit of stream-entry; is he endowed with it? Yes. A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has transcended the path of stream-entry, identity view... and delusion leading to the lower realms; is he endowed with them? It should not be said thus...

Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the fruit of once-returning? Yes. But has not a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning transcended the fruit of once-returning? Yes. If a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has transcended the fruit of once-returning, then it should not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning is endowed with the fruit of once-returning.”

Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā[P 0.0296]. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sakadāgāmimaggaṃ vītivatto, oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has transcended the fruit of once-returning; is he endowed with it? Yes. A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has transcended the path of once-returning, gross sensual desire, and gross ill will; is he endowed with them? It should not be said thus...

410. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Nanu sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya [T 0.0323] paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivattoti? Āmantā. Hañci sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, no ca vata re vattabbe – “sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti.

410. Is a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. But has not a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning transcended the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. If a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning has transcended the fruit of stream-entry, then it should not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning is endowed with the fruit of stream-entry.”

Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattimaggaṃ vītivatto[V 0.0249], sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ…pe… apāyagamanīyaṃ mohaṃ vītivatto, tena samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning has transcended the fruit of stream-entry; is he endowed with it? Yes. A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning has transcended the path of stream-entry, identity view... and delusion leading to the lower realms; is he endowed with them? It should not be said thus...

411. Na vattabbaṃ – “arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo tīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti? Āmantā. Nanu arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni, tehi ca aparihīnoti? Āmantā. Hañci arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi [M 0.0224] ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe – “arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo tīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti.

411. Should it not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship is endowed with the three fruits”? Yes. But surely, have not the three fruits been attained by a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship, and is he not without loss of them? Yes. If indeed the three fruits have been attained by a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship and he has not fallen away from them, then it should indeed be said: “A person practicing for the realization of Arahantship is endowed with the three fruits.”

Na vattabbaṃ – “anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dvīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti? Āmantā. Nanu anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena [P 0.0297] dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni, tehi ca aparihīnoti? Āmantā. Hañci anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīno, tena vata [T 0.0324] re vattabbe – “anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dvīhi phalehi samannāgato”ti.

Should it not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning is endowed with the two fruits”? Yes. But surely, have not the two fruits been attained by a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning, and is he not without loss of them? Yes. If indeed the two fruits have been attained by a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning and he has not fallen away from them, then it should indeed be said: “A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning is endowed with the two fruits.”

Na vattabbaṃ – “sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti? Āmantā. Nanu sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena sotāpattiphalaṃ paṭiladdhaṃ, tena ca aparihīnoti? Āmantā. Hañci sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena sotāpattiphalaṃ paṭiladdhaṃ tena ca aparihīno, tena vata re vattabbe – “sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo sotāpattiphalena samannāgato”ti.

Should it not be said: “A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning is endowed with the fruit of stream-entry”? Yes. But surely, has not the fruit of stream-entry been attained by a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning, and is he not without loss of it? Yes. If indeed the fruit of stream-entry has been attained by a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning and he has not fallen away from it, then it should indeed be said: “A person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning is endowed with the fruit of stream-entry.”

412. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena tīṇi phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti, arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo tīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena cattāro maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo catūhi maggehi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

412. Given that a person practicing for the realization of arahantship has attained the three fruits and has not fallen away from them, is that person practicing for the realization of arahantship endowed with the three fruits? Yes. Given that a person practicing for the realization of arahantship has attained the four paths and has not fallen away from them, is that person practicing for the realization of arahantship endowed with the four paths? It should not be said so... and so on.

Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena dve phalāni paṭiladdhāni tehi ca aparihīnoti[V 0.0250], anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dvīhi phalehi samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena tayo maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo tīhi [T 0.0325] maggehi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Given that a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has attained the two fruits and has not fallen away from them, is that person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the two fruits? Yes. Given that a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning has attained the three paths and has not fallen away from them, is that person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning endowed with the three paths? It should not be said so... and so on.

Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena sotāpattiphalaṃ paṭiladdhaṃ tena ca aparihīnoti, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya [P 0.0298] paṭipanno puggalo [M 0.0225] sotāpattiphalena samannāgatoti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena puggalena dve maggā paṭiladdhā tehi ca aparihīnoti, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno puggalo dvīhi maggehi samannāgatoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Given that a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning has attained the fruit of stream-entry and has not fallen away from it, is that person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning endowed with the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. Given that a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning has attained the two paths and has not fallen away from them, is that person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning endowed with the two paths? It should not be said so... and so on.

Aparāpi samannāgatakathā niṭṭhitā.

The further discourse on being endowed is concluded.

4. Catutthavaggo

4. The Fourth Chapter

(42) 10. Sabbasaṃyojanappahānakathā

(42) 10. Discourse on the Abandonment of All Fetters

413. Sabbasaṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ arahattanti? Āmantā. Arahattamaggena sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

413. Is the abandonment of all fetters Arahantship? Yes. Are all fetters abandoned by the path of Arahantship? It should not be said so... and so on.

Arahattamaggena sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantīti? Āmantā. Arahattamaggena sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pajahatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Are all fetters abandoned by the path of Arahantship? Yes. Does one abandon identity view, doubt, and attachment to rites and rituals by the path of Arahantship? It should not be said so... and so on.

Arahattamaggena sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ vicikicchaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pajahatīti? Āmantā. Nanu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ sotāpattiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti? Āmantā. Hañci tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ sotāpattiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahattamaggena sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti.

Does one abandon identity view, doubt, and attachment to rites and rituals by the path of Arahantship? Yes. But has not the Blessed One said that the abandonment of the three fetters is the fruit of stream-entry? Yes. If the abandonment of the three fetters has been stated by the Blessed One to be the fruit of stream-entry, then it should not, indeed, be said that 'all fetters are abandoned by the path of Arahantship.'

414. Arahattamaggena [T 0.0326][V 0.0251] sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantīti? Āmantā. Arahattamaggena oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

414. Are all fetters abandoned by the path of Arahantship? Yes. Does one abandon gross sensual lust and gross ill will by the path of Arahantship? It should not be said so... and so on.

415. Arahattamaggena [P 0.0299] oḷārikaṃ kāmarāgaṃ oḷārikaṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti? Āmantā. Nanu kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ tanubhāvaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti? Āmantā. Hañci kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ tanubhāvaṃ sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahattamaggena sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti.

415. Does one abandon gross sensual lust and gross ill will by the path of Arahantship? Yes. But has not the Blessed One said that the attenuation of sensual lust and ill will is the fruit of once-returning? Yes. If the attenuation of sensual lust and ill will has been stated by the Blessed One to be the fruit of once-returning, then it should not, indeed, be said that 'all fetters are abandoned by the path of Arahantship.'

Arahattamaggena [M 0.0226] sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantīti? Āmantā. Arahattamaggena aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Are all fetters abandoned by the path of Arahantship? Yes. Does one abandon subtle sensual lust and subtle ill will by the path of Arahantship? It should not be said so... and so on.

416. Arahattamaggena aṇusahagataṃ kāmarāgaṃ aṇusahagataṃ byāpādaṃ pajahatīti? Āmantā. Nanu kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ anavasesappahānaṃ anāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti? Āmantā. Hañci kāmarāgabyāpādānaṃ anavasesappahānaṃ anāgāmiphalaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahattamaggena sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti.

416. Does one abandon subtle sensual lust and subtle ill will by the path of Arahantship? Yes. But has not the Blessed One said that the complete abandonment of sensual lust and ill will is the fruit of non-returning? Yes. If the complete abandonment of sensual lust and ill will has been stated by the Blessed One to be the fruit of non-returning, then it should not, indeed, be said that 'all fetters are abandoned by the path of Arahantship.'

Arahattamaggena sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantīti? Āmantā. Nanu rūparāgaarūparāgamānauddhaccaavijjāya anavasesappahānaṃ [T 0.0327] arahattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti? Āmantā. Hañci rūparāgaarūparāgamānauddhaccaavijjāya anavasesappahānaṃ arahattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “arahattamaggena sabbe saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti.

Are all fetters abandoned by the path of Arahantship? Yes. But has not the Blessed One said that the complete abandonment of lust for form, lust for the formless, conceit, restlessness, and ignorance is Arahantship? Yes. If the complete abandonment of lust for form, lust for the formless, conceit, restlessness, and ignorance has been stated by the Blessed One to be Arahantship, then it should not, indeed, be said that 'all fetters are abandoned by the path of Arahantship.'

417. Na vattabbaṃ – “sabbasaṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ arahatta”nti? Āmantā. Nanu arahato sabbe saṃyojanā pahīnāti? Āmantā[P 0.0300]. Hañci arahato sabbe saṃyojanā pahīnā, tena vata re vattabbe – “sabbasaṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ arahatta”nti.

417. Should it not be said that 'the abandonment of all fetters is Arahantship'? Yes. But for an Arahant, are not all fetters abandoned? Yes. If for an Arahant all fetters are abandoned, then it should indeed be said that 'the abandonment of all fetters is Arahantship.'

Sabbasaṃyojanappahānakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on the Abandonment of All Fetters is concluded.

Catutthavaggo.

The Fourth Chapter.

Tassuddānaṃ –

The summary:

Gihissa [V 0.0252] arahā, saha upapattiyā arahā, arahato sabbe dhammā anāsavā, arahā catūhi phalehi samannāgato, evamevaṃ chahi upekkhāhi, bodhiyā buddho, salakkhaṇasamannāgato, bodhisatto okkantaniyāmo caritabrahmacariyo, paṭipannako phalena samannāgato, sabbasaṃyojanānaṃ pahānaṃ arahattanti.

The householder Arahant; the Arahant with rebirth; for an Arahant, all states are taintless; an Arahant is endowed with the four fruits; likewise with the six kinds of equanimity; the Buddha is awakened through enlightenment; endowed with his own characteristics; the Bodhisatta who has entered the fixed course and practiced the holy life; one who has entered the path is endowed with the fruit; Arahantship is the abandonment of all fetters.

5. Pañcamavaggo

5. The Fifth Chapter

(43) 1. Vimuttikathā

(43) 1. Discourse on Liberation

418. Vimuttiñāṇaṃ [T 0.0328][M 0.0227][P 0.0301] vimuttanti? Āmantā. Yaṃ kiñci vimuttiñāṇaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ vimuttanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe…. Vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Paccavekkhaṇañāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

418. Is the knowledge of liberation liberated? Yes. Is whatever knowledge of liberation there is, all of it liberated? It should not be said so... and so on. Is the knowledge of liberation liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of reviewing liberated? It should not be said so... and so on.

Vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Gotrabhuno puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Sotāpannassa ñāṇaṃ, sotāpattiphalaṃ pattassa paṭiladdhassa adhigatassa sacchikatassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmissa ñāṇaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ pattassa paṭiladdhassa adhigatassa sacchikatassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Anāgāmissa ñāṇaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ pattassa paṭiladdhassa adhigatassa sacchikatassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Arahato [P 0.0302] ñāṇaṃ, arahattaṃ pattassa paṭiladdhassa adhigatassa sacchikatassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the knowledge of liberation liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person of change-of-lineage liberated? It should not be said thus… and so on…. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of a stream-enterer the knowledge of one who has attained, obtained, acquired, and realized the fruit of stream-entry? It should not be said thus… and so on…. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of a once-returner the knowledge of one who has attained, obtained, acquired, and realized the fruit of once-returning? It should not be said thus… and so on…. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of a non-returner the knowledge of one who has attained, obtained, acquired, and realized the fruit of non-returning? It should not be said thus… and so on…. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of Arahantship liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of an Arahant the knowledge of one who has attained, obtained, acquired, and realized the fruit of Arahantship? It should not be said thus… and so on….

419. Sotāpattiphalasamaṅgissa [T 0.0329][V 0.0253] puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sakadāgāmiphalasamaṅgissa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… anāgāmiphalasamaṅgissa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… arahattaphalasamaṅgissa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

419. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person possessed of the fruit of stream-entry liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry liberated? It should not be said thus… and so on…. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person possessed of the fruit of once-returning liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning liberated? It should not be said thus… and so on…. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person possessed of the fruit of non-returning liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning liberated? It should not be said thus… and so on…. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person possessed of the fruit of Arahantship liberated? Yes. Is the knowledge of liberation of a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of Arahantship liberated? It should not be said thus… and so on….

420. Sotāpattiphalasamaṅgissa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa [M 0.0228] vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sakadāgāmiphalasamaṅgissa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Āmantā[P 0.0303]. Sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… anāgāmiphalasamaṅgissa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa [T 0.0330] puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… arahattaphalasamaṅgissa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa vimuttiñāṇaṃ vimuttaṃ tañca phalaṃ pattassa ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

420. For a person possessed of the fruit of stream-entry, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? Yes. For a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? It should not be said thus… and so on…. For a person possessed of the fruit of once-returning, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? Yes. For a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of once-returning, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? It should not be said thus… and so on…. For a person possessed of the fruit of non-returning, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? Yes. For a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of non-returning, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? It should not be said thus… and so on…. For a person possessed of the fruit of Arahantship, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? Yes. For a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of Arahantship, is the knowledge of liberation liberated, and is that the knowledge of one who has attained the fruit? It should not be said thus… and so on….

Vimuttikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Liberation is concluded.

5. Pañcamavaggo

5. The Fifth Section

(44) 2. Asekhañāṇakathā

(44) 2. Discourse on the Knowledge of One Beyond Training

421. Sekhassa [V 0.0254] asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Āmantā. Sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāti passati, diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti na passati, adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti? Āmantā. Hañci sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti na passati, adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharati, no ca vata re vattabbe – “sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthī”ti.

421. Does a trainee possess the knowledge of one beyond training? Yes. Does a trainee know and see the state of one beyond training, abide having attained that which is seen, known, and realized, and abide having touched it with the body? This should not be said thus... and so on... Is it not so that a trainee does not know and does not see the state of one beyond training, abides not having attained that which is unseen, unknown, and unrealized, and abides not having touched it with the body? Yes. If a trainee does not know and does not see the state of one beyond training, abides not having attained that which is unseen, unknown, and unrealized, and abides not having touched it with the body, then indeed, friend, it should not be said: 'A trainee possesses the knowledge of one beyond training.'

Asekhassa [P 0.0304] asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi, asekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāti passati, diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharatīti? Āmantā. Sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi[T 0.0331], sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāti passati, diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ upasampajja viharati, kāyena phusitvā viharatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does one beyond training possess the knowledge of one beyond training, and does that one beyond training know and see the state of one beyond training, abide having attained that which is seen, known, and realized, and abide having touched it with the body? Yes. Does a trainee possess the knowledge of one beyond training, and does that trainee know and see the state of one beyond training, abide having attained that which is seen, known, and realized, and abide having touched it with the body? This should not be said thus... and so on...

422. Sekhassa [M 0.0229] asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi, sekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti na passati, adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti? Āmantā. Asekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthi, asekho asekhaṃ dhammaṃ na jānāti na passati, adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ na upasampajja viharati, na kāyena phusitvā viharatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

422. Is it so that a trainee possesses the knowledge of one beyond training, and that trainee does not know and does not see the state of one beyond training, abides not having attained that which is unseen, unknown, and unrealized, and abides not having touched it with the body? Yes. Is it so that one beyond training possesses the knowledge of one beyond training, and that one beyond training does not know and does not see the state of one beyond training, abides not having attained that which is unseen, unknown, and unrealized, and abides not having touched it with the body? This should not be said thus... and so on...

Sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Āmantā. Gotrabhuno puggalassa sotāpattimagge ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa sotāpattiphale ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sakadāgāmiphala… anāgāmiphala… arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa arahatte ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does a trainee possess the knowledge of one beyond training? Yes. Does a person at the change-of-lineage possess knowledge in the path of stream-entry? This should not be said... Does a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry possess knowledge in the fruit of stream-entry? This should not be said... Similarly for the fruit of once-returning... the fruit of non-returning... Does a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship possess knowledge in Arahantship? This should not be said...

423. Na [V 0.0255] vattabbaṃ – “sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthī”ti? Āmantā. Nanu āyasmā ānando sekho – “bhagavā uḷāro”ti jānāti, “sāriputto thero, mahāmoggallāno thero uḷāro”ti jānātīti? Āmantā. Hañci āyasmā ānando sekho – “bhagavā uḷāro”ti [T 0.0332] jānāti, “sāriputto [P 0.0305] thero, mahāmoggallāno thero uḷāro”ti jānāti, tena vata re vattabbe – “sekhassa asekhaṃ ñāṇaṃ atthī”ti.

423. Should it not be said, 'A trainee possesses the knowledge of one beyond training'? Yes. Does not the Venerable Ānanda, a trainee, know, 'The Blessed One is magnificent,' and know, 'The Elder Sāriputta and the Elder Mahāmoggallāna are magnificent'? Yes. If the Venerable Ānanda, a trainee, knows, 'The Blessed One is magnificent,' and knows, 'The Elder Sāriputta and the Elder Mahāmoggallāna are magnificent,' then indeed, friend, it should be said, 'A trainee possesses the knowledge of one beyond training.'

Asekhañāṇakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on the Knowledge of One Beyond Training is concluded.

5. Pañcamavaggo

5. The Fifth Chapter

(45) 3. Viparītakathā

5. (45) 3. Discourse on Perversion

424. Pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ pathavīkasiṇasamāpattiṃ (sī. ka.) samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Anicce niccanti vipariyesoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… dukkhe sukhanti…pe… anattani attāti…pe… asubhe subhanti vipariyesoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, is there knowledge in perversion? Yes. Is the perversion of 'permanent' in the impermanent knowledge? This should not be said... Is the perversion of 'happiness' in suffering... of 'self' in non-self... of 'beauty' in the foul, knowledge? This should not be said...

Pathavīkasiṇaṃ [M 0.0230] samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Akusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu kusalanti? Āmantā. Hañci kusalaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇa”nti.

424. For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, is there knowledge in perversion? Yes. Is it unwholesome? This should not be said... Is it not wholesome? Yes. If it is wholesome, then indeed, friend, it should not be said, 'For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion.'

Anicce niccanti vipariyeso, so ca akusaloti? Āmantā. Pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇaṃ, tañca akusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… dukkhe sukhanti…pe… anattani attāti…pe… asubhe subhanti vipariyeso, so ca akusaloti? Āmantā. Pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇaṃ, tañca akusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the perversion of 'permanent' in the impermanent unwholesome? Yes. For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion; and is that unwholesome? This should not be said... Is the perversion of 'happiness' in suffering... of 'self' in non-self... of 'beauty' in the foul, unwholesome? Yes. For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion; and is that unwholesome? This should not be said...

425. Pathavīkasiṇaṃ [T 0.0333][P 0.0306][V 0.0256] samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇaṃ, tañca akusalanti? Āmantā. Anicce niccanti vipariyeso, so ca kusaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇaṃ, tañca akusalanti? Āmantā. Dukkhe sukhanti…pe… anattani attāti…pe… asubhe subhanti vipariyeso, so ca kusaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion; and is that unwholesome? Yes. Is the perversion of 'permanent' in the impermanent wholesome? This should not be said... For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion; and is that unwholesome? Yes. Is the perversion of 'happiness' in suffering... of 'self' in non-self... of 'beauty' in the foul, wholesome? This should not be said...

426. Pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Arahā pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpajjeyyāti? Āmantā. Hañci arahā pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpajjeyya, no ca vata re vattabbe – “pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇa”nti.

425. For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, is there knowledge in perversion? Yes. Might an Arahant attain the earth-kasiṇa attainment? Yes. If an Arahant might attain the earth-kasiṇa attainment, then indeed, friend, it should not be said, 'For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion.'

Pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇaṃ, arahā pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpajjeyyāti? Āmantā. Atthi arahato vipariyesoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

426. There is knowledge in perversion for one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, and might an Arahant attain the earth-kasiṇa attainment? Yes. Does an Arahant have perversion? This should not be said...

Atthi arahato vipariyesoti? Āmantā. Atthi arahato saññāvipariyeso cittavipariyeso diṭṭhivipariyesoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does an Arahant have perversion? Yes. Does an Arahant have perversion of perception, perversion of mind, or perversion of view? This should not be said...

Natthi arahato saññāvipariyeso cittavipariyeso diṭṭhivipariyesoti? Āmantā. Hañci natthi arahato saññāvipariyeso cittavipariyeso [M 0.0231] diṭṭhivipariyeso, no ca vata re vattabbe – “atthi arahato vipariyeso”ti.

Does an Arahant not have perversion of perception, perversion of mind, or perversion of view? Yes. If an Arahant does not have perversion of perception, perversion of mind, or perversion of view, then indeed, friend, it should not be said, 'An Arahant has perversion.'

427. Na [T 0.0334] vattabbaṃ – pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Pathavīkasiṇaṃ [P 0.0307] samāpattiṃ samāpajjantassa sabbeva pathavīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe. Tena hi pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇanti.

Should it not be said, 'For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion'? Yes. For one attaining the earth-kasiṇa attainment, is everything earth? This should not be said. Therefore, for one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion.

Pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Nanu pathavī atthi, atthi ca koci pathaviṃ pathavito samāpajjatīti? Āmantā. Hañci pathavī atthi, atthi ca [V 0.0257] koci pathaviṃ pathavito samāpajjati, no ca vata re vattabbe – “pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇa”nti.

427. For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, is there knowledge in perversion? Yes. Is it not so that earth exists, and that someone attains earth as earth? Yes. If earth exists, and someone attains earth as earth, then indeed, friend, it should not be said, 'For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion.'

Pathavī atthi, pathaviṃ pathavito samāpajjantassa viparītaṃ hotīti? Āmantā. Nibbānaṃ atthi, nibbānaṃ nibbānato samāpajjantassa viparītaṃ hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa viparīte ñāṇa”nti.

Earth exists; for one who attains earth as earth, does perversion occur? Yes. Nibbāna exists; for one who attains Nibbāna as Nibbāna, does perversion occur? This should not be said... Therefore, it should not be said, 'For one who has attained the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is knowledge in perversion.'

Viparītakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Perversion is concluded.

5. Pañcamavaggo

5. The Fifth Chapter

(46) 4. Niyāmakathā

(46) 4. Discourse on the Fixed Course

428. Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Niyatassa aniyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

5. Is there knowledge for one who is unfixed for entering the fixed course? Yes. Is there knowledge for one who is fixed for entering the unfixed course? This should not be said...

Niyatassa aniyāmagamanāya natthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Aniyatassa [T 0.0335] niyāmagamanāya natthi ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there no knowledge for one who is fixed for entering the unfixed course? Yes. Is there no knowledge for one who is unfixed for entering the fixed course? This should not be said...

Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā[P 0.0308]. Niyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

428. Is there knowledge for one who is unfixed for entering the fixed course? Yes. Is there knowledge for one who is fixed for entering the fixed course? This should not be said...

Niyatassa niyāmagamanāya natthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya natthi ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there no knowledge for one who is fixed for entering the fixed course? Yes. Is there no knowledge for one who is unfixed for entering the fixed course? This should not be said...

Aniyatassa [M 0.0232][V 0.0258] niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Aniyatassa aniyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there knowledge for one who is unfixed for entering the fixed course? Yes. Is there knowledge for one who is unfixed for entering the unfixed course? This should not be said...

Aniyatassa aniyāmagamanāya natthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya natthi ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there no knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the unfixed course? Yes. Is there no knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course? That should not be said...

429. Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi niyāmoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

429. Is there knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course? Yes. Is there a fixed course for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course? That should not be said...

Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi satipaṭṭhānā… sammappadhānā… iddhipādā… indriyā… balā… bojjhaṅgāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course? Yes. For one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course, are there foundations of mindfulness... right strivings... bases of psychic power... faculties... powers... factors of enlightenment? That should not be said...

Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya natthi niyāmoti? Āmantā. Hañci aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya natthi niyāmo, no vata re vattabbe – “aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇa”nti.

Is there no fixed course for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course? Yes. If there is no fixed course for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course, then it should not be said: 'There is knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course.'

Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya natthi satipaṭṭhānā…pe… bojjhaṅgāti? Āmantā. Hañci aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya natthi bojjhaṅgā, no vata re vattabbe – “aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi [T 0.0336] ñāṇa”nti.

For one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course, are there no foundations of mindfulness... factors of enlightenment? Yes. If, for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course, there are no factors of enlightenment, then it should not be said: 'There is knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course.'

430. Aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇanti? Āmantā. Gotrabhuno [P 0.0309] puggalassa sotāpattimagge ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa sotāpattiphale ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe …pe… arahattasacchikiriyāya paṭipannassa puggalassa arahatte ñāṇaṃ atthīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

430. Is there knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course? Yes. Does a person who is a lineage-being have knowledge in the path of stream-entry? That should not be said... Does a person practicing for the realization of the fruit of stream-entry have knowledge in the fruit of stream-entry? That should not be said... Does a person practicing for the realization of Arahantship have knowledge in Arahantship? That should not be said...

431. Na vattabbaṃ – “aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇa”nti? Āmantā. Nanu [V 0.0259] bhagavā jānāti – “ayaṃ puggalo sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissati, bhabbo ayaṃ puggalo dhammaṃ abhisametu”nti? Āmantā. Hañci bhagavā jānāti – “ayaṃ puggalo sammattaniyāmaṃ okkamissati, bhabbo ayaṃ puggalo dhammaṃ abhisametuṃ,” tena vata re vattabbe – “aniyatassa niyāmagamanāya atthi ñāṇa”nti.

431. Should it not be said: 'There is knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course'? Yes. Does not the Blessed One know: 'This person will enter the right fixed course; this person is capable of comprehending the Dhamma'? Yes. If the Blessed One knows: 'This person will enter the right fixed course; this person is capable of comprehending the Dhamma,' then indeed it should be said: 'There is knowledge for one who is unfixed, for going to the fixed course.'

Niyāmakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on the Fixed Course is concluded.

5. Pañcamavaggo

5. The Fifth Chapter

(47) 5. Paṭisambhidākathā

(47) 5. Discourse on Analytical Knowledge

432. Sabbaṃ [M 0.0233] ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti? Āmantā. Sammutiñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti[T 0.0337]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sammutiñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti? Āmantā. Ye keci sammutiṃ jānanti, sabbe te paṭisambhidāpattāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sabbaṃ ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti? Āmantā. Cetopariyāye [P 0.0310] ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti? Āmantā. Ye keci paracittaṃ jānanti, sabbe te paṭisambhidāpattāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

432. Is all knowledge analytical knowledge? Yes. Is conventional knowledge analytical knowledge? That should not be said… Is conventional knowledge analytical knowledge? Yes. Do all who know convention attain analytical knowledge? That should not be said… Is all knowledge analytical knowledge? Yes. Is knowledge of the minds of others analytical knowledge? That should not be said… Is knowledge of the minds of others analytical knowledge? Yes. Do all who know the minds of others attain analytical knowledge? That should not be said…

Sabbaṃ ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti? Āmantā. Sabbā paññā paṭisambhidāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… sabbā paññā paṭisambhidāti? Āmantā. Pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa atthi paññā, sā paññā paṭisambhidāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… āpokasiṇaṃ…pe… tejokasiṇaṃ…pe… vāyokasiṇaṃ…pe… nīlakasiṇaṃ…pe… pītakasiṇaṃ…pe… lohitakasiṇaṃ…pe… odātakasiṇaṃ…pe… ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ…pe… viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ…pe… ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ…pe… nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpannassa…pe… dānaṃ dadantassa…pe… cīvaraṃ dadantassa…pe… piṇḍapātaṃ dadantassa…pe… senāsanaṃ dadantassa…pe… gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ [V 0.0260] dadantassa atthi paññā, sā paññā paṭisambhidāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is all knowledge analytical knowledge? Yes. Is all wisdom analytical knowledge? That should not be said… Is all wisdom analytical knowledge? Yes. For one who has entered into the earth-kasiṇa attainment, there is wisdom; is that wisdom analytical knowledge? That should not be said… for one who has entered the water-kasiṇa… fire-kasiṇa… air-kasiṇa… blue-kasiṇa… yellow-kasiṇa… red-kasiṇa… white-kasiṇa… the base of the infinity of space… the base of the infinity of consciousness… the base of nothingness… the base of neither-perception-nor-non-perception… for one giving a gift… giving robes… giving alms-food… giving lodging… for one giving medicinal requisites for the sick, there is wisdom; is that wisdom analytical knowledge? That should not be said…

433. Na vattabbaṃ – “sabbaṃ ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidā”ti? Āmantā. Atthi [T 0.0338] lokuttarā paññā, sā paññā na paṭisambhidāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… tena hi sabbaṃ ñāṇaṃ paṭisambhidāti.

433. Should it not be said: 'All knowledge is analytical knowledge'? Yes. There is supramundane wisdom; is that wisdom not analytical knowledge? That should not be said… Therefore, all knowledge is analytical knowledge.

Paṭisambhidākathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Analytical Knowledge is concluded.

5. Pañcamavaggo

5. The Fifth Chapter

(48) 6. Sammutiñāṇakathā

(48) 6. Discourse on Conventional Knowledge

434. Na vattabbaṃ – “sammutiñāṇaṃ saccārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti? Āmantā. Nanu [P 0.0311] pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa atthi ñāṇaṃ, pathavīkasiṇañca [M 0.0234] sammutisaccamhīti? Āmantā. Hañci pathavīkasiṇaṃ samāpattiṃ samāpannassa atthi ñāṇaṃ, pathavīkasiṇañca sammutisaccamhi, tena vata re vattabbe – “sammutiñāṇaṃ saccārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti.

434. Should it not be said: “Conventional knowledge has only truth as its object, and no other object”? Yes. Is it not so that for one who has entered into the earth-kasiṇa attainment there is knowledge, and the earth-kasiṇa is a conventional truth? Yes. If for one who has entered into the earth-kasiṇa attainment there is knowledge, and the earth-kasiṇa is a conventional truth, then indeed it should be said: “Conventional knowledge has only truth as its object, and no other object.”

Na vattabbaṃ – “sammutiñāṇaṃ saccārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti? Āmantā…pe… nanu āpokasiṇaṃ…pe… tejokasiṇaṃ…pe… gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ dadantassa atthi ñāṇaṃ, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāro ca sammutisaccamhīti? Āmantā. Hañci gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ dadantassa atthi ñāṇaṃ, gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāro ca sammutisaccamhi, tena vata re vattabbe – “sammutiñāṇaṃ saccārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti.

Should it not be said: “Conventional knowledge has only truth as its object, and no other object”? Yes… Is it not so that for one who has entered the water-kasiṇa… fire-kasiṇa… for one giving medicinal requisites for the sick there is knowledge, and the medicinal requisites for the sick are a conventional truth? Yes. If for one giving medicinal requisites for the sick there is knowledge, and the medicinal requisites for the sick are a conventional truth, then indeed it should be said: “Conventional knowledge has only truth as its object, and no other object.”

435. Sammutiñāṇaṃ [V 0.0261] saccārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇanti? Āmantā[T 0.0339]. Tena ñāṇena dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

435. Does conventional knowledge have only truth as its object, and no other object? Yes. With that knowledge, does one fully understand suffering, abandon its origin, realize cessation, and develop the path? That should not be said…

Sammutiñāṇakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Conventional Knowledge is concluded.

5. Pañcamavaggo

5. The Fifth Chapter

(49) 7. Cittārammaṇakathā

(49) 7. Discourse on the Object of Consciousness

436. Cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ cittārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Nanu atthi koci “sarāgaṃ cittaṃ sarāgaṃ citta”nti pajānātīti? Āmantā. Hañci atthi koci “sarāgaṃ cittaṃ sarāgaṃ citta”nti pajānāti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ cittārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti.

436. Does the knowledge of others' minds have only mind as its object, and not another object? Yes. Is it not so that there is someone who distinctly knows, 'A mind with lust is a mind with lust'? Yes. If there is someone who distinctly knows, 'A mind with lust is a mind with lust,' then, good sir, it should not be said: 'The knowledge of others' minds has only mind as its object, and not another object.'

Nanu [P 0.0312] atthi koci vītarāgaṃ cittaṃ…pe… sadosaṃ cittaṃ… vītadosaṃ cittaṃ… samohaṃ cittaṃ… vītamohaṃ cittaṃ… saṃkhittaṃ cittaṃ… vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ… mahaggataṃ cittaṃ… amahaggataṃ cittaṃ… sauttaraṃ cittaṃ… anuttaraṃ cittaṃ… samāhitaṃ cittaṃ… asamāhitaṃ cittaṃ… vimuttaṃ cittaṃ…pe… avimuttaṃ cittaṃ “avimuttaṃ citta”nti pajānātīti? Āmantā. Hañci atthi koci “avimuttaṃ cittaṃ avimuttaṃ citta”nti pajānāti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ cittārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti.

Is it not so that there is someone who distinctly knows a mind free from lust... a mind with aversion... a mind free from aversion... a mind with delusion... a mind free from delusion... a contracted mind... a distracted mind... a sublime mind... a non-sublime mind... a surpassable mind... an unsurpassable mind... a concentrated mind... an unconcentrated mind... a liberated mind... an unliberated mind as 'an unliberated mind'? Yes. If there is someone who distinctly knows an unliberated mind as 'an unliberated mind,' then, good sir, it should not be said: 'The knowledge of others' minds has only mind as its object, and not another object.'

437. Phassārammaṇe [M 0.0235] ñāṇaṃ vattabbaṃ – “cetopariyāye ñāṇa”nti? Āmantā[T 0.0340]. Hañci phassārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ vattabbaṃ cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ cittārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti. Vedanārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ…pe… saññārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… cetanārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… cittārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… saddhārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… vīriyārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… satārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… samādhārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… paññārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… rāgārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ [V 0.0262] … dosārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ… mohārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ…pe… anottappārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ vattabbaṃ – “cetopariyāye ñāṇa”nti? Āmantā. Hañci anottappārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ vattabbaṃ cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “cetopariyāye ñāṇaṃ cittārammaṇaññeva na aññārammaṇa”nti.

437. Should knowledge that has contact as its object be called 'knowledge of others' minds'? Yes. If knowledge that has contact as its object is to be called 'knowledge of others' minds,' then, good sir, it should not be said: 'The knowledge of others' minds has only mind as its object, and not another object.' Should knowledge that has feeling as its object... perception as its object... volition as its object... mind as its object... faith as its object... energy as its object... mindfulness as its object... concentration as its object... wisdom as its object... lust as its object... aversion as its object... delusion as its object... lack of moral dread as its object be called 'knowledge of others' minds'? Yes. If knowledge that has lack of moral dread as its object is to be called 'knowledge of others' minds,' then, good sir, it should not be said: 'The knowledge of others' minds has only mind as its object, and not another object.'

Phassārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ na vattabbaṃ – “cetopariyāye ñāṇa”nti? Āmantā. Phassapariyāye ñāṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… vedanārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ…pe… saññārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ…pe… anottappārammaṇe ñāṇaṃ na vattabbaṃ – “cetopariyāye ñāṇa”nti? Āmantā. Anottappapariyāye ñāṇanti? Na [P 0.0313] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should knowledge that has contact as its object not be called 'knowledge of others' minds'? Yes. Should it be called 'knowledge of the course of contact'? That should not be said...
