Is a person endowed with sense-sphere existence endowed with three existences—with sense-sphere existence, with form existence, and with formless existence? It should not be said thus….

Arūpadhātukathā niṭṭhitā.

518. The Discussion on the Formless Element is concluded.

8. Aṭṭhamavaggo

8. The Eighth Chapter

(79) 7. Rūpadhātuyāāyatanakathā

79. Discussion on the Sense Bases in the Form Realm

519. Atthi [M 0.0278] saḷāyataniko attabhāvo rūpadhātuyāti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha ghānāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha gandhāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha jivhāyatananti? Āmantā[T 0.0403]. Atthi tattha rasāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha kāyāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

519. Is there an individual existence endowed with six sense bases in the form realm? Yes. Is the nose sense base there? Yes. Is the odor sense base there? This should not be said... and so on... Is the tongue sense base there? Yes. Is the taste sense base there? This should not be said... and so on... Is the body sense base there? Yes. Is the tangible sense base there? This should not be said... and so on...

Natthi tattha gandhāyatananti? Āmantā. Natthi tattha ghānāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… natthi tattha rasāyatananti? Āmantā. Natthi tattha jivhāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… natthi tattha phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Āmantā[P 0.0375]. Natthi tattha kāyāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there no odor sense base there? Yes. Is there no nose sense base there? This should not be said... and so on... Is there no taste sense base there? Yes. Is there no tongue sense base there? This should not be said... and so on... Is there no tangible sense base there? Yes. Is there no body sense base there? This should not be said... and so on...

520. Atthi tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ, atthi rūpāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha ghānāyatanaṃ, atthi gandhāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ, atthi rūpāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha jivhāyatanaṃ, atthi rasāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha kāyāyatanaṃ, atthi phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha sotāyatanaṃ, atthi saddāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha manāyatanaṃ, atthi dhammāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha ghānāyatanaṃ, atthi gandhāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha manāyatanaṃ, atthi dhammāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha jivhāyatanaṃ, atthi rasāyatananti…pe… atthi tattha kāyāyatanaṃ, atthi phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

520. Is the eye sense base there, and is the visible form sense base there? Yes. Is the nose sense base there, and is the odor sense base there? This should not be said... and so on... Is the eye sense base there, and is the visible form sense base there? Yes. Is the tongue sense base there, and is the taste sense base there... and so on... Is the body sense base there, and is the tangible sense base there? This should not be said... and so on... Is the ear sense base there, and is the sound sense base there... and so on... Is the mind sense base there, and is the mental object sense base there? Yes. Is the nose sense base there, and is the odor sense base there? This should not be said... and so on... Is the mind sense base there, and is the mental object sense base there? Yes. Is the tongue sense base there, and is the taste sense base there... and so on... Is the body sense base there, and is the tangible sense base there? This should not be said... and so on...

Atthi tattha ghānāyatanaṃ, natthi gandhāyatananti? Āmantā[T 0.0404]. Atthi tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ, natthi rūpāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha ghānāyatanaṃ, natthi gandhāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha sotāyatanaṃ, natthi saddāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha manāyatanaṃ, natthi dhammāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha jivhāyatanaṃ, natthi rasāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha kāyāyatanaṃ, natthi phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ, natthi rūpāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi [P 0.0376] tattha kāyāyatanaṃ, natthi phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha sotāyatanaṃ, natthi saddāyatanaṃ [M 0.0279]…pe… atthi tattha manāyatanaṃ, natthi dhammāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the nose sense base there, but not the odor sense base? Yes. Is the eye sense base there, but not the visible form sense base? This should not be said... and so on... Is the nose sense base there, but not the odor sense base? Yes. Is the ear sense base there, but not the sound sense base... and so on... Is the mind sense base there, but not the mental object sense base? This should not be said... and so on... Is the tongue sense base there, but not the taste sense base... and so on... Is the body sense base there, but not the tangible sense base? Yes. Is the eye sense base there, but not the visible form sense base? This should not be said... and so on... Is the body sense base there, but not the tangible sense base? Yes. Is the ear sense base there, but not the sound sense base... and so on... Is the mind sense base there, but not the mental object sense base? This should not be said... and so on...

521. Atthi tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ atthi rūpāyatanaṃ, tena cakkhunā taṃ rūpaṃ passatīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha ghānāyatanaṃ atthi gandhāyatanaṃ, tena ghānena taṃ gandhaṃ ghāyatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ atthi rūpāyatanaṃ, tena cakkhunā taṃ rūpaṃ passatīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha jivhāyatanaṃ atthi rasāyatanaṃ, tāya jivhāya taṃ rasaṃ sāyati…pe… atthi tattha kāyāyatanaṃ atthi phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, tena kāyena taṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

521. Are the eye sense base and the visible form sense base there, and does one see that visible form with that eye? Yes. Are the nose sense base and the odor sense base there, and does one smell that odor with that nose? This should not be said... and so on... Are the eye sense base and the visible form sense base there, and does one see that visible form with that eye? Yes. Are the tongue sense base and the taste sense base there, and does one taste that taste with that tongue... and so on... Are the body sense base and the tangible sense base there, and does one touch that tangible object with that body? This should not be said... and so on...

Atthi tattha sotāyatanaṃ atthi saddāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi [T 0.0405] tattha manāyatanaṃ atthi dhammāyatanaṃ, tena manena taṃ dhammaṃ vijānātīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha ghānāyatanaṃ atthi gandhāyatanaṃ, tena ghānena taṃ gandhaṃ ghāyatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha manāyatanaṃ atthi dhammāyatanaṃ, tena manena taṃ dhammaṃ vijānātīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha jivhāyatanaṃ atthi rasāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha kāyāyatanaṃ atthi phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, tena kāyena taṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Are the ear sense base and the sound sense base there... and so on... Are the mind sense base and the mental object sense base there, and does one cognize that mental object with that mind? Yes. Are the nose sense base and the odor sense base there, and does one smell that odor with that nose? This should not be said... and so on... Are the mind sense base and the mental object sense base there, and does one cognize that mental object with that mind? Yes. Are the tongue sense base and the taste sense base there... and so on... Are the body sense base and the tangible sense base there, and does one touch that tangible object with that body? This should not be said... and so on...

Atthi [V 0.0311] tattha ghānāyatanaṃ atthi gandhāyatanaṃ, na ca tena ghānena taṃ gandhaṃ ghāyatīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha cakkhāyatanaṃ atthi rūpāyatanaṃ, na ca tena cakkhunā taṃ rūpaṃ passatīti? Na [P 0.0377] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi tattha ghānāyatanaṃ atthi gandhāyatanaṃ, na ca tena ghānena taṃ gandhaṃ ghāyatīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha sotāyatanaṃ atthi saddāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha manāyatanaṃ atthi dhammāyatanaṃ, na ca tena manena taṃ dhammaṃ vijānātīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Are the nose sense base and the odor sense base there, but one does not smell that odor with that nose? Yes. Are the eye sense base and the visible form sense base there, but one does not see that visible form with that eye? This should not be said... and so on... Are the nose sense base and the odor sense base there, but one does not smell that odor with that nose? Yes. Are the ear sense base and the sound sense base there... and so on... Are the mind sense base and the mental object sense base there, but one does not cognize that mental object with that mind? This should not be said... and so on...

Atthi tattha jivhāyatanaṃ atthi rasāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha kāyāyatanaṃ atthi phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, na ca tena kāyena taṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusatīti? Āmantā. Atthi [T 0.0406] tattha sotāyatanaṃ atthi saddāyatanaṃ…pe… atthi tattha manāyatanaṃ atthi dhammāyatanaṃ, na ca tena manena taṃ dhammaṃ vijānātīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Are the tongue sense base and the taste sense base there... and so on... Are the body sense base and the tangible sense base there, but one does not touch that tangible object with that body? Yes. Are the ear sense base and the sound sense base there... and so on... Are the mind sense base and the mental object sense base there, but one does not cognize that mental object with that mind? This should not be said... and so on...

522. Atthi [M 0.0280] tattha ghānāyatanaṃ atthi gandhāyatanaṃ, tena ghānena taṃ gandhaṃ ghāyatīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha mūlagandho sāragandho tacagandho pattagandho pupphagandho phalagandho āmagandho vissagandho sugandho duggandhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

522. Are the nose sense base and the odor sense base there, and does one smell that odor with that nose? Yes. Are there root-odor, heartwood-odor, bark-odor, leaf-odor, flower-odor, fruit-odor, raw-odor, rank-odor, fragrant-odor, and foul-odor there? This should not be said... and so on...

Atthi tattha jivhāyatanaṃ atthi rasāyatanaṃ, tāya jivhāya taṃ rasaṃ sāyatīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha mūlaraso khandharaso tacaraso pattaraso puppharaso phalaraso ambilaṃ madhuraṃ tittakaṃ kaṭukaṃ loṇiyaṃ khāriyaṃ lambilaṃ kasāvo sādu asādūti? Na [P 0.0378] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there the tongue-base and the taste-base there, and does one taste that taste with that tongue? Yes. Is there the taste of roots, the taste of stems, the taste of bark, the taste of leaves, the taste of flowers, the taste of fruits, the sour, the sweet, the bitter, the pungent, the salty, the alkaline, the acidic, the astringent, the agreeable, and the disagreeable there? This should not be said… and so on….

Atthi tattha kāyāyatanaṃ atthi phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, tena kāyena taṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusatīti? Āmantā. Atthi tattha kakkhaḷaṃ mudukaṃ saṇhaṃ pharusaṃ sukhasamphassaṃ dukkhasamphassaṃ garukaṃ lahukanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there the body-base and the tangible-base there, and does one contact that tangible object with that body? Yes. Is there the hard, the soft, the smooth, the rough, pleasant contact, painful contact, the heavy, and the light there? This should not be said… and so on….

523. Na vattabbaṃ – “saḷāyataniko attabhāvo rūpadhātuyā”ti? Āmantā. Nanu atthi tattha ghānanimittaṃ jivhānimittaṃ kāyanimittanti? Āmantā. Hañci atthi tattha ghānanimittaṃ [V 0.0312] jivhānimittaṃ kāyanimittaṃ, tena [T 0.0407] vata re vattabbe – “saḷāyataniko attabhāvo rūpadhātuyā”ti.

523. Should it not be said, “The individual existence in the form realm possesses six sense-bases”? Yes. But is there not there the sign of the nose, the sign of the tongue, and the sign of the body? Yes. If there is there the sign of the nose, the sign of the tongue, and the sign of the body, then indeed it should be said, “The individual existence in the form realm possesses six sense-bases.”

Rūpadhātuyā āyatanakathā niṭṭhitā.

The discussion on the sense-bases in the Form Realm is concluded.

8. Aṭṭhamavaggo

8. The Eighth Chapter

(80) 8. Arūpe rūpakathā

(80) 8. Discussion of Form in the Formless Realms

524. Atthi rūpaṃ arūpesūti? Āmantā. Rūpabhavo rūpagati rūpasattāvāso rūpasaṃsāro rūpayoni rūpattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu arūpabhavo arūpagati arūpasattāvāso arūpasaṃsāro arūpayoni arūpattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Hañci arūpabhavo…pe… arūpattabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe – “atthi rūpaṃ arūpesū”ti.

524. Is there form in the formless realms? Yes. Is it form-becoming, a form-destiny, an abode of beings in form, the round of rebirths in form, a form-origin, the acquisition of an individual existence in form? This should not be said… and so on… But is it not formless-becoming, a formless-destiny, an abode of beings in the formless, the round of rebirths in the formless, a formless-origin, the acquisition of an individual existence in the formless? Yes. If it is formless-becoming… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence in the formless, then indeed it should not be said, “There is form in the formless realms.”

Atthi rūpaṃ arūpesūti? Āmantā. Pañcavokārabhavo gati sattāvāso saṃsāro yoni viññāṇaṭṭhiti attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na [P 0.0379] hevaṃ [M 0.0281] vattabbe…pe… nanu catuvokārabhavo…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Hañci catuvokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābho, no ca vata re vattabbe – “atthi rūpaṃ arūpesū”ti.

Is there form in the formless realms? Yes. Is it becoming with five constituents, a destiny, an abode of beings, the round of rebirths, an origin, a station of consciousness, and the acquisition of an individual existence? This should not be said… and so on… But is it not becoming with four constituents… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence? Yes. If it is becoming with four constituents, a destiny… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence, then indeed it should not be said, “There is form in the formless realms.”

525. Atthi rūpaṃ rūpadhātuyā, so ca rūpabhavo rūpagati rūpasattāvāso rūpasaṃsāro rūpayoni rūpattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Atthi rūpaṃ arūpesu, so ca rūpabhavo rūpagati…pe… rūpattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi rūpaṃ rūpadhātuyā, so ca pañcavokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā[T 0.0408]. Atthi rūpaṃ arūpesu, so ca pañcavokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe…. Atthi rūpaṃ arūpesu, so ca [V 0.0313] arūpabhavo arūpagati arūpasattāvāso arūpasaṃsāro arūpayoni arūpattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Atthi rūpaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā (sabbattha), so ca arūpabhavo arūpagati…pe… arūpattabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi rūpaṃ arūpesu, so ca catuvokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Āmantā. Atthi rūpaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā (sabbattha), so ca catuvokārabhavo gati…pe… attabhāvapaṭilābhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

525. Is there form in the form realm, and is that form-becoming, a form-destiny, an abode of beings in form, the round of rebirths in form, a form-origin, the acquisition of an individual existence in form? Yes. Is there form in the formless realms, and is that form-becoming, a form-destiny… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence in form? This should not be said… and so on… Is there form in the form realm, and is that becoming with five constituents, a destiny… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence? Yes. Is there form in the formless realms, and is that becoming with five constituents, a destiny… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence? This should not be said… and so on…. Is there form in the formless realms, and is that formless-becoming, a formless-destiny, an abode of beings in the formless, the round of rebirths in the formless, a formless-origin, the acquisition of an individual existence in the formless? Yes. Is there form in the form realm, and is that formless-becoming, a formless-destiny… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence in the formless? This should not be said… and so on… Is there form in the formless realms, and is that becoming with four constituents, a destiny… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence? Yes. Is there form in the form realm, and is that becoming with four constituents, a destiny… and so on… the acquisition of an individual existence? This should not be said… and so on….

526. Atthi rūpaṃ arūpesūti? Āmantā. Nanu rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ arūpaṃ itivu. 72; a. ni. 5.200; dī. ni. 3.321 vuttaṃ bhagavatāti? Āmantā. Hañci rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ arūpaṃ itivu. 72; a. ni. 5.200; dī. ni. 3.321 vuttaṃ bhagavatā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “atthi rūpaṃ arūpesū”ti.

526. Is there form in the formless realms? Yes. But has not the Blessed One said that the escape from forms is the formless? Yes. If the Blessed One has said that the escape from forms is the formless, then indeed it should not be said, “There is form in the formless realms.”

Rūpānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ arūpaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, atthi rūpaṃ arūpesūti? Āmantā[P 0.0380]. Kāmānaṃ nissaraṇaṃ nekkhammaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, atthi nekkhammesu kāmā, atthi anāsavesu āsavā, atthi apariyāpannesu pariyāpannāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

The Blessed One has said that the escape from forms is the formless; is there form in the formless realms? Yes. The Blessed One has said that the escape from sensual pleasures is renunciation; are there sensual pleasures in renunciation? Are there taints in the taintless? Are there the included in the unincluded? This should not be said… and so on….

Arūpe rūpakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion of Form in the Formless Realms is concluded.

8. Aṭṭhamavaggo

8. The Eighth Chapter

(81) 9. Rūpaṃ kammantikathā

(81) 9. Discussion on Form and Action

527. Kusalena [T 0.0409][M 0.0282] cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Hañci anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusala”nti.

527. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind, wholesome? Yes. Is it with an object? Is there for it turning towards, application, engagement, attention, volition, aspiration, and resolve? This should not be said… and so on… But is it not without an object? Is there not for it turning towards, application, engagement, attention, volition, aspiration, and resolve? Yes. If it is without an object, and there is not for it turning towards… and so on… resolve, then indeed it should not be said, “Bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind is wholesome.”

Kusalena [V 0.0314] cittena samuṭṭhito phasso kusalo sārammaṇo, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitā vedanā…pe… saññā… cetanā… saddhā… vīriyaṃ… sati… samādhi…pe… paññā kusalā sārammaṇā, atthi tāya āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Kusalena [P 0.0381] cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is contact arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and with an object? Is there for it turning towards… and so on… resolve? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and with an object? Is there for it turning towards… and so on… resolve? This should not be said… and so on… Is feeling… and so on… perception… volition… faith… energy… mindfulness… concentration… and so on… wisdom arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and with an object? Is there for it turning towards… and so on… resolve? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and with an object? Is there for it turning towards… and so on… resolve? This should not be said… and so on….

Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalaṃ anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Kusalena [T 0.0410] cittena samuṭṭhito phasso kusalo anārammaṇo, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalaṃ anārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitā vedanā…pe… saññā… cetanā… saddhā… vīriyaṃ… sati… samādhi…pe… paññā kusalā anārammaṇā, natthi tāya āvaṭṭanā…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and without an object, and is there not for it turning towards… resolve? Yes. Is contact arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and without an object, and is there not for it turning towards… resolve? It should not be said so… Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and without an object, and is there not for it turning towards… resolve? Yes. Is feeling… perception… volition… faith… energy… mindfulness… concentration… wisdom arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome and without an object, and is there not for it turning towards… resolve? It should not be said so…

528. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Yaṃ kiñci kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ kusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

528. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome? Yes. Is any form whatsoever that has arisen from a wholesome mind all wholesome? It should not be said so…

Kusalena [M 0.0283] cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ kusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… pathavīdhātu [P 0.0382]… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu kusalāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome? Yes. Is the form base arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome? It should not be said so… Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome? Yes. Are the sound base… odor base… taste base… tangible base… earth element… water element… fire element… air element arisen from a wholesome mind wholesome? It should not be said so…

Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ abyākatanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu [V 0.0315] … tejodhātu [T 0.0411] …pe… vāyodhātu abyākatāti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the form base arisen from a wholesome mind indeterminate? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind indeterminate? It should not be said so… Are the sound base… odor base… taste base… tangible base… earth element… water element… fire element… air element arisen from a wholesome mind indeterminate? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind indeterminate? It should not be said so…

529. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ anārammaṇaṃ kusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu anārammaṇā kusalāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

529. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and wholesome? Yes. Is the form base arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and wholesome? It should not be said so… Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and wholesome? Yes. Are the sound base… odor base… taste base… tangible base… earth element… water element… fire element… air element arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and wholesome? It should not be said so…

Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ anārammaṇaṃ abyākatanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ [P 0.0383]… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu anārammaṇā abyākatāti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the form base arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and indeterminate? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and indeterminate? It should not be said so… Are the sound base… odor base… taste base… tangible base… earth element… water element… fire element… air element arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and indeterminate? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind without an object and indeterminate? It should not be said so…

530. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ kusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ [M 0.0284] kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena [T 0.0412] cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu phassavippayuttā kusalāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

530. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and wholesome? Yes. Is the form base arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and wholesome? It should not be said so… Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and wholesome? Yes. Are the sound base… odor base… taste base… tangible base… earth element… water element… fire element… air element arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and wholesome? It should not be said so…

Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ abyākatanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu phassavippayuttā abyākatāti[V 0.0316]? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the form base arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and indeterminate? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and indeterminate? It should not be said so… Are the sound base… odor base… taste base… tangible base… earth element… water element… fire element… air element arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and indeterminate? Yes. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind dissociated from contact and indeterminate? It should not be said so…

531. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena [P 0.0384] cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ kusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ kāyakammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ kusalanti? Āmantā. Kusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ…pe… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu anārammaṇā phassavippayuttā kusalāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

531. Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind, without an object, dissociated from contact, and wholesome? Yes. Is the form base arisen from a wholesome mind, without an object, dissociated from contact, and wholesome? It should not be said so… Is bodily action, which is form, arisen from a wholesome mind, without an object, dissociated from contact, and wholesome? Yes. Are the sound base… odor base… taste base… tangible base… earth element… water element… fire element… air element arisen from a wholesome mind, without an object, dissociated from contact, and wholesome? It should not be said so…

Akusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ akusalanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… akusalena [T 0.0420] cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ vacīkammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ akusalanti? Āmantā. Akusalena [P 0.0391] cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu asuci assu lohitaṃ sedo anārammaṇo phassavippayutto akusaloti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is verbal action, which is form, arisen from an unwholesome mind, without an object, dissociated from contact, and unwholesome? Yes. Is the form base arisen from an unwholesome mind, without an object, dissociated from contact, and unwholesome? It should not be said thus… Is verbal action, which is form, arisen from an unwholesome mind, without an object, dissociated from contact, and unwholesome? Yes. Is the sound base… the smell base… the taste base… the tangible base… the earth element… the water element… the fire element… the air element, semen, tears, blood, or sweat, without an object, dissociated from contact, and unwholesome? It should not be said thus…

Akusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ rūpāyatanaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ abyākatanti? Āmantā. Akusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ vacīkammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… akusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ saddāyatanaṃ…pe… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu asuci assu lohitaṃ sedo anārammaṇo phassavippayutto abyākatoti? Āmantā. Akusalena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ vacīkammaṃ rūpaṃ anārammaṇaṃ phassavippayuttaṃ abyākatanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the form base produced by an unwholesome mind objectless, dissociated from contact, and indeterminate? Yes. Is verbal action, which is form, produced by an unwholesome mind, objectless, dissociated from contact, and indeterminate? It should not be said thus... Is the sound base... smell base... taste base... tangible base... earth element... water element... fire element... air element, semen, tears, blood, or sweat objectless, dissociated from contact, and indeterminate? Yes. Is verbal action, which is form, produced by an unwholesome mind, objectless, dissociated from contact, and indeterminate? It should not be said thus...

538. Na vattabbaṃ – “rūpaṃ kusalampi akusalampī”ti? Āmantā. Nanu kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ kusalampi akusalampīti? Āmantā. Hañci kāyakammaṃ vacīkammaṃ kusalampi akusalampi, tena vata re vattabbe – “rūpaṃ kusalampi akusalampī”ti.

538. Should it not be said, ‘Form is both wholesome and unwholesome’? Yes. Is it not so that bodily action and verbal action are both wholesome and unwholesome? Yes. If bodily action and verbal action are both wholesome and unwholesome, then indeed, sir, it should be said, ‘Form is both wholesome and unwholesome’.

Rūpaṃ kusalampi akusalampīti? Āmantā. Cakkhāyatanaṃ kusalampi [T 0.0421] akusalampīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… rūpaṃ kusalampi akusalampīti? Āmantā. Sotāyatanaṃ…pe… ghānāyatanaṃ… jivhāyatanaṃ… kāyāyatanaṃ… rūpāyatanaṃ… saddāyatanaṃ… gandhāyatanaṃ… rasāyatanaṃ [P 0.0392]… phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ… pathavīdhātu… āpodhātu… tejodhātu…pe… vāyodhātu asuci assu lohitaṃ sedo kusalopi akusalopīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is form both wholesome and unwholesome? Yes. Is the eye base both wholesome and unwholesome? It should not be said thus… Is form both wholesome and unwholesome? Yes. Is the ear base… the nose base… the tongue base… the body base… the form base… the sound base… the smell base… the taste base… the tangible base… the earth element… the water element… the fire element… the air element, semen, tears, blood, or sweat, both wholesome and unwholesome? It should not be said thus…

Kāyo rūpaṃ, kāyakammaṃ rūpanti? Āmantā. Mano rūpaṃ, manokammaṃ rūpanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe [V 0.0322] …pe… mano arūpaṃ, manokammaṃ arūpanti? Āmantā. Kāyo arūpaṃ, kāyakammaṃ arūpanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the body form, and is bodily action form? Yes. Is the mind form, and is mental action form? It should not be said thus… Is the mind formless, and is mental action formless? Yes. Is the body formless, and is bodily action formless? It should not be said thus…

Kāyo [M 0.0290] rūpanti, kāyakammaṃ rūpanti? Āmantā. Cakkhāyatanaṃ rūpanti, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ rūpanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kāyo rūpanti, kāyakammaṃ rūpanti? Āmantā. Sotāyatanaṃ rūpanti, sotaviññāṇaṃ rūpanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kāyo rūpanti, kāyakammaṃ rūpanti? Āmantā. Ghānāyatanaṃ rūpanti, ghānaviññāṇaṃ rūpanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kāyo rūpanti, kāyakammaṃ rūpanti? Āmantā. Jivhāyatanaṃ rūpanti, jivhāviññāṇaṃ rūpanti[T 0.0422]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kāyo rūpanti, kāyakammaṃ rūpanti? Āmantā. Kāyāyatanaṃ [P 0.0393] rūpanti, kāyaviññāṇaṃ rūpanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the body form, and is bodily action form? Yes. Is the eye-base form, and is eye-consciousness form? It should not be said thus… Is the body form, and is bodily action form? Yes. Is the ear-base form, and is ear-consciousness form? It should not be said thus… Is the body form, and is bodily action form? Yes. Is the nose-base form, and is nose-consciousness form? It should not be said thus… Is the body form, and is bodily action form? Yes. Is the tongue-base form, and is tongue-consciousness form? It should not be said thus… Is the body form, and is bodily action form? Yes. Is the body-base form, and is body-consciousness form? It should not be said thus…

539. Rūpaṃ kammanti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “cetanāhaṃ, bhikkhave, kammaṃ vadāmi; cetayitvā kammaṃ karoti kāyena vācāya manasā”ti a. ni. 6.63 nibbedhikasutte! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “rūpaṃ kamma”nti.

539. Is form kamma? Yes. But has the Blessed One not said: “Monks, I declare volition to be kamma; having intended, one performs kamma by body, speech, or mind”? Is there indeed such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said that ‘form is kamma’.

Rūpaṃ kammanti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “kāye vā, ānanda hānanda (saṃ. ni. 2.25), sati kāyasañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ; vācāya vā, ānanda hānanda (saṃ. ni. 2.25), sati vacīsañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ; mane vā, ānanda hānanda (saṃ. ni. 2.25), sati manosañcetanāhetu uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkha”nti saṃ. ni. 2.25; a. ni. 4.171! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “rūpaṃ kamma”nti.

Is form kamma? Yes. But has the Blessed One not said: “Ānanda, when there is a body, internal pleasure and suffering arise due to bodily volition as a cause; Ānanda, when there is speech, internal pleasure and suffering arise due to verbal volition as a cause; Ānanda, when there is mind, internal pleasure and suffering arise due to mental volition as a cause”? Is there indeed such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said that ‘form is kamma’.

Rūpaṃ kammanti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “tividhā, bhikkhave, kāyasañcetanā akusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ; catubbidhā, bhikkhave, vacīsañcetanā akusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ; tividhā, bhikkhave, manosañcetanā akusalaṃ manokammaṃ dukkhudrayaṃ dukkhavipākaṃ; tividhā, bhikkhave, kāyasañcetanā kusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ sukhudrayaṃ sukhavipākaṃ; catubbidhā, bhikkhave, vacīsañcetanā kusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ sukhudrayaṃ sukhavipākaṃ; tividhā[T 0.0423], bhikkhave, manosañcetanā kusalaṃ manokammaṃ sukhudrayaṃ sukhavipāka”nti a. ni. 10.217 thokaṃ pana visadisaṃ! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena [P 0.0394] hi na vattabbaṃ – “rūpaṃ kamma”nti.

Is form kamma? Yes. But has the Blessed One not said: “Monks, threefold bodily volition is unwholesome bodily kamma, a cause of suffering, with a result of suffering; fourfold verbal volition is unwholesome verbal kamma, a cause of suffering, with a result of suffering; threefold mental volition is unwholesome mental kamma, a cause of suffering, with a result of suffering. Monks, threefold bodily volition is wholesome bodily kamma, a cause of pleasure, with a result of pleasure; fourfold verbal volition is wholesome verbal kamma, a cause of pleasure, with a result of pleasure; threefold mental volition is wholesome mental kamma, a cause of pleasure, with a result of pleasure”? Is there indeed such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said that ‘form is kamma’.

Rūpaṃ [V 0.0323] kammanti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “sacāyaṃ, ānanda, samiddhi moghapuriso pāṭaliputtassa potaliputtassa (ma. ni. 3.300) paribbājakassa evaṃ puṭṭho evaṃ byākareyya – ‘sañcetaniyaṃ[M 0.0291], āvuso pāṭaliputta, kammaṃ katvā kāyena vācāya manasā sukhavedaniyaṃ sukhaṃ so vedayati; sañcetaniyaṃ, āvuso pāṭaliputta, kammaṃ katvā kāyena vācāya manasā dukkhavedaniyaṃ dukkhaṃ so vedayati; sañcetaniyaṃ, āvuso pāṭaliputta, kammaṃ katvā kāyena vācāya manasā adukkhamasukhavedaniyaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ so vedayatī’ti, evaṃ byākaramāno kho, ānanda, samiddhi moghapuriso pāṭaliputtassa paribbājakassa sammā byākaramāno byākareyyā”ti ma. ni. 3.300! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi na vattabbaṃ – “rūpaṃ kamma”nti.

Is form kamma? Yes. But has the Blessed One not said: “Ānanda, if this foolish man Samiddhi, when questioned thus by the wanderer Pāṭaliputta, were to answer in this way: ‘Friend Pāṭaliputta, having performed a volitional kamma by body, speech, or mind, one experiences a pleasure that is to be felt as pleasant; having performed a volitional kamma by body, speech, or mind, one experiences a suffering that is to be felt as suffering; having performed a volitional kamma by body, speech, or mind, one experiences a neither-suffering-nor-pleasure that is to be felt as neither-suffering-nor-pleasure,’ then, Ānanda, in answering thus, the foolish man Samiddhi would be answering correctly to the wanderer Pāṭaliputta”? Is there indeed such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, it should not be said that ‘form is kamma’.

Rūpaṃ kammantikathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion on ‘Is Form Kamma?’ is concluded.

8. Aṭṭhamavaggo

8. The Eighth Chapter

(82) 10. Jīvitindriyakathā

8. 10. Discussion on the Life Faculty

540. Natthi rūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Natthi rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā [T 0.0424] iriyanā vattanā pālanāti? Āmantā. Hañci atthi rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā, no ca vata re vattabbe – “natthi rūpajīvitindriya”nti.

Is there no material life faculty? Yes. Is there no life, duration, maintenance, continuance, proceeding, progression, or preservation for material phenomena? It should not be said thus... Is there life, duration, maintenance, continuance, proceeding, progression, or preservation for material phenomena? Yes. If there is life, duration, maintenance, continuance, proceeding, progression, or preservation for material phenomena, then indeed, it should not be said that ‘there is no material life faculty’.

Atthi [P 0.0395] arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā, atthi arūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Atthi rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā, atthi rūpajīvitindriyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… atthi rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā, natthi rūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā[V 0.0324]. Atthi arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā, natthi arūpajīvitindriyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

540. Is there for immaterial phenomena life, duration, maintenance, continuance, proceeding, progression, or preservation, and is there an immaterial life faculty? Yes. Is there for material phenomena life, duration, maintenance, continuance, proceeding, progression, or preservation, and is there a material life faculty? It should not be said thus... Is there for material phenomena life, duration, maintenance, continuance, proceeding, progression, or preservation, and is there no material life faculty? Yes. Is there for immaterial phenomena life, duration, maintenance, continuance, proceeding, progression, or preservation, and is there no immaterial life faculty? It should not be said thus...

Arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu arūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu rūpajīvitindriyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu na vattabbaṃ – “rūpajīvitindriya”nti? Āmantā. Arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu na vattabbaṃ – “arūpajīvitindriya”nti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

For immaterial phenomena, is their life the immaterial life faculty? Yes. For material phenomena, is their life the material life faculty? It should not be said thus... For material phenomena, should their life not be called ‘the material life faculty’? Yes. For immaterial phenomena, should their life not be called ‘the immaterial life faculty’? It should not be said thus...

541. Rūpīnaṃ [M 0.0292] dhammānaṃ āyu arūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu rūpajīvitindriyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the life of material phenomena the immaterial life faculty? Yes. Is the life of immaterial phenomena the material life faculty? It should not be said thus...

Arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu na vattabbaṃ – “rūpajīvitindriya”nti? Āmantā. Rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu na vattabbaṃ – “arūpajīvitindriya”nti? Na [T 0.0425] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

541. For immaterial phenomena, should their life not be called ‘the material life faculty’? Yes. For material phenomena, should their life not be called ‘the immaterial life faculty’? It should not be said thus...

Rūpīnañca arūpīnañca dhammānaṃ āyu arūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Rūpīnañca arūpīnañca dhammānaṃ āyu rūpajīvitindriyanti? Na [P 0.0396] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the life of both material and immaterial phenomena the immaterial life faculty? Yes. Is the life of both material and immaterial phenomena the material life faculty? It should not be said thus...

Rūpīnañca arūpīnañca dhammānaṃ āyu na vattabbaṃ – “rūpajīvitindriya”nti? Āmantā. Rūpīnañca arūpīnañca dhammānaṃ āyu na vattabbaṃ – “arūpajīvitindriya”nti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… natthi rūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Nirodhaṃ samāpannassa natthi jīvitindriyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Should the life of both material and immaterial phenomena not be called ‘the material life faculty’? Yes. Should the life of both material and immaterial phenomena not be called ‘the immaterial life faculty’? It should not be said thus... Is there no material life faculty? Yes. For one who has attained the attainment of cessation, is there no life faculty? It should not be said thus...

542. Nirodhaṃ samāpannassa atthi jīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Hañci nirodhaṃ samāpannassa atthi jīvitindriyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “natthi rūpajīvitindriya”nti.

For one who has attained the attainment of cessation, is there a life faculty? Yes. If for one who has attained the attainment of cessation there is a life faculty, then indeed, it should not be said that ‘there is no material life faculty’.

Nirodhaṃ samāpannassa atthi jīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Katamakkhandhapariyāpannanti? Saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannanti. Nirodhaṃ samāpannassa atthi saṅkhārakkhandhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

542. For one who has attained the attainment of cessation, is there a life faculty? Yes. In which aggregate is it included? It is included in the aggregate of formations. For one who has attained the attainment of cessation, is there the aggregate of formations? It should not be said thus...

Nirodhaṃ [V 0.0325] samāpannassa atthi saṅkhārakkhandhoti? Āmantā. Nirodhaṃ samāpannassa atthi vedanākkhandho…pe… saññākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

For one who has attained the attainment of cessation, is there the aggregate of formations? Yes. For one who has attained the attainment of cessation, is there the aggregate of feeling... the aggregate of perception... the aggregate of consciousness? It should not be said thus...

Nirodhaṃ samāpannassa atthi vedanākkhandho…pe… saññākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandhoti? Āmantā. Na nirodhaṃ [T 0.0426] samāpannoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

For one who has attained the attainment of cessation, is there the aggregate of feeling... the aggregate of perception... the aggregate of consciousness? Yes. Has one then not attained cessation? It should not be said thus...

543. Natthi rūpajīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Asaññasattānaṃ natthi jīvitindriyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there no material life faculty? Yes. For non-percipient beings, is there no life faculty? It should not be said thus...

Asaññasattānaṃ atthi jīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Hañci [P 0.0397] asaññasattānaṃ atthi jīvitindriyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “natthi rūpajīvitindriya”nti. Asaññasattānaṃ atthi jīvitindriyanti? Āmantā. Katamakkhandhapariyāpannanti? Saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannanti. Asaññasattānaṃ atthi saṅkhārakkhandhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there a life faculty for non-percipient beings? Yes. If there is a life faculty for non-percipient beings, then indeed, O good sir, it should not be said that ‘there is no material life faculty’. Is there a life faculty for non-percipient beings? Yes. In which aggregate is it included? It is included in the aggregate of formations. Is there the aggregate of formations for non-percipient beings? It should not be said thus…

Asaññasattānaṃ [M 0.0293] atthi saṅkhārakkhandhoti? Āmantā. Asaññasattānaṃ atthi vedanākkhandho…pe… saññākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandhoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is there the aggregate of formations for non-percipient beings? Yes. For non-percipient beings, is there the aggregate of feeling… the aggregate of perception… the aggregate of consciousness? It should not be said thus…

Asaññasattānaṃ atthi vedanākkhandho…pe… saññākkhandho…pe… viññāṇakkhandhoti? Āmantā. Pañcavokārabhavoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

For non-percipient beings, is there the aggregate of feeling… the aggregate of perception… the aggregate of consciousness? Yes. Is it then the five-constituent existence? It should not be said thus…

544. Upapattesiyena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ upapattesiye citte bhijjamāne ekadesaṃ bhijjatīti? Āmantā. Upapattesiyena cittena samuṭṭhito phasso upapattesiye citte bhijjamāne ekadeso bhijjatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

544. When the consciousness that seeks rebirth is perishing, does the life faculty that arose from that consciousness perish in part? Yes. When the consciousness that seeks rebirth is perishing, does the contact that arose from that consciousness perish in part? It should not be said thus…

Upapattesiyena cittena samuṭṭhito phasso upapattesiye citte bhijjamāne anavaseso bhijjatīti? Āmantā. Upapattesiyena cittena samuṭṭhitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ upapattesiye citte bhijjamāne anavasesaṃ [T 0.0427] bhijjatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

When the consciousness that seeks rebirth is perishing, does the contact that arose from that consciousness perish without remainder? Yes. When the consciousness that seeks rebirth is perishing, does the life faculty that arose from that consciousness perish without remainder? It should not be said thus…

545. Dve [V 0.0326] jīvitindriyānīti? Āmantā. Dvīhi jīvitehi jīvati, dvīhi maraṇehi mīyatīti? Āmantā na hevaṃ vattabbe (syā. kaṃ. pī.).

545. Are there two life faculties? Yes. Does one live by means of two lives and die by means of two deaths? Yes.

Jīvitindriyakathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discussion on the Life Faculty is concluded.

8. Aṭṭhamavaggo

8. The Eighth Chapter

(83) 11. Kammahetukathā

11. Discourse on Kamma as Cause

546. Kammahetu [P 0.0398] arahā arahattā parihāyatīti? Āmantā. Kammahetu sotāpanno sotāpattiphalā parihāyatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kammahetu arahā arahattā parihāyatīti? Āmantā. Kammahetu sakadāgāmī…pe… anāgāmī anāgāmiphalā parihāyatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

546. Does an Arahant fall away from Arahantship on account of kamma as the cause? Yes. Does a stream-enterer fall away from the fruit of stream-entry on account of kamma as the cause? It should not be said thus… Does an Arahant fall away from Arahantship on account of kamma as the cause? Yes. Does a once-returner… or a non-returner fall away from the fruit of non-returning on account of kamma as the cause? It should not be said thus…

Kammahetu sotāpanno sotāpattiphalā na parihāyatīti? Āmantā. Kammahetu arahā arahattā na parihāyatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe [M 0.0294] …pe… kammahetu sakadāgāmī…pe… anāgāmī anāgāmiphalā na parihāyatīti? Āmantā. Kammahetu arahā arahattā na parihāyatīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does a stream-enterer not fall away from the fruit of stream-entry on account of kamma as the cause? Yes. Does an Arahant not fall away from Arahantship on account of kamma as the cause? It should not be said thus... Does a once-returner... or a non-returner not fall away from the fruit of non-returning on account of kamma as the cause? Yes. Does an Arahant not fall away from Arahantship on account of kamma as the cause? It should not be said thus...

Kammahetu arahā arahattā parihāyatīti? Āmantā. Pāṇātipātakammassa hetūti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… adinnādānakammassa hetu…pe… kāmesumicchācārakammassa hetu… musāvādakammassa [T 0.0428] hetu… pisuṇavācākammassa hetu… pharusavācākammassa hetu… samphappalāpakammassa hetu… mātughātakammassa mātughātakakammassa (syā.), mātughātikammassa (ka.) tathā pitughātaarahantaghātakammassātipadesu hetu… pitughātakammassa hetu… arahantaghātakammassa hetu… ruhiruppādakammassa hetu…pe… saṅghabhedakammassa hetūti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does an Arahant fall away from Arahantship on account of kamma as the cause? Yes. Is it on account of the kamma of killing living beings? It should not be said thus... on account of the kamma of taking what is not given... on account of the kamma of sexual misconduct... on account of the kamma of false speech... on account of the kamma of divisive speech... on account of the kamma of harsh speech... on account of the kamma of idle chatter... on account of the kamma of matricide... on account of the kamma of patricide... on account of the kamma of killing an Arahant... on account of the kamma of shedding the Buddha’s blood... on account of the kamma of causing a schism in the Saᅈgha? It should not be said thus...

Katamassa [V 0.0327] kammassa hetūti? Handa hi arahantānaṃ abbhācikkhatīti. Arahantānaṃ [P 0.0399] abbhācikkhanakammassa hetu arahā arahattā parihāyatīti? Āmantā. Ye keci arahantānaṃ abbhācikkhanti, sabbe te arahattaṃ sacchikarontīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

On account of which kamma? Well now, it is on account of falsely accusing Arahants. Does an Arahant fall away from Arahantship on account of the kamma of falsely accusing Arahants? Yes. Do all those who falsely accuse Arahants realize Arahantship? It should not be said thus...

Kammahetukathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on Kamma as Cause is concluded.

Aṭṭhamavaggo.

The Eighth Chapter.

Tassuddānaṃ –

The Recapitulation:

Cha gatiyo, antarābhavo, pañceva kāmaguṇā kāmadhātu, pañceva āyatanā kāmā, rūpino dhammā rūpadhātu, arūpino dhammā arūpadhātu, saḷāyataniko attabhāvo rūpadhātuyā, atthi rūpaṃ arūpesu, rūpaṃ kammaṃ, rūpaṃ jīvitaṃ, kammahetukā parihāyatīti.

Six destinations; intermediate existence; the five cords of sensual pleasure are the sense-sphere realm; the five sense bases are sensual pleasures; material phenomena are the form realm; immaterial phenomena are the formless realm; the six-sense-base personality in the form realm; there is form in the formless realms; form is kamma; form is life; one falls away on account of kamma as the cause.

9. Navamavaggo

9. The Ninth Chapter

(84) 1. Ānisaṃsadassāvīkathā

(84) 1. 1. Discourse on One Who Sees the Advantage

547. Ānisaṃsadassāvissa [T 0.0429][P 0.0400] saṃyojanānaṃ pahānanti? Āmantā. Nanu saṅkhāre aniccato manasikaroto saṃyojanā pahīyantīti? Āmantā. Hañci [M 0.0295] saṅkhāre aniccato manasikaroto saṃyojanā pahīyanti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “ānisaṃsadassāvissa saṃyojanānaṃ pahāna”nti.

547. Is there the abandoning of fetters for one who sees the advantage? Yes. Is it not the case that for one who attends to formations as impermanent, the fetters are abandoned? Yes. If for one who attends to formations as impermanent, the fetters are abandoned, then, good sir, you should not say: 'There is the abandoning of fetters for one who sees the advantage.'

Nanu saṅkhāre dukkhato…pe… rogato… gaṇḍato… sallato… aghato… ābādhato… parato… palokato… ītito… upaddavato… bhayato… upasaggato… calato… pabhaṅguto… addhuvato… atāṇato… aleṇato… asaraṇato… asaraṇībhūtato… rittato… tucchato… suññato… anattato… ādīnavato…pe… vipariṇāmadhammato manasikaroto saṃyojanā pahīyantīti? Āmantā. Hañci saṅkhāre vipariṇāmadhammato manasikaroto saṃyojanā pahīyanti, no ca vata re vattabbe – “ānisaṃsadassāvissa saṃyojanānaṃ pahāna”nti.

Is it not that by attending to formations as suffering… as a disease… as a boil… as a dart… as misery… as an affliction… as other… as perishable… as a blight… as a calamity… as fear… as a harassment… as unsteady… as crumbling… as not lasting… as without protection… as without shelter… as without refuge… as without recourse… as empty… as hollow… as void… as not-self… as a disadvantage… as subject to change, the fetters are abandoned? Yes. If by attending to formations as subject to change the fetters are abandoned, then it should not be said: 'There is abandoning of the fetters for one who sees the advantage.'

Saṅkhāre [V 0.0328] ca aniccato manasi karoti nibbāne ca ānisaṃsadassāvī hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhāre ca aniccato manasi karoti nibbāne ca ānisaṃsadassāvī hotīti? Āmantā. Dvinnaṃ phassānaṃ…pe… dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ samodhānaṃ hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhāre ca dukkhato…pe… vipariṇāmadhammato manasi karoti nibbāne ca ānisaṃsadassāvī hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhāre ca [T 0.0430] vipariṇāmadhammato manasi karoti nibbāne ca ānisaṃsadassāvī hotīti? Āmantā[P 0.0401]. Dvinnaṃ phassānaṃ…pe… dvinnaṃ cittānaṃ samodhānaṃ hotīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Does one attend to formations as impermanent and is one who sees the advantage in Nibbāna? It should not be said thus… Does one attend to formations as impermanent and is one who sees the advantage in Nibbāna? Yes. Is there a confluence of two contacts… of two minds? It should not be said thus… Does one attend to formations as suffering… as subject to change and is one who sees the advantage in Nibbāna? It should not be said thus… Does one attend to formations as subject to change and is one who sees the advantage in Nibbāna? Yes. Is there a confluence of two contacts… of two minds? It should not be said thus…

548. Na vattabbaṃ – “ānisaṃsadassāvissa saṃyojanānaṃ pahāna”nti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nibbāne sukhānupassī viharati sukhasaññī sukhapaṭisaṃvedī, satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno”ti a. ni. 7.19! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi ānisaṃsadassāvissa saṃyojanānaṃ pahānanti.

548. Should it not be said: 'For one who sees the advantage, there is the abandoning of fetters'? It should not be said. Has it not been said by the Blessed One: 'Here, monks, a monk dwells contemplating happiness in Nibbāna, perceiving happiness, experiencing happiness, constantly, calmly, secludedly, being resolved with his mind and penetrating it with wisdom'? Is there indeed such a Suttanta? Yes. Therefore, for one who sees the advantage, there is the abandoning of fetters.

Ānisaṃsadassāvīkathā niṭṭhitā.

The Discourse on One Who Sees the Advantage is concluded.

9. Navamavaggo

9. The Ninth Chapter

(85) 2. Amatārammaṇakathā

9. 2. Discourse on the Deathless as Object

549. Amatārammaṇaṃ saṃyojananti? Āmantā. Amataṃ saṃyojaniyaṃ ganthaniyaṃ oghaniyaṃ yoganiyaṃ nīvaraṇiyaṃ parāmaṭṭhaṃ upādāniyaṃ saṃkilesiyanti? Na [M 0.0296] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu amataṃ asaṃyojaniyaṃ aganthaniyaṃ…pe… asaṃkilesiyanti? Āmantā. Hañci amataṃ asaṃyojaniyaṃ…pe… asaṃkilesiyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “amatārammaṇaṃ saṃyojana”nti.

Do fetters have the Deathless as their object? Yes. Is the Deathless an object for fetters, an object for ties, an object for floods, an object for yokes, an object for hindrances, an object for grasping, an object for clinging, an object for defilements? It should not be said thus... Is it not that the Deathless is not an object for fetters, not an object for ties... not an object for defilements? Yes. If the Deathless is not an object for fetters... not an object for defilements, then it should certainly not be said, 'Fetters have the Deathless as their object.'

Amataṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjatīti? Āmantā. Amataṃ rāgaṭṭhāniyaṃ rajaniyaṃ kamaniyaṃ madaniyaṃ bandhaniyaṃ mucchaniyanti? Na [P 0.0402] hevaṃ [T 0.0431] vattabbe…pe… nanu amataṃ na rāgaṭṭhāniyaṃ na rajaniyaṃ na kamaniyaṃ na madaniyaṃ na bandhaniyaṃ na mucchaniyanti? Āmantā. Hañci amataṃ na rāgaṭṭhāniyaṃ na rajaniyaṃ na kamaniyaṃ na madaniyaṃ na bandhaniyaṃ na mucchaniyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “amataṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjatī”ti.

549. Taking the Deathless as an object, does lust arise? Yes. Is the Deathless a basis for lust, an object of passion, an object of desire, an object of intoxication, an object of bondage, an object of infatuation? It should not be said thus... Is it not that the Deathless is not a basis for lust, not an object of passion, not an object of desire, not an object of intoxication, not an object of bondage, not an object of infatuation? Yes. If the Deathless is not a basis for lust, not an object of passion, not an object of desire, not an object of intoxication, not an object of bondage, not an object of infatuation, then it should certainly not be said, 'Taking the Deathless as an object, lust arises.'

Amataṃ ārabbha doso uppajjatīti? Āmantā. Amataṃ dosaṭṭhāniyaṃ kopaṭṭhāniyaṃ paṭighaṭṭhāniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu amataṃ na dosaṭṭhāniyaṃ na kopaṭṭhāniyaṃ na paṭighaṭṭhāniyanti? Āmantā. Hañci amataṃ na dosaṭṭhāniyaṃ na kopaṭṭhāniyaṃ na paṭighaṭṭhāniyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “amataṃ ārabbha doso uppajjatī”ti.

Taking the Deathless as an object, does aversion arise? Yes. Is the Deathless a basis for aversion, a basis for anger, a basis for resentment? It should not be said thus... Is it not that the Deathless is not a basis for aversion, not a basis for anger, not a basis for resentment? Yes. If the Deathless is not a basis for aversion, not a basis for anger, not a basis for resentment, then it should certainly not be said, 'Taking the Deathless as an object, aversion arises.'

Amataṃ ārabbha moho uppajjatīti? Āmantā. Amataṃ mohaṭṭhāniyaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ paññānirodhiyaṃ vighātapakkhiyaṃ anibbānasaṃvattaniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu amataṃ na mohaṭṭhāniyaṃ na aññāṇakaraṇaṃ na acakkhukaraṇaṃ paññābuddhiyaṃ avighātapakkhiyaṃ nibbānasaṃvattaniyanti? Āmantā. Hañci amataṃ na mohaṭṭhāniyaṃ na aññāṇakaraṇaṃ…pe… nibbānasaṃvattaniyaṃ, no ca vata re vattabbe – “amataṃ ārabbha moho uppajjatī”ti.

Taking the Deathless as an object, does delusion arise? Yes. Is the Deathless a basis for delusion, a cause of ignorance, a cause of blindness, an obstruction to wisdom, on the side of distress, not conducive to Nibbāna? It should not be said thus... Is it not that the Deathless is not a basis for delusion, not a cause of ignorance, not a cause of blindness, but is for the increase of wisdom, on the side of non-distress, and conducive to Nibbāna? Yes. If the Deathless is not a basis for delusion, not a cause of ignorance... and is conducive to Nibbāna, then it should certainly not be said, 'Taking the Deathless as an object, delusion arises.'

550. Rūpaṃ [V 0.0330] ārabbha saṃyojanā uppajjanti, rūpaṃ saṃyojaniyaṃ ganthaniyaṃ…pe… saṃkilesiyanti? Āmantā[P 0.0403]. Amataṃ ārabbha saṃyojanā uppajjanti, amataṃ saṃyojaniyaṃ…pe… saṃkilesiyanti[T 0.0432]? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking form as an object, do fetters arise, and is form an object for fetters, an object for ties... an object for defilements? Yes. Taking the Deathless as an object, do fetters arise, and is the Deathless an object for fetters... an object for defilements? It should not be said thus...

Rūpaṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, rūpaṃ rāgaṭṭhāniyaṃ rajaniyaṃ kamaniyaṃ madaniyaṃ bandhaniyaṃ mucchaniyanti? Āmantā. Amataṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, amataṃ rāgaṭṭhāniyaṃ…pe… mucchaniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

550. Taking form as an object, does lust arise, and is form a basis for lust, an object of passion, an object of desire, an object of intoxication, an object of bondage, an object of infatuation? Yes. Taking the Deathless as an object, does lust arise, and is the Deathless a basis for lust... an object of infatuation? It should not be said thus...

Rūpaṃ ārabbha doso uppajjati, rūpaṃ dosaṭṭhāniyaṃ kopaṭṭhāniyaṃ paṭighaṭṭhāniyanti? Āmantā. Amataṃ ārabbha doso uppajjati, amataṃ dosaṭṭhāniyaṃ kopaṭṭhāniyaṃ paṭighaṭṭhāniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking form as an object, does aversion arise, and is form a basis for aversion, a basis for anger, a basis for resentment? Yes. Taking the Deathless as an object, does aversion arise, and is the Deathless a basis for aversion, a basis for anger, a basis for resentment? It should not be said thus...

Rūpaṃ [M 0.0297] ārabbha moho uppajjati, rūpaṃ mohaṭṭhāniyaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ…pe… anibbānasaṃvattaniyanti? Āmantā. Amataṃ ārabbha moho uppajjati, amataṃ mohaṭṭhāniyaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ…pe… anibbānasaṃvattaniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking form as an object, does delusion arise, and is form a basis for delusion, a cause of ignorance... not conducive to Nibbāna? Yes. Taking the Deathless as an object, does delusion arise, and is the Deathless a basis for delusion, a cause of ignorance... not conducive to Nibbāna? It should not be said thus...

Amataṃ ārabbha saṃyojanā uppajjanti, amataṃ asaṃyojaniyaṃ aganthaniyaṃ anoghaniyaṃ ayoganiyaṃ anīvaraṇiyaṃ aparāmaṭṭhaṃ anupādāniyaṃ asaṃkilesiyanti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ ārabbha saṃyojanā uppajjanti, rūpaṃ asaṃyojaniyaṃ aganthaniyaṃ…pe… asaṃkilesiyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking the Deathless as an object, do fetters arise, and is the Deathless not an object for fetters, not an object for ties, not an object for floods, not an object for yokes, not an object for hindrances, not an object for grasping, not an object for clinging, not an object for defilements? Yes. Taking form as an object, do fetters arise, and is form not an object for fetters, not an object for ties... not an object for defilements? It should not be said thus...

Amataṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, amataṃ na rāgaṭṭhāniyaṃ na rajaniyaṃ na kamaniyaṃ na madaniyaṃ na bandhaniyaṃ na mucchaniyanti? Āmantā[T 0.0433]. Rūpaṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, rūpaṃ na rāgaṭṭhāniyaṃ…pe… na mucchaniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking the Deathless as an object, does lust arise, and is the Deathless not a basis for lust, not an object of passion, not an object of desire, not an object of intoxication, not an object of bondage, not an object of infatuation? Yes. Taking form as an object, does lust arise, and is form not a basis for lust... not an object of infatuation? It should not be said thus...

Amataṃ [P 0.0404] ārabbha doso uppajjati, amataṃ na dosaṭṭhāniyaṃ na kopaṭṭhāniyaṃ na paṭighaṭṭhāniyanti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ ārabbha doso uppajjati, rūpaṃ na dosaṭṭhāniyaṃ na kopaṭṭhāniyaṃ na paṭighaṭṭhāniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking the Deathless as an object, does aversion arise, and is the Deathless not a basis for aversion, not a basis for anger, not a basis for resentment? Yes. Taking form as an object, does aversion arise, and is form not a basis for aversion, not a basis for anger, not a basis for resentment? It should not be said thus...

Amataṃ ārabbha moho uppajjati, amataṃ na mohaṭṭhāniyaṃ na aññāṇakaraṇaṃ…pe… nibbānasaṃvattaniyanti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ ārabbha moho uppajjati, rūpaṃ na mohaṭṭhāniyaṃ na aññāṇakaraṇaṃ…pe… nibbānasaṃvattaniyanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Taking the Deathless as an object, does delusion arise, and is the Deathless not a basis for delusion, not a cause of ignorance... and conducive to Nibbāna? Yes. Taking form as an object, does delusion arise, and is form not a basis for delusion, not a cause of ignorance... and conducive to Nibbāna? It should not be said thus...

551. Na vattabbaṃ – “amatārammaṇaṃ saṃyojana”nti? Āmantā. Nanu vuttaṃ bhagavatā – “nibbānaṃ nibbānato sañjānāti, nibbānaṃ nibbānato sañjānitvā nibbānaṃ maññati, nibbānasmiṃ maññati, nibbānato maññati, nibbānaṃ meti maññati, nibbānaṃ abhinandatī”ti ma. ni. 1.6! Attheva suttantoti? Āmantā. Tena hi amatārammaṇaṃ saṃyojananti.

Should it not be said, 'Fetters have the Deathless as their object'? It should not be said. But has it not been said by the Blessed One: 'One perceives Nibbāna as Nibbāna; having perceived Nibbāna as Nibbāna, one conceives Nibbāna, one conceives in Nibbāna, one conceives from Nibbāna, one conceives, "Nibbāna is mine," and one delights in Nibbāna'? Is there such a Sutta? Yes. Therefore, fetters have the Deathless as their object.

Amatārammaṇakathā niṭṭhitā.

The discourse on the Deathless as object is concluded.

9. Navamavaggo

9. The Ninth Chapter

(86) 3. Rūpaṃ sārammaṇantikathā

(86) 3. Discussion on Form Being with an Object

552. Rūpaṃ [T 0.0434][M 0.0298][V 0.0331] sārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo samannāhāro manasikāro cetanā patthanā paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… nanu natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Hañci natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhi, no ca vata re vattabbe – “rūpaṃ sārammaṇa”nti.

552. Is form with an object? Yes. Does it have turning towards, adverting, applying, attending, volition, aspiration, or resolve? It should not be said thus… Is it not that it lacks turning towards, adverting… resolve? Yes. If it lacks turning towards, adverting… resolve, then indeed it should not be said, 'Form is with an object.'

Phasso sārammaṇo, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā[P 0.0405]. Rūpaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Contact is with an object; does it have turning towards, adverting… resolve? Yes. Form is with an object; does it have turning towards, adverting… resolve? It should not be said thus….

Vedanā…pe… saññā cetanā cittaṃ saddhā vīriyaṃ sati samādhi paññā rāgo doso moho māno diṭṭhi vicikicchā thinaṃ uddhaccaṃ ahirikaṃ…pe… anottappaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, atthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Feeling… perception, volition, consciousness, faith, energy, mindfulness, concentration, wisdom, lust, aversion, delusion, conceit, view, doubt, sloth, restlessness, shamelessness… lack of moral dread is with an object; does it have turning towards, adverting… resolve? Yes. Form is with an object; does it have turning towards, adverting… resolve? It should not be said thus….

Rūpaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Phasso sārammaṇo, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Form is with an object; does it lack turning towards, adverting… resolve? Yes. Contact is with an object; does it lack turning towards, adverting… resolve? It should not be said thus….

Rūpaṃ [T 0.0435] sārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Āmantā. Vedanā…pe… anottappaṃ sārammaṇaṃ, natthi tassa āvaṭṭanā ābhogo…pe… paṇidhīti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Form is with an object; does it lack turning towards, adverting… resolve? Yes. Feeling… lack of moral dread is with an object; does it lack turning towards, adverting… resolve? It should not be said thus….

553. Na vattabbaṃ – “rūpaṃ sārammaṇa”nti? Āmantā. Nanu rūpaṃ sappaccayanti? Āmantā. Hañci rūpaṃ sappaccayaṃ, tena vata re vattabbe – “rūpaṃ sārammaṇa”nti.

553. Should it not be said, 'Form is with an object'? Yes. But is not form conditioned? Yes. If form is conditioned, then indeed it should be said, 'Form is with an object.'

Rūpaṃ sārammaṇantikathā niṭṭhitā.

The discussion on form being with an object is concluded.

9. Navamavaggo

9. The Ninth Chapter

(87) 4. Anusayā anārammaṇakathā

(87) 4. Discussion on Latent Tendencies Being without an Object

554. Anusayā [M 0.0299][V 0.0332] anārammaṇāti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ [P 0.0406] nibbānaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

554. Are latent tendencies without an object? Yes. Are they form, Nibbāna, the eye-base… the tangible-base? It should not be said thus….

Kāmarāgānusayo anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Kāmarāgo kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kāmarāgasaṃyojanaṃ kāmogho kāmayogo kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ anārammaṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kāmarāgo kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhānaṃ kāmarāgasaṃyojanaṃ kāmogho kāmayogo kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ sārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Kāmarāgānusayo sārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the latent tendency of sensual lust without an object? Yes. Are sensual lust, the obsession of sensual lust, the fetter of sensual lust, the flood of sensuality, the yoke of sensuality, and the hindrance of sensual desire without an object? It should not be said thus… Are sensual lust, the obsession of sensual lust, the fetter of sensual lust, the flood of sensuality, the yoke of sensuality, and the hindrance of sensual desire with an object? Yes. Is the latent tendency of sensual lust with an object? It should not be said thus….

Kāmarāgānusayo anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Katamakkhandhapariyāpannoti[T 0.0436]? Saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannoti. Saṅkhārakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhārakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho viññāṇakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the latent tendency of sensual lust without an object? Yes. In which aggregate is it included? It is included in the aggregate of formations. Is the aggregate of formations without an object? It should not be said thus… Is the aggregate of formations without an object? Yes. Are the aggregates of feeling, perception, and consciousness without an object? It should not be said thus….

Kāmarāgānusayo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Kāmarāgo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… kāmarāgo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno sārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Kāmarāgānusayo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno sārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the latent tendency of sensual lust, being included in the aggregate of formations, without an object? Yes. Is sensual lust, being included in the aggregate of formations, without an object? It should not be said thus… Is sensual lust, being included in the aggregate of formations, with an object? Yes. Is the latent tendency of sensual lust, being included in the aggregate of formations, with an object? It should not be said thus….

Kāmarāgānusayo [P 0.0407] saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno anārammaṇo, kāmarāgo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno sārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Saṅkhārakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhārakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho viññāṇakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is it that the latent tendency of sensual lust is included in the aggregate of formations and is without an object, while sensual lust is included in the aggregate of formations and is with an object? Yes. Is the aggregate of formations partly with an object and partly without an object? It should not be said thus… Is the aggregate of formations partly with an object and partly without an object? Yes. Are the aggregates of feeling, perception, and consciousness partly with an object and partly without an object? It should not be said thus….

555. Paṭighānusayo [V 0.0333] mānānusayo diṭṭhānusayo vicikicchānusayo bhavarāgānusayo avijjānusayo anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjāsaṃyojanaṃ [M 0.0300] avijjānīvaraṇaṃ anārammaṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… avijjā [T 0.0437] avijjogho…pe… avijjānīvaraṇaṃ sārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Avijjānusayo sārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

555. Are the latent tendencies of aversion, conceit, views, doubt, craving for existence, and ignorance without an object? Yes. Are ignorance, the flood of ignorance, the yoke of ignorance, the latent tendency of ignorance, the obsession of ignorance, the fetter of ignorance, and the hindrance of ignorance without an object? It should not be said thus… Is ignorance, the flood of ignorance… the hindrance of ignorance with an object? Yes. Is the latent tendency of ignorance with an object? It should not be said thus….

Avijjānusayo anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Katamakkhandhapariyāpannoti? Saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannoti. Saṅkhārakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhārakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho viññāṇakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the latent tendency of ignorance without an object? Yes. In which aggregate is it included? It is included in the aggregate of formations. Is the aggregate of formations without an object? It should not be said thus… Is the aggregate of formations without an object? Yes. Are the aggregates of feeling, perception, and consciousness without an object? It should not be said thus….

Avijjānusayo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Avijjā [P 0.0408] saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannā anārammaṇāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… avijjā saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannā sārammaṇāti? Āmantā. Avijjānusayo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno sārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is the latent tendency of ignorance, being included in the aggregate of formations, without an object? Yes. Is ignorance, being included in the aggregate of formations, without an object? It should not be said thus… Is ignorance, being included in the aggregate of formations, with an object? Yes. Is the latent tendency of ignorance, being included in the aggregate of formations, with an object? It should not be said thus….

Avijjānusayo saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpanno anārammaṇo, avijjā saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannā sārammaṇāti? Āmantā. Saṅkhārakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhārakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho viññāṇakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is it that the latent tendency of ignorance is included in the aggregate of formations and is without an object, while ignorance is included in the aggregate of formations and is with an object? Yes. Is the aggregate of formations partly with an object and partly without an object? It should not be said thus… Is the aggregate of formations partly with an object and partly without an object? Yes. Are the aggregates of feeling, perception, and consciousness partly with an object and partly without an object? It should not be said thus….

556. Na [T 0.0438] vattabbaṃ – “anusayā anārammaṇā”ti? Āmantā. Puthujjano kusalābyākate citte vattamāne sānusayoti vattabboti? Āmantā. Atthi tesaṃ anusayānaṃ ārammaṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… tena hi anusayā anārammaṇāti. Puthujjano kusalābyākate citte vattamāne sarāgoti vattabboti? Āmantā. Atthi tassa rāgassa ārammaṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe…. Tena hi rāgo anārammaṇoti.

556. Should it not be said that 'underlying tendencies are without an object'? Yes. When an ordinary person’s mind is occurring in a wholesome or indeterminate state, should it be said that they are with underlying tendencies? Yes. Do those underlying tendencies have an object? It should not be said thus… Therefore, underlying tendencies are without an object. When an ordinary person’s mind is occurring in a wholesome or indeterminate state, should it be said that they are with lust? Yes. Does that lust have an object? It should not be said thus… Therefore, lust is without an object.

Anusayā anārammaṇātikathā niṭṭhitā.

The discussion on underlying tendencies being without an object is concluded.

9. Navamavaggo

9. The Ninth Chapter

(88) 5. Ñāṇaṃ anārammaṇantikathā

9. (88) 5. Discussion on Knowledge Being Without an Object

557. Ñāṇaṃ [P 0.0409][V 0.0334] anārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Rūpaṃ nibbānaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ…pe… phoṭṭhabbāyatananti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… ñāṇaṃ anārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Paññā [M 0.0301] paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo sārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Ñāṇaṃ sārammaṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is knowledge without an object? Yes. Is knowledge form, Nibbāna, the eye-sphere… up to… the tangible-sphere? It should not be said thus… Is knowledge without an object? Yes. Are wisdom, the wisdom-faculty, the wisdom-power, right view, and the investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor without an object? It should not be said thus… Are wisdom, the wisdom-faculty, the wisdom-power, right view, and the investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor with an object? Yes. Is knowledge with an object? It should not be said thus…

Ñāṇaṃ anārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Katamakkhandhapariyāpannanti? Saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannanti. Saṅkhārakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhārakkhandho anārammaṇoti[T 0.0439]? Āmantā. Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho viññāṇakkhandho anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… ñāṇaṃ saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannaṃ anārammaṇanti? Āmantā. Paññā saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannā anārammaṇāti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… paññā saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannā sārammaṇāti? Āmantā. Ñāṇaṃ saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannaṃ sārammaṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

557. Is knowledge without an object? Yes. In which aggregate is it included? It is included in the formations aggregate. Is the formations aggregate without an object? It should not be said thus… Is the formations aggregate without an object? Yes. Are the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the consciousness aggregate without an object? It should not be said thus… Is knowledge, being included in the formations aggregate, without an object? Yes. Is wisdom, being included in the formations aggregate, without an object? It should not be said thus… Is wisdom, being included in the formations aggregate, with an object? Yes. Is knowledge, being included in the formations aggregate, with an object? It should not be said thus…

Ñāṇaṃ [P 0.0410] saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannaṃ anārammaṇaṃ, paññā saṅkhārakkhandhapariyāpannā sārammaṇāti? Āmantā. Saṅkhārakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… saṅkhārakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Āmantā. Vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho viññāṇakkhandho ekadeso sārammaṇo ekadeso anārammaṇoti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe….

Is knowledge, being included in the formations aggregate, without an object, and wisdom, being included in the formations aggregate, with an object? Yes. Is the formations aggregate in one part with an object and in one part without an object? It should not be said thus… Is the formations aggregate in one part with an object and in one part without an object? Yes. Are the feeling aggregate, the perception aggregate, and the consciousness aggregate in one part with an object and in one part without an object? It should not be said thus…

558. Na vattabbaṃ – “ñāṇaṃ anārammaṇa”nti? Āmantā. Arahā cakkhuviññāṇasamaṅgī ñāṇīti vattabboti? Āmantā. Atthi tassa ñāṇassa ārammaṇanti? Na hevaṃ vattabbe…pe… tena hi ñāṇaṃ anārammaṇanti. Arahā cakkhuviññāṇasamaṅgī paññavāti [V 0.0335] vattabboti? Āmantā. Atthi tāya paññāya ārammaṇanti? Na [T 0.0440] hevaṃ vattabbe…pe…. Tena hi paññā anārammaṇāti.

Should it not be said that 'knowledge is without an object'? Yes. Should it be said that an Arahant endowed with eye-consciousness possesses knowledge? Yes. Does that knowledge have an object? It should not be said thus... Therefore, knowledge is without an object. Should it be said that an Arahant endowed with eye-consciousness possesses wisdom? Yes. Does that wisdom have an object? It should not be said thus... Therefore, wisdom is without an object.

Ñāṇaṃ anārammaṇantikathā niṭṭhitā.

558. The discussion on knowledge being without an object is concluded.

9. Navamavaggo

9. The Ninth Chapter

(89) 6. Atītānāgatārammaṇakathā

(89) 6. Discussion on Past and Future Objects
